opts.t: A CCPC must first reduce its low rate income pool (LRIP) to zero on Schedule 54 before it may pay any eligible dividend out of GRIP.
opts.w: 错误。低税率收入池（low rate income pool, LRIP，Schedule 54）是非 CCPC 才有的阻挡池；CCPC 只有 GRIP，没有 LRIP。

opts.t: GRIP must be calculated immediately before each dividend payment, and any excess eligible dividend designation is taxed at 60% under Part III.
opts.w: 错误。要求在每次派息前一刻核实余额、超额罚 60% Part III 税的是资本股息账户（CDA），而 GRIP 是在年末计算的，超额罚 20% 或 30%（Part III.1 税）。

opts.t: A CCPC may treat a dividend as eligible without ever notifying shareholders in writing, as long as it reports the designation on its T2.
opts.w: 错误。根据 ITA s.89(14)，合资格股息必须在付款当时或之前书面通知股东（董事会纪要记一行即可）；迟报指定可在三年内补作，但也要通知股东，不存在「永不通知、只在 T2 上报」就成立的合资格股息。

main.pt: 两条递减取大者与现行应税资本区间
main.trap: 两条递减相加或套用旧区间
main.stem: Kootenay Precision Ltd., a stand-alone CCPC, had $12,000,000 of taxable capital employed in Canada in its preceding tax year and $70,000 of adjusted aggregate investment income (AAII) in its tax year ended in the preceding calendar year. Applying the 2026 rules, by how much is Kootenay's $500,000 small business deduction business limit reduced?
main.zh: 独立 CCPC（Kootenay Precision Ltd.）上一税年在加拿大运用的应税资本为 $12,000,000，上一历年内结束的税年的调整后合计投资收入（AAII）为 $70,000。按 2026 税年现行规则，Kootenay 的 $500,000 小企业扣除经营限额被削减多少？

opts.t: $125,000, because the $25,000 taxable capital grind and the $100,000 passive income grind are added together.
$25,000, because the smaller of the taxable capital grind and the passive income grind is the one that applies.
$200,000, because the taxable capital grind phases the business limit out between $10M and $15M of capital.
$100,000, the greater of the $25,000 taxable capital grind and the $100,000 passive income grind.

main.pt: 赚取收入与三项法定资格
main.trap: 股息计入赚取收入陷阱
main.stem: Marcus is the sole owner-manager of a British Columbia retail CCPC. Since incorporating three years ago, he has compensated himself exclusively with $100,000 of non-eligible dividends each year and $0 in salary. He has no other income sources. Which statement accurately describes his tax and benefit position for 2026?
main.zh: Marcus 是一家卑诗省零售类 CCPC 的唯一业主经理。自三年前成立公司以来，他每年全部以 $100,000 非合资格股息的形式给自己发薪酬，工资为 $0，且无其他收入来源。关于他 2026 年的税务与福利状况，下列哪项表述准确？

opts.t: He accumulates $18,000 of new RRSP contribution room each year, but he does not build any CPP pensionable earnings.
opts.w: 落入股息计入赚取收入陷阱。根据《所得税法》（ITA）s.146(1)，注册退休储蓄计划（RRSP）的赚取收入（earned income）只包含雇佣所得、自营所得及不动产净租金等，股息不在清单内，因此不会产生 $18,000 的 RRSP 额度。

opts.t: He generates no new RRSP room, accumulates no CPP pensionable earnings, and has a $0 earned income base for childcare deductions.
opts.w: 正确。股息既不产生加拿大退休金计划（Canada Pension Plan, CPP）可保收入，也被排除在 ITA s.146(1) 的 RRSP 赚取收入（earned income）和 ITA s.63(3) 的托儿费扣除赚取收入之外，只靠分红维生会让这三项资格全部归零。

opts.t: He can claim childcare expenses up to two-thirds of his $115,000 grossed-up dividend, though his RRSP room remains zero.
opts.w: 落入股息计入赚取收入陷阱。托儿费扣除额度虽按赚取收入（earned income）的三分之二封顶（ITA s.63(3)），但该定义只认雇佣与自营所得，不含股息或毛额化股息。

opts.t: His corporation can deduct the $100,000 dividend as an operating expense, saving 11% in combined corporate income tax.
opts.w: 混淆了工资与分红在公司层面的扣除规则。工资可以作为经营支出在算税前扣除，而分红是用公司交完税后的留存利润分配的，在公司层面不可扣除。

main.pt: 股息毛额化与税收抵免计算
main.trap: 滑单混报与超额合资格股息陷阱
main.stem: A British Columbia CCPC earns $100 of active business income in 2026 that fully qualifies for the federal and BC small business deduction (combined 11% corporate tax rate). It distributes the entire $89 after-tax profit as a non-eligible dividend to its sole shareholder. How is this dividend treated on the shareholder's 2026 personal tax return?
main.zh: 一家卑诗省 CCPC 在 2026 年赚取 $100 积极营业收入，全额享受联邦与卑诗省小企业扣除（合计 11% 公司税率）。公司将税后剩下的 $89 利润全部作为非合资格股息分给唯一股东。这笔股息在股东 2026 年个人税表上如何处理？

opts.t: Grossed up by 38% to $122.82, with a federal dividend tax credit of 6/11 of the gross-up and a BC credit of 12% of the taxable dividend.
opts.w: 错用了合资格股息的参数。38% 毛额化、联邦 6/11 抵免和 BC 省 12% 抵免适用于一般税率利润派发的合资格股息（eligible dividend），而非享小企业扣除后的非合资格股息。

opts.t: Grossed up by 15% to $102.35, with a BC provincial dividend tax credit equal to 1.96% of the $89.00 actual cash dividend received.
opts.w: 混淆了省级股息税收抵免的计算基数。卑诗省 2026 年非合资格股息的 1.96% 抵免率乘的是放大后的应税股息（$102.35），而不是实际收到的现金股息（$89.00）。

opts.t: Grossed up by 15% to $102.35, with a federal dividend tax credit of 9/13 of the gross-up and a BC credit of 1.96% of the $102.35 taxable dividend.
opts.w: 正确。享小企业低税率的利润分出的是非合资格股息（non-eligible dividend），按 ITA s.82(1)(b) 放大 15% 得应税股息 $102.35；联邦股息税收抵免（DTC）为毛额化增量的 9/13（ITA s.121），BC 省抵免为应税股息 $102.35 的 1.96%。

opts.t: Reported at its actual cash amount of $89.00 with no further personal tax payable because corporate integration is exact.
opts.w: 误解了整合（integration）机制。个人必须先按毛额化放大再抵免，且扣掉抵免后个人层面仍需按边际税率补交第二道税，整合只是近似而非免除个人税。

main.pt: 控股股东工资的CPP与EI
main.trap: 控股股东照常缴EI陷阱
main.stem: Tariq owns 100% of the voting shares of his BC consulting CCPC. In 2026, the corporation pays him an employment salary of $90,000. Given that the 2026 YAMPE for CPP2 is $85,000, which statutory payroll deductions and employer contributions apply to Tariq's salary?
main.zh: Tariq 持有其卑诗省咨询类 CCPC 100% 的有表决权股份。2026 年公司向他发放 $90,000 雇佣工资。已知 2026 年 CPP2 的年度额外最高可保收入上限（YAMPE）为 $85,000，Tariq 的工资适用哪些法定薪资扣缴与雇主供款？

opts.t: Both employee and employer pay base CPP (5.95% each) up to the YMPE and CPP2 (4% each) from the YMPE to $85,000, with $0 in EI premiums.
opts.w: 正确。发工资须由雇员与公司各付 5.95% 的基本 CPP（合计 11.9%），并在 YMPE 至 $85,000（YAMPE）区间各付 4% 的第二层附加 CPP 供款（CPP2），$85,000 以上不再缴；同时因 Tariq 控制超过 40% 有表决权股份，按《雇佣保险法》s.5(2)(b) 属于不可保雇佣，免缴雇佣保险（EI）。

opts.t: Both employee and employer pay base CPP, CPP2, and mandatory Employment Insurance (EI) premiums up to the annual Maximum Insurable Earnings.
opts.w: 落入控股股东照常缴 EI 陷阱。控制公司超过 40% 有表决权股份的股东，其雇佣关系按《雇佣保险法》s.5(2)(b) 直接属于不可保雇佣，不用缴 EI 保费，也不能领常规 EI 福利。

opts.t: Tariq pays the combined 11.9% CPP personally on his T1 return at year-end, so the corporation does not need a payroll program account (RP).
opts.w: 混淆了公司雇员与无限责任个体经营者的申报方式。没有公司的个体经营者才在 T1 上自己扛两份 CPP；公司发工资必须先开立薪资扣缴账户（payroll program account, RP），由公司代扣雇员部分并配缴雇主部分。

opts.t: The 4% CPP2 contribution applies to all employment income above the YMPE, including the $5,000 portion above $85,000.
opts.w: 忽略了 CPP2 的封顶上限。CPP2 仅对 YMPE 到 YAMPE（2026 年为 $85,000）之间那一段收入课征 4%，超过 $85,000 YAMPE 的部分不再缴纳。

main.pt: TOSI家庭分红三条排除线
main.trap: TOSI年龄与工时错配陷阱
main.stem: Victor, age 52, owns 100% of a Surrey restaurant corporation. His spouse, Rosa, age 49, owns non-voting shares (worth 5% of total corporate value) and worked 25 hours per week managing inventory during six prior taxation years from 2018 to 2023, though she did not work at the restaurant in 2026. If the corporation pays Rosa a $40,000 dividend in 2026, how does TOSI apply?
main.zh: 52 岁的 Victor 100% 持有素里一家餐厅公司的表决权股份。他 49 岁的配偶 Rosa 持有无表决权股份（占公司总市值 5%），在 2018 至 2023 年共六个过往纳税年度中每周工作 25 小时负责库存管理，但 2026 年未在餐厅工作。若公司 2026 年向 Rosa 派发 $40,000 分红，TOSI 如何适用？

opts.t: The dividend is taxed at the top marginal rate under TOSI because Rosa did not work at least 20 hours per week in 2026.
opts.w: 落入 TOSI 年龄与工时错配陷阱。实质参与经营（excluded business）排除要求在本年度、或者过去累计任意五个纳税年度（不需连续）平均每周工作达到或超过 20 小时；Rosa 已有六年达标，当年不工作也依然满足该排除。

opts.t: The dividend is excluded from TOSI under the excluded shares rule because a restaurant is not a professional corporation.
opts.w: 落入 TOSI 年龄与工时错配陷阱。合资格股份（excluded shares）要求收款人持有的表决权与市值均不低于 10%；Rosa 持有的是无表决权股且市值仅占 5%，不满足合资格股份排除。

opts.t: Taxed at the top marginal rate under TOSI because Victor, the owner, has not yet reached age 65 in 2026.
opts.w: 误以为必须同时满足所有排除条件。分割收入税（TOSI）的三条排除线只需命中任意一条即可按收款人自己的边际税率课税，虽然 Victor 未满 65 岁，但 Rosa 已命中实质参与经营排除。

opts.t: Exempt from TOSI under the excluded business rule, since Rosa worked 20+ hours a week in five prior years.
opts.w: 正确。根据实质参与经营（excluded business）排除规则，年满 18 岁的收款人在本年度或过去累计任意五个纳税年度中平均每周实际工作满 20 小时即可豁免 TOSI；Rosa 在过去六个纳税年度每周工作 25 小时，分红按她自己的边际税率课税。

main.trap: 股东贷款免本金即免利息陷阱
main.stem: Liam's wholly owned CCPC has a December 31 taxation year-end. On April 1, 2026, Liam borrows $200,000 interest-free from the corporation to use as a down payment on a personal vacation cottage (not as an employee loan). What is the latest date he can repay the principal to avoid a s.15(2) loan inclusion, and does an interest benefit still apply?
main.zh: Liam 全资持有的 CCPC 年结日为 12 月 31 日。2026 年 4 月 1 日，Liam 因股东身份从公司无息借出 $200,000 用于个人度假屋首付（非雇员购房贷款例外）。为避免按 s.15(2) 将本金整笔并入所得，他最迟须在哪天还清本金？是否仍会产生利息福利？

opts.t: Repay by December 31, 2026; if repaid by then, neither the principal nor any deemed interest benefit is included in his income.
opts.w: 同时搞错了还款期限与利息规则。还款限期是借款那个公司税年结束后一年内（2027 年 12 月 31 日），且即便按时还清本金，零息借款仍须计算 s.80.4 推定利息福利。

opts.t: Repay by December 31, 2027 (not part of a series of loans and repayments); a s.80.4 deemed interest benefit at the prescribed rate still applies.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.15(2)，股东贷款只要在放款那个公司税年（2026 年 12 月 31 日）结束后一年内（即 2027 年 12 月 31 日前）还清且非循环借还，本金不并入所得；但实付利息（0%）低于 CRA 规定利率（prescribed rate，2026 年 Q4 为 3%），差额仍须按 s.80.4 计入推定利息福利（deemed interest benefit）。

opts.t: Repay by April 1, 2027 (365 days from the date of the advance); if repaid by then, no s.80.4 interest benefit arises.
opts.w: 落入股东贷款免本金即免利息陷阱，且误把期限算成放款日起 365 天。条文规定的是放款那个公司税年结束后一年内（横跨两个公司年结日），且按期还款不免除 s.80.4 利息福利。

opts.t: Repay by February 28, 2027 (the T4A filing deadline); the corporation can deduct the forgone interest as a business expense.
opts.w: 混淆了滑单申报截止日与股东贷款还款期。次年 2 月最后一天是滑单申报截止日，不是 s.15(2) 的还款期限，且公司未收的利息不能作为费用扣除。

main.pt: 公司车待命费与股东福利滑单
main.trap: 滑单混报与超额合资格股息陷阱
main.stem: A BC corporation purchases an automobile for $50,000 (including taxes) and makes it available to its sole shareholder for all 12 months of 2026. The shareholder drives the car 18,000 km in total during the year, of which 7,000 km is for business and 11,000 km is personal. How is the standby charge calculated, and if the benefit is provided strictly by virtue of shareholding, which slip is used?
main.zh: 一家卑诗省公司以 $50,000（含税）买断一辆汽车，并在 2026 年全年 12 个月提供给唯一股东使用。股东全年共行驶 18,000 公里，其中公务 7,000 公里、私用 11,000 公里。汽车待命费（standby charge）如何计算？若该福利纯因股东身份提供，应使用哪张滑单申报？

opts.t: 2% × $50,000 × 12 months, reduced by multiplying by (11,000 ÷ 20,004), and reported on a T5 slip as a non-eligible dividend.
opts.w: 同时犯了打折条件错误与滑单混报错误。公务里程 7,000 / 18,000 未超过 50%，不能享受按私用公里打折；且股东福利不能报在 T5 上当股息。

opts.t: 2/3 × $50,000 × 12 months with no reduction, reported on a T4 slip so that it generates CPP pensionable earnings.
opts.w: 混淆了买断车与租赁车的公式及申报表。2/3 是租赁车乘月租的系数，买断车应按每月 2% 乘原始成本；且因股东身份给的福利应报进 T4A 而非 T4。

opts.t: Full standby charge of 2% × $50,000 × 12 months ($12,000) with no reduction because business use is not over 50%, reported on a T4A slip.
opts.w: 正确。买断车待命费（standby charge）公式为每月 2% × 原始成本 × 可用月数（ITA s.6(1)(e)/(2)）；只有公务用途超过 50% 时才能按私用公里 ÷（1,667 × 12）打折，本题公务仅 7,000/18,000（低于 50%），按全额 $12,000 算；因股东身份取得的应税福利（taxable benefit）应报在 T4A 上（计入 T1 第 13000 行），不享股息抵免。

opts.t: Full standby charge of 2% × $50,000 × 12 months ($12,000), reported on a T4A slip and eligible for the 1.96% BC dividend tax credit.
opts.w: 落入滑单混报陷阱。股东福利报进 T4A 后属于普通所得（报在 T1 第 13000 行），不是股息，不能享受联邦或 BC 省的股息税收抵免（DTC）。

main.pt: 家庭雇员s.67与合规截止日
main.trap: TOSI年龄与工时错配陷阱
main.stem: Gavin owns 100% of a BC software CCPC. In 2026, the corporation pays his 19-year-old daughter $65,000 in salary for updating the company website for two hours a month — a task that an arm's-length freelancer would perform for $3,000 a year. What is the tax consequence of this salary payment, and when are payroll remittances normally due?
main.zh: Gavin 100% 持有一家卑诗省软件 CCPC。2026 年公司向他 19 岁的女儿支付 $65,000 工资，工作内容是每月花两小时更新公司网站——同等工作找非关联自由职业者每年只需 $3,000。这笔工资支出有何税务后果？常规按月汇缴源头扣缴的截止日是哪天？

opts.t: Under s.67, the corporation's deduction is denied for the unreasonable $62,000 excess; regular monthly payroll remittances are due by the 15th of the following month.
opts.w: 正确。付给家庭成员的报酬必须通过 ITA s.67 合理性测试（reasonableness test），超出付给陌生人做同等工作公允市价（$3,000）的不合理部分（$62,000）公司不得扣除，但个人已收款项仍可能被追征导致双重不利；此外常规雇主的源头扣缴（payroll source deductions）须在每月 15 日前汇缴。

opts.t: The $65,000 salary is automatically taxed at the top marginal rate under the Tax on Split Income (TOSI) rules because she worked under 20 hours per week.
opts.w: 混淆了工资与分红的反避税规则。分割收入税（TOSI）及每周 20 小时排除线管辖的是分红等分拆收入，而支付给家庭成员的雇佣工资受 s.67 合理性测试与 business purpose 测试规制。

opts.t: The entire $65,000 is deductible by the corporation as long as a T4 slip is filed by the last day of February of the following year.
opts.w: 误以为按时申报 T4 就能绕过实质审查。虽然 T4 滑单确须在次年 2 月最后一天前申报，但徒有其名或远超公允市价的家庭成员工资仍会被 CRA 按 s.67 打回扣除。

opts.t: The corporation is assessed a 20% Part III.1 penalty tax on the $62,000 excess salary paid to a specified family member.
opts.w: 错配了罚税条款。20% 的 Part III.1 罚税专门针对公司超一般税率收入池（GRIP）余额错发合资格股息的行为，不适用于超额工资。

main.pt: 股东贷款一年例外死线与雇员例外
main.trap: 用借款日加一年算还款死线
main.stem: Ms. Gao owns 100% of the shares of Cedar Design Inc., which has a December 31 taxation year-end. On March 1, 2026, she withdraws an $80,000 interest-free loan from the corporation to renovate her principal residence. It is not part of a series of loans and repayments. By what date must she repay the loan so that the $80,000 principal is not included in her 2026 income under ITA s.15(2)?
main.zh: 高女士持有雪松设计公司 100% 的股份，该公司税年结束日为 12 月 31 日。2026 年 3 月 1 日，她从公司支取一笔 $80,000 的无息借款用于装修自住房，且不属于一系列借与还。她最迟必须在哪一天之前还清这笔钱，才能使 $80,000 本金不按 ITA s.15(2) 计入她 2026 年的收入？

opts.t: March 1, 2027, which is exactly one year after the date she received the $80,000 loan.
opts.w: 落入了『用借款日加一年算还款死线』的陷阱；ITA s.15(2.6) 的一年起算点是放款公司该税年结束之日（2026-12-31），而不是放款当天（2026-03-01）。

opts.t: December 31, 2027, which is one year after the end of the corporation's 2026 taxation year in which the loan was made.
opts.w: 首先，s.15(2.4) 的雇员股东购房例外（employee-shareholder exception）仅限『取得（购买）』供本人居住的住宅，装修不在其中，且她持股 100% 属指定雇员（specified employee）；因此只能走 s.15(2.6) 的一年内还清例外，死线为放款公司税年结束日（2026-12-31）之后一年，即 2027-12-31。

opts.t: January 30, 2027, which is 30 days after the end of the 2026 calendar year.
opts.w: 混淆了本金还款死线与利息支付死线；次年 1 月 30 日（日历年结束后 30 天内）是支付实际利息以抵减 s.80.4 视同利息利益（deemed interest benefit）的截止日。

opts.t: No fixed deadline applies, because a loan used for a shareholder's principal residence is exempt under s.15(2.4).
opts.w: 误读了 s.15(2.4) 住宅例外的适用范围；条文写的是『购买』供本人居住的住宅，借钱装修现有自住房不能适用该条例外。

main.pt: s.80.4视同利息利益与实付利息抵减
main.trap: 股东贷款免本金即免利息
main.stem: Using the same facts for Ms. Gao (an $80,000 interest-free loan received on March 1, 2026, outstanding for 306 days in 2026, and repaid in full in November 2027), the CRA prescribed rate is 3% for all four quarters of 2026. If she pays no interest to the corporation, what is her 2026 deemed interest benefit under ITA s.80.4, and by what date could she pay interest to eliminate it?
main.zh: 沿用高女士的情形（2026 年 3 月 1 日借入 $80,000 无息贷款，2026 年内未偿期 306 天，并于 2027 年 11 月全额还清），2026 税年四个季度的 CRA 规定利率均为 3%。若她未向公司支付利息，2026 年按 ITA s.80.4 计算的视同利息利益是多少？她最迟可在哪一天前付息以将该利益抵为零？

opts.t: Approximately $2,012; she can eliminate the benefit by paying the interest on or before January 30, 2027.
opts.w: 因为她在 2027-12-31 死线前还清本金，本金不按 s.15(2) 计税，须按 s.80.4 计算视同利息利益（deemed interest benefit）：$80,000 × 规定利率（prescribed rate）3% × 306/365 ≈ $2,012；只要在日历年结束后 30 天内（即 2027 年 1 月 30 日或之前）实际付息即可抵为零。

opts.t: $0; because the loan is repaid within the s.15(2.6) window in November 2027, no benefit arises under s.80.4.
opts.w: 混淆了 s.15(2) 与 s.80.4 的互补关系；正因为走掉了 s.15(2.6) 的一年内还款例外、本金未被全额课税，才轮到 s.80.4 对白用公司资金的期间计算视同利息利益。

opts.t: Approximately $2,012; she can eliminate the benefit by paying the interest at any time before November 2027 when the principal is repaid.
opts.w: 把本金还款死线当成了利息抵减死线；s.80.4 明确要求抵减的利息必须在日历年结束后 30 天内（次年 1 月 30 日前）实际支付。

opts.t: $80,000 plus $2,012; both the loan principal and the deemed interest benefit are taxed in 2026.
opts.w: 违反了 s.80.4(3)(b) 同一笔钱不双重课税的原则，且她在 2027 年 11 月（早于 2027-12-31 死线）还清本金，本金无需计入 2026 年收入。

main.pt: s.85票据超税基与下限规则
main.trap: s.85 拿超额票据仍以为零税负
main.stem: Mr. Kuan incorporates his sole proprietorship in 2026 and transfers equipment (FMV $60,000, UCC $22,000), inventory (FMV $30,000, cost $30,000), and internally generated goodwill (FMV $90,000, tax cost $0) to his new corporation under ITA s.85. Total FMV is $180,000 and total tax cost is $52,000. If he takes back a $80,000 promissory note plus common shares and tries to elect at $52,000, what is the immediate tax result?
main.zh: 关先生在 2026 年将其个体户装进公司，按 ITA s.85 转让设备（公平市值 $60,000，未折旧资本成本 $22,000）、存货（公平市值 $30,000，成本 $30,000）和自建商誉（公平市值 $90,000，税基 $0）。公平市值合计 $180,000，税基合计 $52,000。若他从公司拿走一张 $80,000 的票据外加普通股，并试图将选举金额填为 $52,000，当年的即时税务后果是什么？

opts.t: He realizes zero income in 2026 because an s.85 election always defers gain when common shares are included in the consideration.
opts.w: 落入了『s.85 拿超额票据仍以为零税负』的陷阱；虽然对价包含股份，但非股份对价（boot）$80,000 超过了税基合计 $52,000，不能再填 $52,000。

opts.t: The minimum elected amount is pushed up to the $80,000 boot under s.85(1)(b), triggering $28,000 of immediate gain in 2026.
opts.w: 根据 ITA s.85(1)(b)，选举金额（elected amount）的下限是所收非股份对价（boot）的公平市值；当票据开到 $80,000 时，超出税基 $52,000 的 $28,000 把选举金额下限顶到 $80,000，当年立刻产生 $28,000 的应税收益。

opts.t: The entire s.85 election becomes invalid and he is taxed on the full $128,000 accrued gain in 2026.
opts.w: 选举金额填得比 boot 低并不会使整份第 85 条转让（section 85 rollover）作废，法律是直接按 s.85(1)(b) 将选举金额自动调高到 boot 的公平市值 $80,000。

opts.t: The $28,000 excess boot is taxed as a shareholder loan under s.15(2) unless repaid by the end of the next taxation year.
opts.w: 混淆了公司欠股东的票据（boot）与股东欠公司的借款（shareholder loan）；票据是公司应付给关先生的对价，适用 s.85(1)(b) 确认转让收益，不适用 s.15(2)。

main.pt: ABIL计算与历年豁免两倍冲减
main.trap: ABIL 误用 2/3 纳入率或漏算豁免冲减
main.stem: In 2026, Mr. Yuen makes a valid ITA s.50(1) election on an uncollectible $50,000 loan he had advanced to his insolvent small business corporation. In 2019, he had claimed a $30,000 capital gains deduction under s.110.6 (exempting $60,000 of capital gains). What is the allowable business investment loss (ABIL) he can deduct against his 2026 employment income on T1 line 21700?
main.zh: 2026 年，袁先生就其借给名下资不抵债小企业公司的一笔 $50,000 坏账作出有效的 ITA s.50(1) 视同处置选举。2019 年，他曾按 s.110.6 申报过 $30,000 的资本利得扣除（即豁免了 $60,000 资本利得）。他可在 2026 年 T1 line 21700 用以抵扣雇佣收入的可扣营业投资损失（ABIL）是多少？

opts.t: $25,000, calculated as the $50,000 business investment loss multiplied by the 2026 one-half inclusion rate.
opts.w: 落入了『漏算历年终身资本利得豁免冲减』的陷阱；未先按 s.39(9) 扣减往年资本利得扣除额的两倍（$60,000）。

opts.t: $33,335, calculated using the 66.67% inclusion rate that older 2024 training examples applied to the loss.
opts.w: 同时犯了两个错误：既误用了从未生效的 66.67% 纳入率，又漏算了 s.39(9) 对往年终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）的冲减。

opts.t: $10,000, calculated by subtracting the $30,000 prior deduction from the $50,000 loss and multiplying the remainder by one-half.
opts.w: 冲减倍数算错；s.39(9) 规定往年申报的 s.110.6 资本利得扣除额（$30,000）要按『两倍』（即当初被豁免的利得总额 $60,000）冲减本年的营业投资损失。

opts.t: $0, since s.39(9) cuts the $50,000 loss by twice the prior $30,000 deduction ($60,000), leaving no ABIL.
opts.w: 根据 ITA s.39(9)，以前年度申报过的 s.110.6 资本利得扣除（$30,000）按两倍（即 $60,000）冲减本年的营业投资损失（business investment loss, BIL）；$50,000 的 BIL 被削成 $0，故可扣营业投资损失（ABIL）为 $0，该笔 $50,000 损失退回普通资本损失，只能抵资本利得。

main.pt: 清算视同股息与PUC及ACB分步计税
main.trap: 清算时拿个人 ACB 算视同股息
main.stem: Maple Consulting Inc. winds up in 2026 with $300,000 in cash after paying all liabilities. Its sole shareholder, Mr. Tse, holds common shares with a paid-up capital (PUC) of $1,000 and an adjusted cost base (ACB) of $61,000 (having bought shares at a premium from a former partner). The corporation has a capital dividend account (CDA) balance of $40,000 and makes a timely s.83(2) election. What are Mr. Tse's taxable dividend and his capital loss on the shares (after any stop-loss reduction) on the wind-up?
main.zh: 枫叶咨询公司在 2026 年清偿所有债务后账上剩 $300,000 现金并进行清算。唯一股东谢先生持有的普通股实缴资本（PUC）为 $1,000，他个人的调整成本基础（ACB）为 $61,000（早年从退出的合伙人手里溢价买股形成）。公司资本股息账户（CDA）余额为 $40,000 并按时作了 s.83(2) 选举。谢先生在本次清算中的应税股息，以及股份上（经止损规则调整后）可认的资本损失分别是多少？

opts.t: Taxable dividend of $199,000, using the $61,000 ACB instead of PUC, and a capital loss of $0 on the shares.
opts.w: 落入了『清算时拿个人 ACB 算视同股息』的头号陷阱；s.84(2) 的视同股息必须用分配款减去公司层面的 PUC（$1,000），不能减个人的 ACB（$61,000）。

opts.t: Taxable dividend of $299,000 and capital loss of $60,000, because the CDA balance cannot be elected during a wind-up.
opts.w: 忽略了 s.88(2) 允许将清算股息中不超过 CDA 余额的 $40,000 视同独立股息并作 s.83(2) 免税选举，也漏算了 s.112(3)(a) 止损规则对资本损失的 $40,000 调减。

opts.t: Taxable dividend of $259,000 (plus a $40,000 tax-free capital dividend) and a capital loss of $20,000 after stop-loss.
opts.w: 第一步按 s.84(2) 算视同股息（deemed dividend）：$300,000 − 实缴资本（PUC）$1,000 ＝ $299,000；第二步切出资本股息账户（CDA）余额内的 $40,000 作 s.83(2) 免税选举，余下 $259,000 为应税股息；第三步算股份处置：处置对价 $300,000 剔除视同股息 $299,000 得 $1,000，减去调整成本基础（ACB）$61,000 得未调整资本损失 $60,000，再按 s.112(3)(a) 止损规则扣减已免税收到的 $40,000 资本股息，最终可认的资本损失为 $20,000（这是资本损失本身，可扣的一半即允许资本损失为 $10,000）。

opts.t: Taxable capital gain of $239,000 ($300,000 cash minus the $61,000 ACB) and a deemed dividend of $0.
opts.w: 把公司清算分配当成了向第三方卖股票；公司清算必须先按 s.84(2) 将超过 PUC 的部分定性为视同股息，再将视同股息从处置对价中剔除。

main.pt: 清算解散法定顺序与清税证明书责任
main.trap: 先分财产后办清税证明或注销后才选 CDA
main.stem: Mr. Fang is the sole director and liquidator of a corporation winding up in 2026 with $300,000 in cash. Eager to close the books, he distributes the $300,000 to the shareholders first and plans to file the final T2 return and Form TX19 next month. What is the legal consequence under ITA s.159(2) and (3)?
main.zh: 方先生是一家在 2026 年清算的公司的唯一董事兼清算人，公司账上有 $300,000 现金。为尽快结账，他先把 $300,000 分给了股东，打算下个月再去报最后一张 T2 和递交 TX19 表。按 ITA s.159(2)(3) 会产生什么法律后果？

opts.t: He is personally liable for the corporation's unpaid tax, interest and penalties, up to the $300,000 he distributed.
opts.w: 根据 ITA s.159(2)(3)，法定代表人（legal representative）在向股东分配公司财产之前，必须先凭 TX19 取得清税证明书（clearance certificate）；未取得证书就先分钱的，在已分配财产价值（$300,000）的范围内对公司欠缴的税款、利息与罚金承担个人连带责任。

opts.t: There is no personal liability for him as long as he submits Form RC145 within 30 days after distributing the cash.
opts.w: RC145 只是最后一步用来关闭营业号下各程序账户的申请表，不能免除未取得 TX19 清税证明书就先行分配财产所触发的 s.159(3) 个人责任。

opts.t: His personal liability is capped at $8,000, the statutory maximum penalty for procedural filing errors by a director.
opts.w: $8,000 是迟报选举的封顶罚金；s.159(3) 的个人责任上限是『已分配财产的价值』（本例高达 $300,000），而非 $8,000。

opts.t: The distribution is void under corporate law, so only the CRA can sue the bank to reverse the wire transfer to shareholders.
opts.w: 税法并不宣告转账在公司法上无效，而是直接依据 s.159(3) 让先分钱的法定代表人自己掏腰包赔付公司欠税。

main.pt: s.50(1)视同处置选举年份与实物分配
main.trap: 先分财产后办清税证明或注销后才选 CDA
main.stem: A corporation ceased operations in 2023 and by the end of 2024 met all four conditions under ITA s.50(1)(b) (insolvent, ceased business, shares had nil fair market value, and reasonably expected to be dissolved without resuming business). The shareholder only remembers to claim an ABIL when preparing his 2026 T1 return. How must this be handled?
main.zh: 一家公司在 2023 年停业，到 2024 年末同时满足了 ITA s.50(1)(b) 的四个条件（资不抵债、停止经营、股份公平市值为零、且可合理预期将解散而不会重新开业）。股东直到准备 2026 年 T1 报税表时才想起要申报 ABIL。应当如何处理？

opts.t: He can freely make the s.50(1) election on his 2026 T1 return, because a shareholder may pick any year before formal dissolution.
opts.w: 忽略了 s.50(1) 触发年份的唯一性；四个条件在某一个年末同时成立的那一年（2024 年）就是唯一可以正常作 s.50(1) 选举的年份，不能随便挪到 2026 年。

opts.t: He has lost the ABIL permanently, because a late s.50(1) election is never permitted once the 2024 filing deadline has passed.
opts.w: 虽然错过了 2024 当年的正常申报，但税法在 s.220(3.2) 下留有税年结束后十个日历年内的迟报选举救济窗口，并非永久丧失。

opts.t: 2024 was the only trigger year; he now needs a late election under s.220(3.2), within ten years and subject to a penalty.
opts.w: 第 50(1) 条选举（subsection 50(1) election）只能在四个条件于年末同时成立的那一年（2024 年）作出；既然该年已过去，只能按 s.220(3.2) 走迟报选举（窗口为税年结束后十个日历年，罚金为 $8,000 与 $100 × 完整月数取小）。

opts.t: He can transfer the worthless shares to his spouse in 2026 for $1 to trigger a fresh 2026 business investment loss, with no election.
opts.w: 根据 s.39(1)(c)，向关联方（如配偶）转让股份不能触发营业投资损失（BIL）。

main.pt: 雇员福利与股东福利的身份分流与报表
main.trap: 混淆雇员福利（s.6，T4，可扣）与股东福利（s.15(1)，T4A，不可扣）
main.stem: Marco is the sole shareholder and president of a plumbing corporation. During 2026, the corporation paid $18,000 directly to a contractor to renovate the kitchen in Marco's personal residence and recorded the payment as a corporate repair expense. This benefit was not part of any employment compensation package offered to employees. How is this $18,000 treated for tax purposes?
main.zh: Marco 是一家水暖公司的唯一股东兼总裁。2026 年期间，公司直接向承包商支付了 $18,000 用于翻修 Marco 私人住宅的厨房，并在账上记为公司维修费用。这项好处不属于提供给雇员的任何薪酬方案。这 $18,000 在税务上应如何处理？

opts.t: It is a shareholder benefit under ITA s.15(1): the corporation cannot deduct the $18,000, and Marco must include $18,000 in his income, reported on a T4A slip under code 028.
opts.w: 正确。Marco 是以股东身份（因为公司是他的）而非雇员身份获得私人住宅装修，走股东福利（shareholder benefit, ITA s.15(1)）路径：由于该支出不是为赚取经营收入而发生（过不了 s.18(1)(a)），公司不得扣除这 $18,000，而 Marco 个人仍须全额计入收入，并报在 T4A 表的 code 028（其他收入）栏。

opts.t: It is a taxable employment benefit under ITA s.6(1)(a): the corporation can deduct the $18,000 as remuneration, and Marco reports it on a T4 slip subject to CPP and income tax withholdings.
opts.w: 错误。这是「同时是雇员和股东却一律按雇员报」的典型陷阱。如果 Marco 不是股东，公司根本不会替他装修私人厨房，因此事实判据属于股东福利（s.15(1)）而非受雇福利（taxable employment benefit, s.6(1)(a)），公司拿不到扣除。

opts.t: It is a shareholder loan benefit under ITA s.80.4: only the prescribed interest on the $18,000 is included in Marco's income and reported on a T4A slip under code 117.
opts.w: 错误。公司直接替股东支付私人装修并记入公司费用，属于直接授予股东福利（s.15(1)），本金 $18,000 全额计入收入并报 T4A code 028；只有股东贷款产生的推定利息福利（deemed interest benefit, s.80.4）才报 code 117。

opts.t: Because the corporation is denied the $18,000 deduction under ITA s.18(1)(a), Marco is not required to include the $18,000 in his personal income to avoid double taxation.
opts.w: 错误。公司能否扣除与个人是否计入收入是两道各自独立的闸；走上 s.15(1) 股东福利路径的后果正是公司不得扣除、个人照样全额计税，两级税负直接叠加，没有税收整合（integration）。

main.pt: 2026法定扣款上限与雇主配比成本
main.trap: 只看 EI 费率下调就断定保费减少或忽略雇主 1.4 倍
main.stem: A British Columbia software corporation hires a senior developer in 2026 at an annual salary of $92,000. Based on the 2026 federal statutory payroll parameters, what is the total employer portion of CPP, CPP2, and EI that the corporation must pay on top of the $92,000 gross salary?
main.zh: 一家卑诗省软件公司在 2026 年聘用了一位高级开发人员，年薪为 $92,000。根据 2026 年联邦法定薪资参数，公司在 $92,000 毛薪之外必须承担的 CPP、CPP2 和 EI 雇主部分总额是多少？

opts.t: $5,769.52, because the employer matches the employee's maximum deductions dollar-for-dollar across CPP, CPP2, and EI.
opts.w: 错误。$5,769.52 是雇员个人的三项最高扣款合计（$4,230.45 + $416 + $1,123.07）。雇主在 CPP 和 CPP2 上确实是 1:1 配比，但在就业保险（Employment Insurance, EI）上是雇员保费的 1.4 倍（$1,572.30），不能按 1:1 算。

opts.t: $6,218.75, consisting of $4,230.45 for CPP, $416.00 for CPP2, and $1,572.30 for EI (1.4 times the employee maximum).
$5,990.75, because the maximum CPP2 contribution is capped at the 2024 introductory limit of $188.00.
opts.w: 错误。这是把 2024 年 CPP2 刚上线时的第一年上限 $188 当成了 2026 年现行数字；2026 年 CPP2 第二层上限（YAMPE）为 $85,000，最高供款为 $416.00。

opts.t: $6,427.00, because the $3,500 basic exemption does not apply once an employee's salary exceeds the $85,000 YAMPE ceiling.
opts.w: 错误。CPP 的 $3,500 基本免税额（basic exemption）不会因为高薪而消失，第一层 CPP 始终按（$74,600 − $3,500）× 5.95% = $4,230.45 封顶。

main.pt: 公司车减免待命费的双重并列条件
main.trap: 减免待命费只看业务比例过半
main.stem: An employer purchased an automobile for $50,000 (including taxes) and made it available to a regional sales representative for all 365 days of 2026. The employer required her to use the car for work and paid all operating expenses. During 2026, she drove a total of 50,000 km, of which 29,000 km were for business (58%) and 21,000 km were for personal use. Does she qualify for the reduced standby charge and the optional operating expense calculation (one-half of the standby charge)?
main.zh: 一家雇主以 $50,000（含税）购买了一辆汽车，并在 2026 年全年 365 天提供给一位区域销售代表使用。雇主要求她为工作用车并支付了全部运营费用。2026 年期间，她共行驶 50,000 公里，其中业务行驶 29,000 公里（占 58%），个人使用 21,000 公里。她是否有资格享受减免待命费以及按待命费一半计算运营费用福利的选择性算法？

opts.t: She qualifies for both the reduced standby charge and the optional operating expense method, since business use was over half.
opts.w: 错误。这是「减免待命费只看业务占比」的经典陷阱。减免待命费（reduced standby charge, ITA s.6(2)）要求两个并列条件：业务用途过半，并且个人里程不超过每 30 天 1,667 公里（全年 20,004 公里）。她的个人里程为 21,000 公里，超过了 20,004 公里上限，因此拿不到减免待命费。

opts.t: She qualifies for neither the reduced standby charge nor the optional operating expense method, since personal driving topped 20,004 km.
opts.w: 错误。个人里程 21,000 公里超过 20,004 公里，确实使她失去减免待命费资格（待命费按全额 2% × $50,000 × 12 = $12,000）；但运营费用福利的选择性算法（optional calculation）只要求「有待命费且业务用途过半」，她业务占 58%，仍可用选择性算法。

opts.t: No reduced standby charge, since personal driving topped 20,004 km, but the optional half-of-standby method is still open.
opts.w: 正确。减免待命费（reduced standby charge）必须同时满足「业务用途过半」和「个人里程不超过 1,667 公里／30 天（全年 20,004 公里）」两个条件；她个人跑了 21,000 公里，减免资格消失，待命费按全额 2% × $50,000 × 12 = $12,000。运营费用福利（operating expense benefit）的选择性算法前提是「有待命费且业务用途过半」（她业务 29,000 ÷ 50,000 = 58%），没有 20,004 公里这一条，所以仍可用：$12,000 的一半 = $6,000，比固定费率法 21,000 × 34¢ = $7,140 低。

opts.t: She gets a reduced standby charge capped at 20,004/20,004, and no operating benefit arises because business driving exceeded 25,000 km.
opts.w: 错误。税法中没有「业务里程超过 25,000 公里免除运营费用福利」的规则；且分子 A 取 20,004 时，A/B = 20,004/20,004 = 1，实质上就是没有任何减免的全额待命费。

main.pt: 乘用车法定上限与里程津贴方向辨析
main.trap: 混淆里程津贴与运营费用福利
main.stem: In February 2026, an engineering firm in British Columbia buys a new non-zero-emission passenger vehicle for $52,000 (before tax) and also reimburses an arm's length engineer who drives her own personal car 6,000 km on firm business during 2026. Which statement accurately states the 2026 federal rules for these two situations?
main.zh: 2026 年 2 月，卑诗省一家工程公司以 $52,000（税前）新购入一辆非零排放乘用车，同时为一位在 2026 年开私家车为公司出差 6,000 公里的公平交易工程师发放里程补贴。哪项陈述准确说明了这两种情形在 2026 年的联邦规则？

opts.t: The Class 10.1 cap is $39,000 as announced (ITR text still reads $38,000); the allowance limit is 73¢ for 5,000 km, then 67¢.
opts.w: 正确。根据财政部 2026-01-14 新闻稿，2026 年新购 Class 10.1 乘用车 CCA 上限已宣布升至 $39,000（但《所得税条例》ITR s.7307(1) 截至 2026-06-21 的合订本文本仍写 $38,000，须并列说明）；同时雇员开私家车办公事的合理免税里程津贴（reasonable per-kilometre allowance）在各省为前 5,000 公里 73¢/km、其后 67¢/km。

opts.t: The Class 10.1 CCA ceiling is $61,000, and the engineer's reimbursement is capped at 34 cents per kilometre for all 6,000 km driven.
opts.w: 错误。$61,000 是 Class 54 零排放乘用车（zero-emission passenger vehicle）的 CCA 上限，不是普通乘用车上限；34¢/km 是雇员开公司车办私事的运营费用福利固定费率（operating expense benefit），不是雇员开私家车办公事的里程津贴。

opts.t: The Class 10.1 CCA ceiling is $39,000, and the provincial tax-free per-kilometre allowance is 77 cents for the first 5,000 km and 71 cents thereafter.
opts.w: 错误。77¢／71¢ 是 2026 年三个领地（territories）的免税里程津贴标准，卑诗省等各省（provinces）的标准是 73¢／67¢。

opts.t: The engineer must include 34 cents per kilometre in her T4 income for the 6,000 km driven, while the firm can deduct up to $1,100 per month in CCA.
opts.w: 错误。这是把方向彻底搞反了：工程师开自己的车替公司跑业务，公司按合理里程津贴付钱给她是免税的，不是她欠公司 34¢/km 的运营费用福利；且 $1,100／月是租入车的月租金扣除上限（leasing deduction limit），不是购车的 CCA 折旧额。

main.pt: 礼品500排除股东与奖金180天死线
main.trap: 股东亲属套用 $500 礼品免税
main.stem: Riverview Hardware Ltd. has a December 31, 2026 taxation year-end. In December 2026, it accrued a $50,000 bonus to its sole shareholder-employee, Chen, and paid the bonus on July 15, 2027. Also in December 2026, the company gave two non-cash holiday gift baskets worth $450 each—one to Chen and one to an arm's length store clerk who received no other gifts in 2026. What is the correct tax treatment?
main.zh: Riverview Hardware Ltd. 的税年结束日为 2026 年 12 月 31 日。2026 年 12 月，公司向其唯一股东兼雇员 Chen 计提了一笔 $50,000 的奖金，并于 2027 年 7 月 15 日实际支付。同样在 2026 年 12 月，公司送出两份各值 $450 的非现金节日礼篮——一份给 Chen，一份给 2026 年未收到其他礼品的公平交易店员。正确的税务处理是什么？

opts.t: The $50,000 bonus is deductible in 2026 because it was paid in 2027, and both $450 gift baskets are tax-free under the $500 non-cash gift policy.
opts.w: 错误。这里同时踩中两个陷阱：第一，年结日 2026-12-31 之后第 180 天是 2027 年 6 月 29 日，7 月 15 日支付已超过未付薪酬规则（unpaid remuneration rule, ITA s.78(4)）的 180 天死线，2026 年不得扣除；第二，CRA 的 $500 非现金礼品政策明文排除股东及亲属（non-arm's length exclusion），Chen 的 $450 礼篮必须全额计税。

opts.t: The bonus is deductible only in 2027, since it was paid after June 29, 2027; the clerk's gift is tax-free but Chen's is fully taxable.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.78(4) 未付薪酬规则（unpaid remuneration rule），2026-12-31 年结后第 180 天为 2027 年 6 月 29 日，7 月 15 日才付导致公司 2026 年扣除被取消，改到实际支付的 2027 年才能扣除；根据 CRA 礼品与奖励政策（gifts and awards policy），公平交易店员 $500 以内的非现金礼品免税，但股东及亲属被明文排除，Chen 的 $450 全额应税。

opts.t: The $50,000 bonus is deductible in 2026 because the deadline is six calendar months plus 30 days, while both $450 gift baskets are fully taxable.
opts.w: 错误。ITA s.78(4) 的死线是精确的「税年结束后第 180 天」（对 12 月 31 日年结而言是次年 6 月 29 日），不是 6 个月加 30 天；此外公平交易店员收到的 $450 非现金礼篮在 $500 额度内免税。

opts.t: The $50,000 bonus is non-deductible in both 2026 and 2027 once the 180-day deadline is missed, and Chen's $450 gift is tax-free up to $500.
opts.w: 错误。错过 180 天死线的后果是计提年度（2026）不得扣除，改为在实际支付的那一年（2027）扣除，并非永久不得扣除；且股东 Chen 不适用 $500 免税额。

main.pt: 源头扣缴汇款四档与迟缴未扣罚则
main.trap: 忽略联营公司合并 AMWA 或销售税迟报导致季度汇款资格丢失
main.stem: Company X had an average monthly withholding amount (AMWA) of $2,400 two calendar years ago and $2,600 last year. It has paid all payroll deductions on time for the past 12 months, but it filed its quarterly GST/HST return three weeks late four months ago. Separately, Company Y is associated with Company Z; two calendar years ago, Company Y had an AMWA of $4,000 and Company Z had an AMWA of $23,000. Which statement correctly identifies their remitter categories?
main.zh: X 公司两个日历年前的月均预扣额（AMWA）为 $2,400，去年为 $2,600。过去 12 个月它按时缴纳了所有薪资扣款，但四个月前它的季度 GST/HST 申报迟交了三周。另外，Y 公司与 Z 公司联营；两个日历年前，Y 公司的 AMWA 为 $4,000，Z 公司的 AMWA 为 $23,000。哪项陈述正确认定了它们的汇款人档次？

opts.t: Company X qualifies as a quarterly remitter because all its payroll remittances were on time, and Company Y is a regular remitter because its own AMWA is under $25,000.
opts.w: 错误。两边都踩了坑：第一，季度汇款人（quarterly remitter）要求的完美合规记录（perfect compliance history）涵盖过去 12 个月的薪资扣缴、GST/HST 缴纳以及 T4 和 GST/HST 按时申报，GST/HST 迟报一次即丧失按季汇款资格；第二，联营公司（associated corporations）的 AMWA 必须合并计算（$4,000 + $23,000 = $27,000 ≥ $25,000），Y 和 Z 都变成加速汇款人。

opts.t: If Company X remits a $5,000 payroll deduction five days late for the first time, it faces a flat 10% failure-to-deduct penalty of $500 on the whole amount.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了未扣缴罚（failure to deduct penalty，一律 10%）与迟缴罚（late remittance penalty，阶梯罚：1–3 天 3%、4–5 天 5%、6–7 天 7%、超过 7 天 10%）。迟缴 5 天适用 5% 的阶梯罚率，而非 10%。

opts.t: Company X is a quarterly remitter, while Company Y and Company Z are Threshold 2 accelerated remitters who must remit four times a month through a financial institution.
opts.w: 错误。X 公司因 GST/HST 迟报已失去季度资格；而 Y 与 Z 合并后的 AMWA 为 $27,000，属于加速门槛一（$25,000–$99,999.99，每月两次），达到 $100,000 及以上才是加速门槛二（Threshold 2）。

opts.t: X loses quarterly status because its late GST/HST filing breaks the perfect compliance history; Y and Z, with combined AMWA of $27,000, are Threshold 1 remitters.
opts.w: 正确。季度汇款人除了要求前一年或前两年 AMWA 低于 $3,000 外，还要求过去 12 个月具备完美合规记录（包括薪资扣缴、GST/HST 缴纳以及 T4 与销售税按时申报），X 公司迟报 GST/HST 导致失去季度资格，只能按普通汇款人（次月 15 日）缴；同时联营公司的两年前 AMWA 必须合并计算，Y 与 Z 合计 $27,000 落入 $25,000–$99,999.99 区间，因此组内所有公司（含仅 $4,000 的 Y 公司）均成为加速门槛一（Threshold 1 accelerated remitter）汇款人。

main.pt: BC雇主健康税缺口费率与联营共享
main.trap: 联营公司拆薪资躲避加速汇款或 BC 雇主健康税
main.stem: Westcoast Design Ltd. is a regular (non-charitable) employer in British Columbia with no associated corporations. For the 2026 calendar year, its total BC remuneration is $1,300,000. What is its 2026 BC Employer Health Tax (EHT), and how would the EHT change if its sole shareholder also controlled a second BC corporation with $400,000 of 2026 BC remuneration?
main.zh: Westcoast Design Ltd. 是卑诗省的一家一般（非慈善）雇主，没有联营公司。2026 日历年其 BC 薪酬总额为 $1,300,000。它 2026 年的 BC 雇主健康税（EHT）是多少？如果其唯一股东同时控制另一家 2026 年 BC 薪酬为 $400,000 的 BC 公司，EHT 会如何变化？

opts.t: Standalone EHT is $5,850 (1.95% × $300,000); if associated, the second corporation still pays $0 because its own $400,000 payroll is under the $1,000,000 exemption.
opts.w: 错误。第一，薪酬在 $1,000,000.01 至 $1,500,000 之间适用 5.85% 的缺口费率（notch rate），不是 1.95%；第二，联营雇主（associated employers）必须共享 $1,000,000 免税额，且合计薪酬一旦超过 $1,500,000，全组都没有免税额。

opts.t: Standalone EHT is $25,350 (1.95% × $1,300,000); if associated, the two corporations simply share one $1,000,000 exemption between them and pay 5.85% on the rest.
Standalone EHT is $17,550 (5.85% × $300,000); if associated, combined payroll of $1,700,000 removes the exemption, so each pays 1.95% on its full payroll.
opts.w: 正确。单家公司 BC 薪酬 $1,300,000 落在 $1,000,000.01–$1,500,000 区间，按缺口费率（notch rate）计算：5.85% × ($1,300,000 − $1,000,000) = $17,550；当与第二家公司联营时，联营组合计薪酬为 $1,300,000 + $400,000 = $1,700,000，超过 $1,500,000 门槛，根据 BC 雇主健康税（Employer Health Tax, EHT）规则，联营组全组都没有免税额，各自按全额薪酬的 1.95% 缴税。

opts.t: Standalone EHT is $17,550; if associated, the $1,000,000 exemption is still kept and split between them because neither corporation alone exceeded $1,500,000.
opts.w: 错误。这是「拆公司发薪避税」的常见误区：BC EHT 规定联营组合计薪酬超过 $1,500,000 的，全组都没有免税额，看的是联营组合计数而非单家公司是否超 $1,500,000。

main.pt: 非营利组织四要件与禁开收据
main.trap: 零税免报 T2 陷阱
main.stem: A newly formed neighbourhood heritage society is incorporated as a non-share-capital corporation and operates exclusively for civic improvement under ITA s.149(1)(l). It is not a registered charity. A local business owner offers a donation and asks for an official tax receipt, while the society's treasurer believes the society never needs to register with the CRA or file any tax return because it owes no tax. Which statement is correct?
main.zh: 一家新成立的社区历史文化社团注册为无股本非营利公司，并按 ITA s.149(1)(l) 专为公民改善目的运营，不属于注册慈善机构。一位本地企业主表示愿意捐款并索要正式抵税收据，而社团财务主管认为社团既然不欠税，就既不需要向 CRA 注册，也永远不用交任何申报表。下列哪项说法正确？

opts.t: The society does not need to register to be tax-exempt under s.149(1)(l), cannot issue official donation receipts, and must still file a T2 return every tax year as a corporation
opts.w: 非营利组织（non-profit organization, NPO）在 s.149(1)(l) 下无需向联邦或省级注册即可享受免税，但不能就捐款或会费开具税务抵扣收据；同时，作为居民公司，即使应纳税额为零，每个税年仍必须提交 T2 公司所得税申报表（T2 return）。

opts.t: The society must first apply to the CRA for non-profit registration before its income becomes exempt, after which it may issue official donation receipts
opts.w: 这混淆了非营利组织与注册慈善机构（registered charity）：只有按 s.149(1)(f) 免税的注册慈善机构才需要向 CRA 申请注册并获得开具捐赠收据的权力。

opts.t: The society cannot issue official donation receipts, and like a registered charity it is completely exempt from filing a T2 return as long as it has zero tax payable
opts.w: 这掉进了「零税免报 T2 陷阱」：全年都是注册慈善机构的公司确实免报 T2，但作为公司的非营利组织并不在 T2 免报例外名单中，哪怕零税也必须每年报 T2 或 T2 简表（T2 Short Return）。

opts.t: Once the society's articles state a non-profit purpose, its tax-exempt status is permanently guaranteed and it may issue receipts for membership dues
opts.w: s.149(1)(l) 看的是「组织并运营」（exclusively organized and operated）两个动词，是逐年的事实判断而非永久保证，且非营利组织对捐款和会费均不能开具税务抵扣收据。

main.pt: T1044 四项被动收入门槛
main.trap: T1044 收入混算与当期资产陷阱
main.stem: An incorporated community sports association exempt under ITA s.149(1)(l) has never previously been required to file Form T1044. Its total assets had a GAAP book value of $150,000 at the end of the prior fiscal period and $198,000 at the end of the current fiscal period. During the current fiscal period, it received $610,000 in membership dues and government grants, $7,000 in rental income, and $3,500 in bank interest. Must it file Form T1044 for the current fiscal period?
main.zh: 一家按 ITA s.149(1)(l) 免税的社区体育协会公司此前从未触发过 T1044 申报义务。其上一会计期末按 GAAP 计算的总资产账面价值为 $150,000，本会计期末为 $198,000。在本会计期内，该协会收到会费与政府拨款共 $610,000、租金收入 $7,000 以及银行利息 $3,500。它本会计期是否必须申报 T1044？

opts.t: No, because neither its rental income ($7,000) nor its interest income ($3,500) individually exceeds the $10,000 threshold
opts.w: s.149(12) 的被动收入门槛看的是应税股息、利息、租金、特许权使用费四项的「合计」（total），而不是单看某一项是否超过 $10,000。

opts.t: Yes, because its combined rental income ($7,000) and interest income ($3,500) exceed the $10,000 passive income threshold
opts.w: 在判定非营利组织信息申报表（Form T1044）的条件一时，应将本期收到或应收的应税股息、利息、租金、特许权使用费四项加总（会费与拨款不计入）；本例中租金 $7,000 加利息 $3,500 合计已超过 $10,000 门槛，因此必须在会计期结束后 6 个月内申报 T1044。

opts.t: Yes, but only because its membership dues and grants of $610,000 push total revenue over $200,000
opts.w: 这掉进了「T1044 收入混算陷阱」：会费、募捐、政府拨款和活动收入根本不计入 s.149(12) 的 $10,000 被动收入测试，且 $200,000 是上一期末总资产门槛而非收入门槛。

opts.t: No, because its prior-period total assets of $150,000 and current-period assets of $198,000 are both below $200,000
opts.w: s.149(12) 的三条触发条件是「或」而不是「且」；即便资产未超 $200,000，只要四项被动收入合计超过 $10,000，就必须提交 Form T1044。

main.pt: T1044 上期末资产与棘轮规则
main.trap: 棘轮可逆陷阱
main.stem: A residential condominium corporation had $480,000 in total assets at the end of 2025 and earned $14,200 in interest in 2025, properly filing Form T1044 for 2025. After major roof repairs in 2026, its total assets fell to $150,000 at the end of 2026, and its interest income dropped to $3,000 in both 2026 and 2027, with assets remaining at $150,000. What is its Form T1044 filing obligation for 2026 and 2027?
main.zh: 一家住宅共管公寓管理公司在 2025 年末拥有总资产 $480,000，2025 年利息收入为 $14,200，并已按规提交了 2025 年的 T1044。2026 年因大修屋顶，其 2026 年末总资产降至 $150,000，且 2026 年与 2027 年的利息收入均降至 $3,000，资产维持在 $150,000。它在 2026 年和 2027 年的 T1044 申报义务是什么？

opts.t: It does not need to file Form T1044 for either 2026 or 2027 because both its assets and passive income fell below the thresholds starting in 2026
opts.w: 这同时违背了条件二（2026 年看的是 2025 年末资产 $480,000）与条件三棘轮规则（ratchet rule，报过一次就永久要报）。

opts.t: It must file Form T1044 for 2026 because 2025 year-end assets exceeded $200,000, but it may stop filing in 2027 once 2026 year-end assets are $150,000
opts.w: 这掉进了「棘轮可逆陷阱」：虽然 2026 年末资产降到了 $150,000，但条件三规定只要以前任何一个会计期曾有申报义务，2027 年及以后每年仍必须继续报。

opts.t: It must file Form T1044 for both 2026 and 2027 (and every future fiscal period as long as it remains an NPO) because of the prior-period asset test and the ratchet rule
opts.w: 根据 s.149(12)，2026 年不仅上一期末（2025 年末）资产 $480,000 超过 $200,000，而且 2025 年已经报过非营利组织信息申报表（Form T1044）；根据只进不出的棘轮规则（ratchet rule），2026 年、2027 年及此后每一个会计期都必须继续申报，不论金额降到多少。

opts.t: It is exempt from Form T1044 in all years because residential condominium corporations are excluded under s.149(1)(i)
opts.w: 多数住宅共管公寓管理公司（condominium corporation）落入 s.149(1)(l) 并受 s.149(12) 管辖；s.149(1)(i) 免报例外仅针对专为向长者提供低成本住房而运营的公司。

main.pt: 会所视同信托与三表分工
main.trap: 会所全部免税或全部课税陷阱
main.stem: An incorporated golf and dining club exempt under ITA s.149(1)(l) has the main purpose of providing dining and sporting facilities to its members. In 2026, it collected $2,100,000 in membership dues, $340,000 in dining revenue, and $58,000 in interest and dividends from an investment account, and it realized a $600,000 capital gain from selling a parcel of idle land that was never used for the golf course or restaurant. How is the club taxed and which return(s) must it file for 2026?
main.zh: 一家按 ITA s.149(1)(l) 免税的高尔夫与餐饮俱乐部公司，主要目的是为会员提供餐饮与体育设施。2026 年该会收取会费 $2,100,000、餐饮收入 $340,000，投资账户产生利息与股息合计 $58,000，并因出售一块从未用于球场或餐厅的闲置土地实现资本利得 $600,000。该俱乐部在 2026 年应如何课税并提交哪些申报表？

opts.t: All of its revenue and capital gains are completely exempt under s.149(1)(l), so the club only needs to file a nil T2 return together with Form T1044 for the year
opts.w: 这掉进了「会所全部免税陷阱」：主要目的为提供餐饮、娱乐或体育设施的俱乐部会触发 s.149(5) 视同生前信托（deemed inter vivos trust），投资收益与闲置土地资本利得必须报 T3 纳税。

opts.t: Because s.149(5) applies, the club loses its s.149(1)(l) status entirely and must report the $2,100,000 dues, $340,000 dining revenue, $58,000 investment income, and $600,000 gain on its T2 return
opts.w: 这掉进了「会所全部课税陷阱」：s.149(5) 并未取消会费与餐饮收入在 s.149(1)(l) 下的免税待遇，而是将财产视同由生前信托持有、仅就财产收入及非服务用财产的资本利得在 T3 上课税。

opts.t: Dues and dining revenue stay exempt; the $58,000 property income and the gain on the idle land are taxed in a deemed trust on a T3; it files T2, T1044 and T3
opts.w: 根据 s.149(5)，主要目的为会员提供餐饮、娱乐或体育设施的会所，其财产视同由生前信托（deemed inter vivos trust）持有：会费与餐饮收入继续免税，但 $58,000 财产收入及未用于提供该类服务的闲置土地应税资本利得须报 T3 课税；同时因其是公司且被动收入超 $10,000，一年须交齐 T2、T1044 与 T3 三份表。

opts.t: Only the $58,000 of interest and dividend income is taxed on a T3 return, because every capital gain on real estate owned by an NPO club remains fully exempt
opts.w: s.149(5) 明确规定，处置未用于提供餐饮、娱乐或体育设施的财产所产生的应税资本利得同样落在视同生前信托中课税。

main.pt: T1044 与 T2 迟报罚及补救顺序
main.trap: 零税免报 T2 陷阱
main.stem: An incorporated non-profit organization that validly qualifies for tax exemption under ITA s.149(1)(l) and has $0 tax payable discovers that both its T2 return and its Form T1044 are overdue due to circumstances beyond its control. How are the late-filing penalties calculated for the two forms, and what should the organization do first regarding Form T1044?
main.zh: 一家符合 ITA s.149(1)(l) 免税条件且应纳税额为 $0 的非营利公司发现，由于不可控原因，其 T2 申报表和 T1044 均已逾期。这两份表的迟报罚款分别如何计算？针对 T1044，该组织首先应该怎么做？

opts.t: Both the T2 and the T1044 are penalized at $25 per day up to $2,500 each, so the organization should wait for CRA approval of a relief request before filing either form
opts.w: T2 并非按每日 $25 计罚，且对于按天计罚的 Form T1044，绝不能先等 CRA 答复再交表，否则等待期间罚款会继续按天累积到 $2,500 上限。

opts.t: Both the T2 and the T1044 penalties are based on unpaid tax at the filing deadline (5% plus 1% per month), so the organization owes a $0 penalty on both forms
opts.w: 只有 T2 的 s.162(1) 迟报罚以期限时未付税款为基数；Form T1044 的迟报罚是按每日 $25 计算的定额罚，与是否欠税无关。

opts.t: The T2 penalty is 10% plus 2% per month of total assets, while the T1044 penalty is a flat $100 no matter how many days late it is filed, so filing order does not matter
opts.w: 10% 加每整月 2%（最多 20 个月）是 s.162(2) 下 T2 重犯时针对「未付税款」的比例，不是按总资产计算；且 $100 只是 T1044 迟报罚的最低下限而非固定金额。

opts.t: The T2 penalty is $0, being based on unpaid tax; the T1044 penalty is $25 a day ($100 to $2,500), so file the T1044 now and attach a relief request
opts.w: T2 迟报按 s.162(1) 以期限时未付的税为基数（5%＋每整月 1%，最多 12 个月），真正零税的免税公司算出来是 $0（但若日后被追溯否定免税身份则会从原始期限起算）；而 Form T1044 按每日 $25 基本罚（basic penalty $25 per day，最低 $100、最高 $2,500）计罚，正确实务是先把表交上去止住计天，同时随表附信援引纳税人纾困条款（taxpayer relief provisions）申请豁免。

main.pt: BC 非营利雇主健康税与合格地点
main.trap: BC 雇主健康税单限额与共享场地陷阱
main.stem: A social services organization exempt under ITA s.149(1)(l) has a total 2026 BC calendar-year payroll of $2,600,000, split evenly ($1,300,000 each) between two separate office buildings—one in Richmond and one in Vancouver—that it leases and uses exclusively. What is its 2026 BC Employer Health Tax (EHT) payable, and what would the tax be if both divisions were instead on different floors of the same building?
main.zh: 一家按 ITA s.149(1)(l) 免税的社区服务机构，2026 日历年的 BC 薪酬总额为 $2,600,000，平均分布在列治文和温哥华两处各自独立租用且排他使用的办公楼（每处薪酬各 $1,300,000）。它 2026 年应缴的 BC 雇主健康税（EHT）是多少？如果这两个部门改为设在同一栋楼的不同楼层，应缴税额又会是多少？

opts.t: $0 when operating in two separate qualifying locations ($1,500,000 exemption per location), and $32,175 when operating in the same building (2.925% × ($2,600,000 − $1,500,000))
opts.w: 在 BC 雇主健康税（Employer Health Tax, EHT）下，非营利雇主的每个排他使用的合格地点（qualifying location）各享一份 $1,500,000 免税额，两处独立办公楼各发薪 $1,300,000 均未超限，应缴为 $0；若同一法人的两个内部部门在同一栋楼的不同楼层，则合算为一个合格地点，仅享一份 $1,500,000 免税额，落在 $1,500,000.01–$4,500,000 缺口区间（notch rate amount），按 2.925% ×（$2,600,000 − $1,500,000）＝ $32,175 计税。

opts.t: $50,700 in both cases, calculated at the 1.95% rate on the full $2,600,000 payroll because total payroll exceeds $1,500,000
opts.w: $50,700（1.95% × $2,600,000）是一般雇主超过 $1,500,000 时的算法；非营利雇主不仅按每个合格地点各享 $1,500,000 免税额，而且单地点要超过 $4,500,000 才按全额计税。

opts.t: $32,175 in both cases, because a single legal entity can claim only one $1,500,000 EHT exemption across British Columbia regardless of how many locations it operates
opts.w: 这掉进了「BC 雇主健康税单限额陷阱」：与联邦所得税一个纳税人一份限额不同，BC 非营利雇主在省内有多个排他使用的合格地点时，每个合格地点各享一份 $1,500,000 免税额。

opts.t: $0 in both cases, because each floor of an office building counts as a separate qualifying location as long as it has its own department manager
opts.w: 根据 BC 省财政厅口径，同一法人在同一栋楼里的各个内部部门只算一个合格地点（qualifying location），只能合用一份 $1,500,000 免税额。

main.pt: 年度身份四问与账面价值口径
main.trap: T1044 收入混算与当期资产陷阱
main.stem: At the end of its fiscal period, a non-profit association is performing its annual four-step compliance review to check its ITA s.149(1)(l) status and Form T1044 requirement. When testing the $200,000 asset threshold and the $10,000 passive income threshold under s.149(12), which accounting bases must it use?
main.zh: 在会计期结束时，一家非营利协会正在进行年度四步合规自检，以核实其 ITA s.149(1)(l) 身份及 T1044 申报义务。在测试 s.149(12) 下的 $200,000 资产门槛与 $10,000 被动收入门槛时，该协会必须采用什么会计计量口径？

opts.t: Current fiscal period-end fair market value for total assets, and only the cash actually received during the period for the passive income items
opts.w: 两项口径均错误：资产门槛看的是「上一会计期末」按公认会计原则计算的「账面价值」（而非本期公允价值），被动收入包含「收到或应收」（而非仅实收现金）。

opts.t: Prior period-end GAAP book value for total assets, and amounts received or receivable in the current period for the four passive income items
opts.w: 根据 s.149(12) 及 T4117 指南，资产门槛看的是上一会计期末按公认会计原则确定的账面价值（book value under GAAP）是否超过 $200,000；被动收入门槛看的是本会计期内收到或应收（received or receivable，即权责发生制应收也算）的应税股息、利息、租金、特许权使用费四项合计是否超过 $10,000。

opts.t: Prior fiscal period-end appraised replacement value for real estate only, and gross revenue from all sources including membership fees and grants
opts.w: 资产看的是全部总资产的 GAAP 账面价值而非仅不动产评估重置价值，且会费等非被动收入不计入 $10,000 门槛。

opts.t: Average monthly asset balances during the current period, and net investment income after deducting all management and custody expenses
opts.w: 法条看的是上一会计期末时点的总资产账面价值以及本期收到或应收的四项被动收入总额，不采用月均余额或扣减管理费后的净额。

main.pt: 税会调整与应税收入综合计算
main.trap: 俱乐部会费误按餐饮娱乐扣 50%
main.stem: An engineering firm with a December 31, 2026 year-end reports net profit after tax of $180,000 on its financial statements (GIFI code 9999). In arriving at that profit, the bookkeeper deducted all of the following expenses: book depreciation of $42,000; client meals and entertainment of $16,000; annual golf club membership dues for a director of $9,500; an increase in the accounting allowance for doubtful accounts of $8,000; charitable donations to registered charities of $5,000; and book income tax expense of $38,000. Schedule 8 capital cost allowance (CCA) for the year is $55,000. What are the firm's net income for tax purposes (Schedule 1 result) and taxable income for 2026?
main.zh: 一家年结日为 2026 年 12 月 31 日的工程公司，其财务报表上的税后净利润（GIFI 代码 9999）为 $180,000。在计算该账面利润时，记账员已经扣除了以下全部项目：账面折旧 $42,000；客户餐饮与娱乐费 $16,000；一位董事的高尔夫俱乐部年费 $9,500；会计坏账准备增加额 $8,000；向注册慈善机构的慈善捐赠 $5,000；以及账面所得税费用 $38,000。当年按 Schedule 8 算出的资本成本折让（CCA）为 $55,000。该公司 2026 年的税务净收入（Schedule 1 结果）和应税收入分别是多少？

opts.t: Net income for tax purposes of $230,500 and taxable income of $225,500.
opts.w: 落入「慈善捐赠在 Schedule 1 漏加回」陷阱：算税务净收入（net income for tax purposes）时忘记把账上已扣的 $5,000 慈善捐赠加回（少加回 $5,000 得出 $230,500），随后在算应税收入（taxable income）时又扣了一次 $5,000 得出 $225,500，等于把同一笔捐赠扣了两次。

opts.t: Net income for tax purposes of $235,500 and taxable income of $230,500.
opts.w: 正确。从 Schedule 1 金额 A（$180,000）出发，加回账面折旧 $42,000（s.18(1)(b)）、餐饮娱乐费的一半 $8,000（s.67.1）、高尔夫俱乐部会费全额 $9,500（s.18(1)(l)）、坏账准备增加额 $8,000（s.18(1)(e)）、慈善捐赠 $5,000 及账面所得税费用 $38,000（加项合计 $110,500），再减去 Schedule 8 资本成本折让（capital cost allowance, CCA）$55,000，得出税务净收入（net income for tax purposes）＝ $180,000 ＋ $110,500 − $55,000 ＝ $235,500；最后在 T2 主表从税务净收入中扣除慈善捐赠 $5,000，得到应税收入（taxable income）$230,500。

opts.t: Net income for tax purposes of $230,750 and taxable income of $225,750.
opts.w: 落入「俱乐部会费误按餐饮娱乐扣 50%」陷阱：把 $9,500 的高尔夫俱乐部会费只加回了一半（少加回 $4,750），忽略了 s.18(1)(l) 下高尔夫与康乐俱乐部会费是 100% 完全不扣。

opts.t: Net income for tax purposes of $197,500 and taxable income of $192,500.
opts.w: 漏加回了账面所得税费用 $38,000（$235,500 − $38,000 ＝ $197,500）：由于 GIFI 代码 9999 是计入所得税后的净利润，公司所得税本身在税法上不可扣除，必须在 Schedule 1 上全额加回。

main.pt: GIFI 校验必填代码、粒度与简表条件
main.trap: GIFI 必填代码留空、只报小计或零活动不报
main.stem: Which of the following statements accurately describes the General Index of Financial Information (GIFI) rules for a 2026 corporate tax return?
main.zh: 下列哪项陈述准确描述了 2026 税年公司所得税申报表中关于财务信息通用索引（GIFI）的规则？

opts.t: With 40 line items it must report 40 GIFI codes, not subtotals, and enter 0 for any nil validity check item such as 2599 or 9999.
opts.w: 正确。财务信息通用索引（General Index of Financial Information, GIFI）严禁只报小计与合计（财报上有 40 项就要有 40 个代码），且所有校验必填项（validity check items：2599 总资产、3499 总负债、3620 股东权益或 3575 合伙人资本、8299 总收入、9368 总费用、9999 净利润，有农业活动时另加 9659/9898）即使金额为零也必须填 0，否则无法通过电子校验。

opts.t: A corporation filing with GIFI must still attach its traditional financial statements unless it is an insurer involved in underwriting.
opts.w: 把一般规则和唯一例外彻底说反了：使用 GIFI 时不再随申报表提交传统财务报表，只有从事承保业务的保险公司（人寿、存款、财产与意外）因 GIFI 无保险业专用项目才仍须附交传统财报（例外颠倒陷阱）。

opts.t: A corporation using tax software may file the paper GIFI-Short (T1178) if either its gross revenue or its total assets is under $1,000,000.
opts.w: 错在两个条件：第一，纸质简表 T1178（GIFI-Short）只适用于「不使用软件」的公司；第二，必须总收入与总资产「各自」低于一百万（$1,000,000），而不是二选一（简表门槛混淆陷阱）。

opts.t: Items with no exact GIFI match go into the block's total code, and validity check codes with a nil balance may be left blank.
opts.w: 落入「GIFI 必填代码留空、只报小计」陷阱：找不到完全匹配的科目时，应使用该区块开头的通用项（generic item，代表同类兜底而非合计），且必填代码为零时必须填 0 而不能留空。

main.pt: 餐饮娱乐扣除比例与俱乐部会费辨析
main.trap: 俱乐部会费误按餐饮娱乐扣 50%
main.stem: Under the Income Tax Act rules governing Schedule 1 adjustments in 2026, how do the deductibility limits compare across: (1) regular client meals and entertainment, (2) meals of a long-haul truck driver during an eligible travel period, (3) qualifying meals provided at a temporary work site camp, and (4) membership dues at a recreational or dining club?
main.zh: 根据 2026 税年规管 Schedule 1 调整的《所得税法》规则，以下四项支出的可扣除比例分别是多少：（1）普通客户餐饮与娱乐费、（2）长途货运司机在合格出差期间的餐费、（3）在符合条件的临时工地营地提供的餐食、（4）康乐或餐饮俱乐部的会员年费？

opts.t: 50% for regular meals; 80% for long-haul truck driver meals; 50% for work site camp meals; 50% for club membership dues.
opts.w: 错在后两项：符合条件的临时工地营地餐食可 100% 全额扣除，而康乐或餐饮俱乐部会费在 s.18(1)(l) 下是 0% 可扣（100% 加回）（俱乐部会费误按餐饮娱乐扣 50% 陷阱）。

opts.t: 50% for regular meals; 100% for long-haul truck driver meals; 80% for work site camp meals; 0% for club membership dues.
opts.w: 把长途货运司机合格出差餐费（80% 可扣）与临时工地营地餐食（100% 可扣）的比例颠倒了（特例比例互换陷阱）。

opts.t: 50% for regular meals; 80% for long-haul truck driver meals; 100% for work site camp meals; 0% for club membership dues.
opts.w: 正确。根据 s.67.1(1)，普通餐饮与娱乐费（meals and entertainment）按实际支出与合理金额取小者的 50% 扣除（加回 50%）；长途货运司机在合格出差期间的餐费按 80% 扣除（加回 20%）；符合条件的临时工地营地餐食可 100% 全额扣除（无需加回）；而以提供餐饮、康乐或体育设施为主要目的的俱乐部会费（club dues，含入会费）在 s.18(1)(l) 下完全不扣（0% 可扣，100% 加回）。

opts.t: 0% for regular meals; 50% for long-haul truck driver meals; 80% for work site camp meals; 0% for club membership dues.
opts.w: 全盘压低了法定可扣比例：普通合理餐饮娱乐费可扣 50% 而非 0%，长途货运司机出差餐费可扣 80%，临时工地营地餐食可扣 100%（比例整体错位陷阱）。

main.pt: RIIP 与即时费用化退坡及乘用车上限
main.trap: 误用已取消的三分之二资本利得纳入率或旧版 AII 日期
main.stem: In March 2026, a manufacturing corporation purchases and places into use a new piece of manufacturing and processing machinery (Class 53, or assessed under Class 43 after 2025 where it would have been Class 53 if acquired in 2025) for $200,000. Under the current 2026 rules in the T2 Guide, how much first-year capital cost allowance (CCA) can the corporation claim on this machine, and when does the phase-out begin for this category?
main.zh: 2026 年 3 月，一家制造公司花 $200,000 购置并投入使用一台全新的货物制造加工机器（53 类，或 2025 年之后取得按 43 类判、若在 2025 年取得会归入 53 类的）。根据 2026 税年现行 T2 指南规则，该公司在第一年可以就这台机器申报多少资本成本折让（CCA）？该类别的退坡从什么时候开始？

opts.t: It cannot claim immediate expensing because the 2018 Accelerated Investment Incentive (AII) 50% net addition ended before 2024 and completely phases out before 2028.
opts.w: 落入「误用旧版 AII 日期」陷阱：考试旧口径里的 2018 版加速投资激励（AII，50% 加成至 2024 年前、2028 年前可用）在 2026 税年已全部作废，现行规则已恢复并更新为再加速投资激励财产（RIIP）及即时费用化参数。

opts.t: It can claim 100% immediate expensing of $200,000 in 2026, and the phase-out for this manufacturing and processing machinery category only begins for property that becomes available for use after 2029.
opts.w: 正确。按 2026 税年现行 T2 指南规则（与旧版 AII 考试口径不同），2026 年取得并投入使用的制造与加工机器设备（53 类，或 2025 年后取得按 43 类判、若在 2025 年取得会归 53 类的）适用即时费用化（immediate expensing），首年可 100% 扣除全部 $200,000，且该类别（以及 43.1 类清洁能源设备）的退坡要到 2029 年之后可用的财产才开始。

opts.t: It can claim 100% immediate expensing of $200,000 in 2026, but the 100% deduction for manufacturing machinery expires for property becoming available for use after 2026 (before 2027).
opts.w: 混淆了不同资产类别的退坡时间表：「2027 年前可用享受 100%、2026 年之后可用只剩半年规则豁免」是生产力资产（44、46、50 类）的截止期，而不是制造加工机器（53 类）与清洁能源设备（43.1 类）的 2029 年后退坡期（类别退坡年份混淆陷阱）。

opts.t: It is limited by the half-year rule under Regulation 1100(2) because reaccelerated investment incentive property (RIIP) only applies to property acquired after 2030.
opts.w: 记错了现行再加速投资激励财产（reaccelerated investment incentive property, RIIP）的时间窗：RIIP 适用于 2024 年之后取得、2034 年前可用的合格财产（其中 50% 净增加成在 2030 年前可用），并非 2030 年后才适用（RIIP 年份记反陷阱）。

main.pt: 资本利得二分之一纳入率与特殊纳入率
main.trap: 误用已取消的三分之二资本利得纳入率或旧版 AII 日期
main.stem: For a corporation completing Schedule 6 and Schedule 1 for the 2026 tax year, how are capital gains included in net income for tax purposes under current rules?
main.zh: 对于正在编制 2026 税年 Schedule 6 与 Schedule 1 的公司，按现行规则，资本利得应当如何计入税务净收入？

opts.t: Two-thirds (2/3) of the capital gain on Schedule 6 is entered on Schedule 1 line 113 because the proposed increase took effect on January 1, 2026.
opts.w: 落入「误用已取消的三分之二资本利得纳入率」陷阱：将资本利得纳入率从 1/2 提高到 2/3 的提案在推迟生效日到 2026-01-01 后已被正式宣布取消，2026 税年任何按 2/3 编写的考试口径或模板均已过期。

opts.t: One-half of a regular gain goes to Amount R and line 113; eligible gifts of listed securities generally get 0%, and some s.100(1) dispositions 100%.
opts.w: 正确。现行 T2 指南明确规定，Schedule 6（资本财产处置汇总）上的金额 P 若为利得，仍按二分之一（P × 1/2）填入金额 R 与 Schedule 1 第 113 行（2/3 提案已取消）；同时保留特殊纳入率：向合格受赠人捐赠特定证券或环境敏感土地一般适用零纳入率（0%），而在 s.100(1) 下处置资产全部为存货、可折旧财产或资源财产的合伙企业权益时，可按 100% 纳入。

opts.t: One-half (1/2) of the capital gain is deducted on Schedule 1 line 401, while the full accounting gain on disposal remains inside GIFI code 9999 without adjustment.
opts.w: 搞混了会计处置利得与税法应税资本利得的两步替代关系：账上记了的资产处置收益属于「账上记了而税上不计」的减项，应先在 Schedule 1 减去账面处置利得，再把 Schedule 6 算出的应税资本利得（P × 1/2）加回到 Schedule 1 第 113 行（税会处置损益替代关系陷阱）。

opts.t: Dispositions of partnership interests under s.100(1) where all partnership assets are inventory or depreciable property qualify for a 0% inclusion rate on Schedule 6.
opts.w: 把 0% 纳入率和 100% 纳入率的对象彻底搞反了：0% 纳入率适用于向合格受赠人捐赠特定证券或环境敏感土地；而在 s.100(1) 下处置资产全部是存货、可折旧财产或资源财产的合伙企业权益时，整笔按 100% 纳入（特殊纳入率颠倒陷阱）。

main.pt: 附表6、13、73与表1衔接规则
main.trap: 附表回填错位：账面准备进表 13、合伙利得进第 129 行
main.stem: A corporation is a member of a partnership and also records an accounting warranty reserve on its financial statements. During the 2026 tax year, the partnership allocates a share of taxable capital gains to the corporation. Where must the partnership's allocated taxable capital gains and the corporation's accounting warranty reserve be reported on the T2 return?
main.zh: 一家公司是某合伙企业的成员，同时在其财务报表上记录了一笔会计保修准备金。在 2026 税年，该合伙企业向该公司分配了应税资本利得份额。合伙企业分来的应税资本利得以及公司财报上的会计保修准备金，应当分别填报在 T2 申报表的哪个位置？

opts.t: Report the partnership's allocated taxable capital gains on Schedule 1 line 129, and report the opening and closing accounting warranty reserve on Schedule 13.
opts.w: 同时踩中「附表回填错位：账面准备进表 13、合伙利得进第 129 行」两个陷阱：合伙企业分配的应税资本利得严禁填在 Schedule 1 第 129 行，而财报上的会计准备严禁填进 Schedule 13。

opts.t: Report the partnership's allocated taxable capital gains on the corporation's own Schedule 6, and report the opening and closing accounting warranty reserve on Schedule 13.
opts.w: 前半句正确，后半句踩中「账面准备进表 13」陷阱：准备金连续性表（Schedule 13）只放税法允许的准备，财报上的期初期末准备必须走 Schedule 1 的第 414 行与第 126 行。

opts.t: Report the partnership's allocated taxable capital gains on Schedule 1 line 129, and report the opening and closing accounting warranty reserve on lines 414 and 126 of Schedule 1.
opts.w: 后半句正确，前半句踩中「合伙利得进第 129 行」陷阱：合伙企业分配给公司合伙人的应税资本利得或可扣资本损失，不能填在 Schedule 1 第 129 行，必须填进公司自己的 Schedule 6。

opts.t: The partnership capital gains go on the corporation's own Schedule 6; the accounting warranty reserve goes on Schedule 1 lines 414 and 126.
opts.w: 正确。根据 T2 指南规则：第一，合伙企业分配给公司合伙人的应税资本利得或可扣资本损失，不填 Schedule 1 第 129 行，而应把公司所占份额填进公司自己的资本财产处置汇总表（Schedule 6）；第二，准备金连续性表（Schedule 13）只放税法明文允许的准备，财报上的期初期末会计准备直接走 Schedule 1 的第 414 行与第 126 行。

main.pt: 表141编表人披露与联邦省税联动
main.trap: GIFI 必填代码留空、只报小计或零活动不报
main.stem: Which of the following accurately describes the role of Schedule 141, financial statement notes, and provincial corporate tax computation in a 2026 T2 filing?
main.zh: 下列哪项准确描述了 2026 税年 T2 申报中关于 Schedule 141、财务报表附注以及省级公司税计算的规则？

opts.t: Schedule 141 asks about the preparer's designation, connection and any reservation; notes go as text with e-filing; BC uses federal taxable income.
opts.w: 正确。Schedule 141（附加信息）把编表人的身份、执业资格、独立性（是否与公司关联）以及有无提出保留意见（reservation）写进申报内容；电子申报 T2 时，已编制的财报附注（notes to the financial statements）仍须以文本形式随传输一并提交（漏交属申报不完整）；且税务净收入全国一套不分省重算，BC 省在 Schedule 427 上直接沿用联邦算出的应税收入基数计算省税。

opts.t: Electronic T2 filers do not need to prepare or transmit notes to the financial statements, because GIFI codes replace all narrative disclosures.
opts.w: 误解了「电子申报不用再寄纸质附注」的含义：「不用寄纸件」不等于「不用做或不用交」——只要编制了财报附注，电子申报时必须以文本形式随传输提交，漏交属于申报不完整（漏交附注陷阱）。

opts.t: Schedule 141 only asks for numerical breakdowns of extraordinary items, and British Columbia requires a separate calculation of provincial net income for tax purposes on Schedule 427.
opts.w: 两处均错：第一，Schedule 141 问的不是数字而是人（谁经手财务信息、有无会计执业资格、是否关联、有无保留意见及谁编制 T2）；第二，BC 省在 Schedule 427 上不重算税务净收入，而是共用联邦应税收入（表 141 用途与省级重算双重误区）。

opts.t: If a corporation understates its Schedule 1 add-backs and is reassessed, it only pays simple interest on the unpaid federal tax because Schedule 1 adjustments do not affect provincial tax.
opts.w: 错在两处：第一，Schedule 1 少加回导致应税收入被低估时，补税利息是按规定利率「逐日复利（compounded daily）」而非单利计算（若属重大失实陈述，正常复评期外仍可重开）；第二，Schedule 1 的每一处调整都会同时改变联邦税和省税两个数（复利与省税联动忽视陷阱）。

variants.pt: 四因素测试判定雇员与自雇
variants.trap: 合同写承包就算自雇
variants.stem: Elena provides home daycare services in her own residence. She sets her own operating hours and fee schedule, purchases all toys and food at her own expense, bears the financial loss if enrollment drops, and serves six different families independently. How will the CRA most likely classify Elena under RC4110?
variants.zh: Elena 在自己家里提供家庭日托服务。她自行决定作息时间与收费标准，自费购买所有玩具和餐饮食材，若招不满孩子则自己承担亏损风险，并独立为六个不同家庭提供服务。根据 RC4110 指南，CRA 最可能如何认定 Elena 的身份？

opts.t: As an employee of the six families, because residential childcare is automatically deemed employment by occupation name.
opts.w: 错误。不能套用职业名称一刀切；CRA 明确指出在自己家里提供日托、自行决定收费与作息、自担场地耗材成本的人通常属于自雇。

opts.t: As operating a personal service business, which prohibits her from deducting any food or toy supplies.
opts.w: 错误。个人服务业务（personal service business）针对的是借公司外壳提供实质雇佣服务的人，Elena 是以个人身份独立自雇经营。

opts.t: As self-employed, because she controls the work, supplies her own space and materials, and bears the chance of profit and risk of loss.
opts.w: 正确。对照四因素测试（four-factor test），Elena 自主掌握控制权、自备场地与耗材工具、自担盈亏风险且独立于单一付款方，属于典型的自雇者（self-employed）。

opts.t: As self-employed only if each parent signs a notarized waiver of employer CPP and EI obligations before the tax year ends.
opts.w: 错误。自雇还是雇佣取决于四因素的经济实质，不需要也不靠双方签署放弃代扣义务的书面声明来决定。

variants.pt: 权责发生制默认与现金制例外
variants.trap: 任意小生意都可选现金制
variants.stem: Gavin is a self-employed grain farmer who properly reported his farm income using the cash method in 2025. In 2026, he wants to switch to the accrual method, and another farmer friend who still uses the cash method prepays a three-year supply contract covering 2026, 2027, and 2028. Under section 28 of the Income Tax Act, which statement is correct?
variants.zh: Gavin 是一名自雇谷物种植农，2025 年合规使用现金制申报农业收入。2026 年他想改用权责发生制；而他另一位仍使用现金制的农民朋友一次性预付了涵盖 2026、2027 和 2028 三年的农资合同款。根据《所得税法》第 28 条，下列哪项陈述正确？

opts.t: Gavin needs CRA concurrence to leave the cash method, and a cash-method farmer cannot fully deduct in the year paid a prepayment covering two or more later years.
opts.w: 正确。农渔业进现金制容易、出现金制须经 CRA 同意（ITA s.28(3)）；同时现金制（cash method）下对应两年或以上之后税年的预付费用不能在收付当年一次性扣完，须按对应年度分摊。

opts.t: Gavin needs CRA approval to first enter the cash method, but he can switch back to the accrual method at any time simply by checking a box on his return.
opts.w: 错误。把方向记反了：农渔业选现金制只需在报税表上按现金制计算即可，但一旦用过现金制，要改回权责发生制必须取得 CRA 同意。

opts.t: Both farmers must use the accrual method starting in 2026 because the cash method now applies only to commissioned sales agents.
opts.w: 错误。农民、渔民以及按佣金计酬的销售代理人三类人在 2026 税年依然拥有选择现金制的法定空间。

opts.t: A cash-method farmer can deduct 100% of a five-year prepaid expense in the year of payment because cash accounting has no anti-distortion rules.
opts.w: 错误。现金制专门设有一条防扭曲补丁规则：预付费用若对应两年或以上之后的税年，必须按对应年度分摊，不能在付款当年一次性冲掉。

variants.pt: 三道法定闸门与五类高频费用
variants.trap: 开业前考察费事后补扣
variants.stem: Victor is a self-employed long-haul truck driver who incurs $2,000 in eligible meal expenses during eligible travel periods in 2026. Of that $2,000, the CRA determines that $200 was excessive and unreasonable under section 67, leaving $1,800 as the reasonable amount. He also pays $1,500 in legal fees to defend against a personal criminal charge unrelated to his trucking business. What total deduction can Victor claim for these two items?
variants.zh: Victor 是一名自雇长途货车司机，2026 年在合资格出车期间发生了 $2,000 的餐饮支出。CRA 根据第 67 条认定其中 $200 超出合理范围，合理金额为 $1,800。此外他还支付了 $1,500 律师费，用于抗辩一项与货运业务无关的个人刑事指控。Victor 就这两项支出共可扣除多少？

opts.t: $900, calculated as 50% of the $1,800 reasonable meal expenses, with $0 for the personal legal fees.
opts.w: 错误。忽略了长途货车司机的专门比例（s.67.1(1.1)）：长途货车司机的合资格餐饮费可扣 80%，而非普通 50%。

opts.t: $1,440, calculated as 80% of the $1,800 reasonable meal amount for a long-haul truck driver, and $0 for the personal criminal defence legal fees.
opts.w: 正确。先按合理性测试（reasonableness test, s.67）取实际与合理金额较小值 $1,800，再按长途货车司机（long-haul truck driver, s.67.1(1.1)）80% 比例算出 $1,440；与营业无关的个人刑事抗辩律师费未通过目的测试（purpose test, s.18(1)(a)），不可扣除。

opts.t: $1,600, calculated as 80% of the full $2,000 actual meal receipts regardless of reasonableness.
opts.w: 错误。s.67.1 的百分比限制是在「实际支付金额」与「情理之中合理的金额」两者取较小值（$1,800）之后才乘百分比，超出的 $200 不合理部分直接剔除。

opts.t: $2,940, consisting of $1,440 for meals plus $1,500 for the legal fees because losing his personal liberty would stop him from driving.
opts.w: 错误。抗辩与营业无关的个人刑事指控属于个人支出，过不了 s.18(1)(a) 目的测试，不能作为营业专业费用扣除。

variants.pt: 自雇CPP计算与Schedule 8分拆
variants.trap: CPP全额当扣除或EI交2.4倍
variants.stem: Hannah is a 67-year-old self-employed consultant who is already receiving a CPP retirement pension and has no employment income. She wants to stop making CPP contributions on her self-employed earnings starting in July 2026. How does she make this election?
variants.zh: Hannah 是一名 67 岁的自雇顾问，已经在领取 CPP 退休金且没有任何雇佣收入。她想从 2026 年 7 月起停止就其自雇收入缴纳 CPP 供款。她该如何做出这项选择？

opts.t: She must give Form CPT30 to each of her clients before July 2026, otherwise she cannot stop contributing on her self-employed earnings for 2026.
opts.w: 错误。向雇主提交 Form CPT30 是雇员的流程；纯自雇者没有雇主，也无需向客户交 CPT30，而是在 Schedule 8 上填停缴月份。

opts.t: She cannot stop contributing until she turns 70 because self-employed CPP contributions are mandatory at all ages once net income exceeds $3,500.
opts.w: 错误。已满 65 岁不满 70 岁且正在领取 CPP 的自雇者有权选择停止供款。

opts.t: She must pay the full year's CPP upfront and file Form T1139 the following year to request a refund of the employer half.
opts.w: 错误。Form T1139 是替代财年调节表，与 65–70 岁停缴 CPP 毫无关系。

opts.t: She enters the month her contributions stop directly on Schedule 8 when filing her 2026 return, as long as the return is filed by the filing deadline.
opts.w: 正确。已满 65 岁不满 70 岁且正在领取 CPP 的自雇者，只需在申报期限内交表时直接在 Schedule 8 上追溯填写停止供款生效的月份即可，比雇员交 CPT30 更方便。

variants.pt: 申报延期、缴税期限与分期预缴
variants.trap: 6月15日才算欠税晚交
variants.stem: Owen is a self-employed IT consultant in Vancouver (not a farmer or fisher) whose net tax owing was $4,500 in 2025 and is projected to be $5,000 in 2026. What are the required instalment payment due dates for Owen during the 2026 tax year?
variants.zh: Owen 是温哥华一名自雇 IT 顾问（非农民或渔民），其 2025 年净欠税额为 $4,500，预计 2026 年净欠税额为 $5,000。Owen 在 2026 税年期间的分期预缴固定到期日是什么时候？

opts.t: April 30, 2026, and June 15, 2026, matching the individual payment and filing deadlines.
opts.w: 错误。4 月 30 日与 6 月 15 日是次年汇算清缴与申报的截止日，不是当年按季分期预缴的四个到期日。

opts.t: March 15, June 15, September 15, and December 15.
opts.w: 正确。除农渔业外，净欠税额在当年及前两年之一超过 $3,000（魁省 $1,800）门槛的自雇者须按季分期预缴（instalment payments），四个固定到期日为 3 月 15 日、6 月 15 日、9 月 15 日、12 月 15 日。

opts.t: December 31, 2026, as a single lump-sum instalment payment.
opts.w: 错误。12 月 31 日单期预缴仅适用于农民和渔民，IT 顾问必须按四个季度到期日预缴。

opts.t: No instalments are required in 2026 because the federal threshold for self-employed professionals is $6,000 of net tax owing.
opts.w: 错误。分期预缴的法定净欠税门槛是 $3,000（魁省 $1,800，ITA s.156.1(1)），不存在 $6,000 的门槛。

variants.pt: 非资本亏损抵扣与结转规则
variants.trap: 把营业亏损和资本亏损混用
variants.stem: Kevin has an unused net capital loss from selling shares in 2024 and a current-year business profit of $60,000 reported on Form T2125 in 2026. He has no capital gains in 2026. Can Kevin use his 2024 net capital loss to reduce his 2026 self-employed business income?
variants.zh: Kevin 有一笔 2024 年出售股票留下的未用净资本亏损，而 2026 年他在 Form T2125 上申报了 $60,000 的当年营业利润，当年没有任何资本利得。Kevin 能否用 2024 年的净资本亏损来抵减 2026 年的自雇营业收入？

opts.t: No, because net capital losses can only offset capital gains and cannot be mixed with or used to offset business income.
opts.w: 正确。净资本亏损（net capital loss）与非资本亏损（non-capital loss）是两套完全独立、不可混用的规则：净资本亏损只能抵扣资本利得，不能用来冲抵 T2125 的营业收入。

opts.t: Yes, up to 50% of the net capital loss can be converted into a non-capital loss after two years.
opts.w: 错误。净资本亏损永远不会自动或按比例转化为非资本亏损，两者不可互相顶替。

opts.t: Yes, provided he files Form T2125 Part 5 to claim the loss as a partner adjustment.
opts.w: 错误。T2125 Part 5 处理的是合伙份额、合伙人自付费用和业务用房支出，不能把净资本亏损塞进营业报表。

opts.t: No, because capital losses expire after 3 tax years if they are not used against employment or business income in that period.
opts.w: 错误。净资本亏损可回抵 3 年、无限期结转（不会在 3 年后过期），它不能用的原因是抵扣对象仅限于资本利得。

variants.pt: 专业收入Part 3B与期末WIP规则
variants.trap: 专业人士年底排除WIP
variants.stem: Tariq earns income from two separate unincorporated activities in 2026: he works as an independent IT architecture consultant (a profession involving specialized knowledge) and he also runs an online retail store selling computer accessories with year-end merchandise inventory. How must Tariq complete Form T2125 for 2026?
variants.zh: Tariq 在 2026 年从两项独立的未注册公司活动中取得收入：他担任独立 IT 架构顾问（一项蕴含专门知识的职业），同时还经营一家销售电脑配件且期末有商品存货的网店。Tariq 在 2026 年必须如何填报 Form T2125？

opts.t: He combines both activities onto a single Form T2125 under Part 3A because IT consulting is not one of the six traditional designated professions.
opts.w: 错误。专业收入（professional income）的区分标准是「是否属于蕴含专门知识、区别于单纯技能的职业」，法院明确将建筑师、工程师、IT 顾问包含在内，且同时有营业和专业两类收入必须分开填两张 T2125。

opts.t: He files one Form T2125 using Part 3B for both activities and values the retail computer accessories as unbilled work-in-progress.
opts.w: 错误。同时有营业收入与专业收入的人必须分别填两张 T2125，网店商品属于期末存货（Part 3A），不是专业服务在制品（WIP）。

opts.t: He completes two T2125 forms: Part 3A for the store, with closing inventory, and Part 3B for the consulting, with WIP at the lower of cost and fair market value.
opts.w: 正确。同时有营业收入（business income, Part 3A，核算期末存货成本）和专业收入（professional income, Part 3B，包括 IT 顾问，按成本与公允市价孰低核算期末 WIP）的人，必须分别填报两张 Form T2125，且网店还需填写 Part 2 网络收入信息。

opts.t: He reports the retail store on Form T2125 Part 3A and reports the IT consulting directly on Line 10400 as employment income because IT consultants cannot use Part 3B.
opts.w: 错误。独立自雇的 IT 顾问属于专业收入，填报在另一张 T2125 的 Part 3B（最终落到 T1 Line 13700），不是雇佣收入。

variants.pt: 家庭办公室两道替代门槛与当面会客
variants.trap: 工时与视频会客混淆陷阱
variants.stem: Liam is a self-employed business coach who has no outside office and performs all his research, preparation, and client coaching from a dedicated home study using video calls. He never meets clients face to face at home. Is Liam eligible to claim business-use-of-home expenses?
variants.zh: Liam 是一名自雇商业教练，没有外部办公室，所有研究、备课与客户辅导均在家中一间专用书房通过视频通话完成，从不在家面对面见客户。Liam 是否有资格申报家庭办公室支出？

opts.t: No, because conducting coaching sessions by video call automatically disqualifies any home office claim.
opts.w: 这落入了把两条替代门槛当成必须同时满足的陷阱：虽然视频会议不满足第二条「当面会客」门槛，但只要家是主要营业地，就不需要靠第二条门槛过关。

opts.t: No, because a taxpayer must satisfy both the principal place of business test and the in-person client meeting test simultaneously.
opts.w: s.18(12) 的两条门槛是替代关系（满足其一即可），并不要求同时满足两条。

opts.t: Yes, because his home study is his principal place of business, which satisfies the first gateway test without needing in-person client meetings.
opts.w: 家庭办公室的两条门槛互为替代：由于 Liam 没有其他营业场所，家中的书房就是其主要营业地（principal place of business），直接满足第一条门槛，无需再满足第二条当面会客要求。

opts.t: Yes, but only for utilities and internet, because self-employed individuals cannot deduct mortgage interest or property tax.
opts.w: 这落入了「雇员与自雇清单串位陷阱」：自雇者满足门槛后不仅可以扣水电暖，还能按比例扣物业税、房屋保险以及按揭利息。

variants.pt: 家庭办公室可扣项目与净收入限制
variants.trap: 雇员与自雇清单串位陷阱
variants.stem: Chloe is a self-employed bookkeeper whose sole office is a shared dining table used partly for business and partly for family meals. Which rule governs how she calculates and claims her home expenses on Form T2125?
variants.zh: Chloe 是一名自雇簿记员，唯一办公地点是家中一张兼作家庭用餐的餐桌。在 T2125 表上计算并申报房屋支出时适用哪条规则？

opts.t: She prorates eligible expenses (including mortgage interest and property tax) first by the area ratio and then by the business-use time ratio, and cannot use them to create a business loss.
opts.w: 当工作空间不是专用（如餐桌白天办公晚上吃饭）时，自雇者可扣的水电暖、物业税、房屋保险与按揭利息须分两步分摊：先按工作空间面积除以住宅总面积，再按用于经营的时间比例打第二折，且同样受净收入限制不得制造亏损。

opts.t: Because the dining table is not used exclusively for business, she is completely barred from claiming any home office expenses even though her home is her principal place of business.
opts.w: 「专门使用（exclusive use）」只是第二条门槛的要求；既然家是她的唯一及主要营业地（满足第一条门槛），非专用空间依然可以申报，只需在面积比例后再乘以时间比例。

opts.t: She may deduct the full cost of renovating the kitchen and replacing all house windows as current home office expenses.
opts.w: 换窗户、装修厨房等让房屋整体升值的支出属于资本性装修（capital renovations），永远不能作为当年现行费用直接进家庭办公室清单。

opts.t: She can prorate only by floor area without adjusting for personal dining hours, and any excess over net income can be applied against employment income from another employer.
opts.w: 非专用空间必须再按经营时间比例打折，且超出净收入限制的部分只能结转用于同一自雇业务的后年收入，不能当场抵扣其他收入。

variants.pt: 行车日志基准年法与T2125申报顺序
variants.trap: 家庭办公室制造亏损陷阱
variants.stem: After establishing a base-year vehicle logbook two years ago, a self-employed contractor relocated her business premises and shifted to a completely different client territory in 2026. How does this affect her vehicle expense documentation and interest deduction?
variants.zh: 一名自雇承包商两年前确立了基准年行车日志，但在 2026 年搬迁了营业场所并转向完全不同的客户区域。这对她的车辆费用凭证与利息扣除有何影响？

opts.t: She can still rely on the old base-year percentage forever, and her vehicle loan interest is prorated before applying the federal monthly limit.
opts.w: 行驶模式发生实质变化后基准年不再有代表性，不能继续沿用；且贷款利息必须先按月度上限封顶，再乘以经营使用比例。

opts.t: Her driving pattern changed materially, so she needs a new full-year logbook, and her loan interest is first capped at the monthly limit and then prorated.
opts.w: 一旦换了主要客户群或搬了办公地点导致行驶模式实质变化，原基准年即失去代表性，须重新做一整年完整记录；计算车辆贷款利息（s.67.2）与租赁费用（s.67.3）时，先按联邦月度上限封顶，再乘以经营比例。

opts.t: She may use a flat unverified estimate for 2026 mileage because the CRA is required to accept post-filing estimates when an office moves.
opts.w: 车辆扣除必须有可靠记录支持，不能假定事后估算会获 CRA 接受，记录不足可能被调整或整笔拒绝。

opts.t: She only needs to keep her vehicle logbook and purchase invoices for one year after filing the 2026 return.
opts.w: 行车日志与相关凭证必须从相关税年年末算起保存六年，而非一年。

variants.pt: Class 10.1 上限与处置规则
variants.trap: 豪车上限与处置混同陷阱
variants.stem: In 2026, a self-employed GST-registered consultant purchases a non-zero-emission passenger vehicle for $132,000 before taxes for business use. How is the capital cost base for CCA determined in 2026?
variants.zh: 2026 年，一名已注册 GST 的自雇顾问以税前 $132,000 购入一辆非零排放乘用车用于经营。2026 年该如何确定其用于计算 CCA 的资本成本基础？

opts.t: It goes into its own Class 10.1 at $39,000 plus the GST and PST computed on that $39,000, less any GST recovered as an input tax credit.
opts.w: 超过法定上限的乘用车须单独归入 Class 10.1，以财政部宣布的 2026 年上限 $39,000 加上按这 $39,000 计算的适用销售税（已申 ITC 的 GST 不再计入）作为成本基础。注意《所得税条例》s.7307 合订本至 2026-07-21 仍写 $38,000，2026 年取得的车辆按财政部宣布的 $39,000 计算（2025 年取得的仍是 $38,000）。

opts.t: The full $132,000 purchase price goes into Class 10 and is depreciated at 30%, because the car is used to earn business income.
opts.w: 这落入了「豪车上限与处置混同陷阱」：无论业务使用比例多高，超过法定上限的乘用车都不能按实际买价 $132,000 入 Class 10，超出部分永久排除在 CCA 成本基础之外。

opts.t: The vehicle enters Class 54 because all passenger vehicles costing over $100,000 qualify for the higher Class 54 ceiling.
opts.w: Class 54 仅适用于零排放乘用车（zero-emission passenger vehicles），普通燃油乘用车超过上限只能进 Class 10.1。

opts.t: It goes into Class 10.1 at a flat $39,000, and no sales tax of any kind may ever be added on top of that capped amount.
opts.w: 这是案例中指出的常见错报：不能只按光秃秃的 $39,000 入类，按这 $39,000 上限对应计算的未抵免销售税（如不可退还的 PST）应当计入成本基础。

variants.pt: CCA类别划分与$500工具分界
variants.trap: 新政已宣布与已生效混淆陷阱
variants.stem: A small business disposes of the last remaining piece of equipment in its Class 8 pool during 2026. At year-end, no assets remain in Class 8, but there is still a positive undepreciated capital cost (UCC) balance left in the pool. How is this remaining balance treated?
variants.zh: 一家小企业在 2026 年处置了其 Class 8 类别中仅存的最后一件设备。到年末时，Class 8 中已无任何财产，但类别里仍有一笔正数的未折旧资本成本余额（UCC）。这笔剩余余额如何处理？

opts.t: It must be added back to business income as recapture.
opts.w: 追加折旧（recapture）发生在类别期末 UCC 在年度增减调整后为负数时；当类别已空且仍有正数未折旧余额时，产生的是期末亏损而非追加折旧。

opts.t: It is deducted in full as a terminal loss, which can be used to offset income from any source.
opts.w: 当普通 CCA 类别（非 Class 10.1）里已经没有财产但仍有未折旧余额（UCC）时，剩余部分可作为期末亏损（terminal loss）全额扣除，且不像资本损失只抵资本利得，期末亏损可用来抵扣任何来源的收入。

opts.t: It is treated as a capital loss that can only offset taxable capital gains.
opts.w: 折旧财产类别清空后的剩余 UCC 是期末亏损（terminal loss），可以全额抵扣任何来源的收入，不受「资本损失只能抵资本利得」的限制。

opts.t: It is forfeited under s.20(16.1) because terminal losses are disallowed for all CCA classes.
opts.w: s.20(16.1) 禁止期末亏损仅针对 Class 10.1 的超上限乘用车，普通 Class 8 财产完全允许申报期末亏损。

variants.pt: 高价商用车联邦豪华税与BC省PST
variants.trap: 豪车上限与处置混同陷阱
variants.stem: A BC business owner is comparing the provincial PST tiers on passenger vehicles purchased from a GST-registered dealer in 2026. Which statement correctly describes the BC PST rate thresholds and the federal luxury tax scope in 2026?
variants.zh: 一名 BC 省企业主正在对比 2026 年从 GST 注册经销商处购买乘用车的省级 PST 分档税率。哪项陈述正确描述了 2026 年的 BC PST 税率分界及联邦豪华税适用范围？

opts.t: Ordinary passenger vehicles under $55,000 are taxed at 12%, while vehicles of $150,000 and over are taxed at 10%.
opts.w: GST 注册商出售普通乘用车低于 $55,000 为 7%（私人交易才有 12% 等税率），而 $150,000 起为 20%（$57,000 至不足 $125,000 才是 10%）。

opts.t: ZEVs use the same $55,000, $56,000 and $57,000 starting points as gas cars, and the luxury tax still covers aircraft and vessels in 2026.
opts.w: ZEV 的前三个高档起点提高到了 $75,000、$76,000、$77,000；且飞机与船舶的联邦豪华税已在 2025-11-04 之后由 C-15 终止。

opts.t: Dealer sales of ordinary cars start at 7% under $55,000 and reach 20% at $150,000, and the vehicle luxury tax still applies above $100,000.
The federal Select Luxury Items Tax on vehicles is 20% of the entire purchase price once the price exceeds $100,000.
opts.w: 车辆豪华税是「总价的 10%」与「超出 $100,000 部分的 20%」两者取较小值，绝不是按全部车价的 20% 征收。

variants.pt: 2026加速投资激励与即时费用化三态
variants.trap: 新政已宣布与已生效混淆陷阱
variants.stem: A small manufacturer buys new processing equipment in 2026 and wants to know why she cannot put it into Class 53 or simply multiply by a flat 30% half-year rule without checking acquisition dates. Which explanation is accurate for the 2026 tax year?
variants.zh: 一名小型制造商在 2026 年购入新的加工设备，想了解为什么不能将其归入 Class 53，也不能在不核对取得日期的情况下简单按 30% 半年规则计算。就 2026 税年而言，哪项解释是准确的？

opts.t: Class 53 took only 2016–2025 acquisitions; 2026 machinery goes to Class 43 at 30%, and the restored RIIP first-year rule must be checked by acquisition and use dates.
opts.w: Class 53（50% 费率）于 2025 年底截止新增，2026 年起新购合资格制造加工设备改归 Class 43（普通年率 30%）；同时 C-15 已恢复加速投资激励/RIIP 首年增强规则，必须先核对资产类别、取得日期与可供使用日期，分开普通年率与合资格 RIIP 首年规则：本会归 Class 53 的制造加工设备首年可 100% 扣除（2029 年后才可供使用的开始退坡），不能只按普通 30% 算首年。

opts.t: Class 53 is still open in 2026, and the taxpayer is required by law to claim the maximum possible CCA every year.
opts.w: Class 53 已于 2025 年底截止新增；且 CCA 是否申报可自行选择（不申报或申报低于上限均合法）。

opts.t: New manufacturing machinery acquired in 2026 must be placed in Class 13 and depreciated straight-line over the building lease.
opts.w: Class 13 仅适用于租用场地上的资本性改良（leasehold interest），2026 年新购制造加工机器设备应归入 Class 43。
