opts.t: She can place two machines in Class 43 and claim the full enhanced rate on one machine while claiming 0% on the other machine within the same class pool.
opts.w: 一旦几件财产共用同一个 CCA 类别，同一年只能对整个类别选择一个申报额度，不能对类别内某一件多提、另一件少提。

variants.pt: 三类供应与进项抵免分野
variants.trap: 混淆零税率与豁免供应的ITC资格
variants.stem: Marcus runs a neighbourhood pharmacy in Victoria that sells prescription drugs and basic groceries, along with a licensed daycare centre in the adjacent unit. Which statement correctly describes his eligibility to claim input tax credits (ITCs)?
variants.zh: Marcus在维多利亚经营一家销售处方药和基本食品杂货的社区药房，并在隔壁单元经营一家持牌托儿中心。下列哪项准确描述了他申报进项税额抵免（ITC）的资格？

opts.t: Prescription drugs and basic groceries are zero-rated, so their inputs earn ITCs, while daycare is an exempt supply that earns no ITCs.
opts.w: 正确。处方药与基本食品杂货属于零税率供应（zero-rated supply），对客户的税率为 0，但上游进项税额抵免（ITC）可全额退回；托儿服务属于豁免供应（exempt supply），不能抵扣任何进项税。

opts.t: Because neither prescription drugs nor daycare services charge GST at the counter, neither activity qualifies for any ITCs.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了零税率与豁免：虽然柜台都不收税，但处方药和基本食品是零税率应税供应，注册后可全额退回进项税。

opts.t: Daycare services are zero-rated supplies that generate full ITC refunds, whereas prescription drugs are exempt supplies.
opts.w: 错误。将两类供应颠倒了：托儿服务是豁免供应（不可抵ITC），处方药和基本食品是零税率供应（可抵ITC）。

opts.t: Once Marcus registers for GST/HST through his pharmacy, he can also claim 100% of the GST paid on toys and supplies used exclusively in the daycare.
opts.w: 错误。即便因为药房业务成为登记人（registrant），专门用于豁免供应（托儿服务）的采购依然不得抵扣任何ITC。

variants.pt: 小供应商3万门槛与合并计算
variants.trap: 单季跨线误套缓冲期
variants.stem: Nadia is an unregistered consultant in Kelowna. Her quarterly taxable revenues are $8,000 in Q1, $9,000 in Q2, $8,500 in Q3, and $7,000 in Q4 (ending December 31, 2026), bringing her four-quarter cumulative total to $32,500 without any single quarter exceeding $30,000. When must Nadia start charging GST?
variants.zh: Nadia是基洛纳一名未注册的顾问。她四个季度的应税收入分别为：第1季$8,000、第2季$9,000、第3季$8,500、第4季（截至2026年12月31日）$7,000，连续四季累计达$32,500，但没有任何单季超过$30,000。Nadia必须从何时起开始收取GST？

opts.t: On the exact date in Q4 when her cumulative four-quarter revenue crossed $30,000, with no buffer period.
opts.w: 错误。立即从跨线当笔交易起收税是“单个日历季度内超$30,000”的规则；Nadia每季均未超$30,000，走的是连续四季累计超线的第二条路径。

opts.t: On January 1, 2027, which is the very first day after the calendar quarter in which she exceeded the threshold.
opts.w: 错误。连续四季累计超线的路径给予一个月的缓冲期，她在超线季度结束后的下一个月末（1月31日）才失去小供应商身份，而非1月1日。

opts.t: She remains exempt from registration as long as fewer than 30 sales were made through a digital platform during the year.
opts.w: 错误。“30笔且$2,800”只是数字平台向CRA报送卖家信息的排除门槛，不改变纳税人自己的$30,000 GST/HST注册义务。

opts.t: On her first taxable supply made after January 31, 2027, with registration completed within 29 days of that effective date.
opts.w: 正确。连续四个日历季度累计超$30,000但单季未超线的，在超线季度（Q4，12月31日结束）后的下一个月末（2027年1月31日）失去小供应商（small supplier）身份，从2月1日起的第一笔应税供应开始收税，并在生效日后29天内完成注册。

variants.pt: 进项凭证三档要求与简化进项法
variants.trap: 错用旧发票门槛或漏算简化法进口采购
variants.stem: While closing her 2026 books, a regular-method registrant (whose annual sales have always been under $300,000) discovers an unclaimed $540 equipment invoice from May 2024 that lists all required high-tier details. How should she claim this missed ITC, and what is the statutory time limit?
variants.zh: 在结平2026年账目时，一名采用常规法的登记人（年销售额始终低于$300,000）发现一张2024年5月漏抵的$540设备发票，票面已具备高档凭证所需的全部要素。她应如何补抵这笔漏掉的ITC？法定时效是多久？

opts.t: She must forfeit the ITC, because unclaimed input tax credits expire at the end of the fiscal year in which the expense was incurred.
opts.w: 错误。ITC并非“当期不报就作废”，一般登记人享有长达4年的申领时效。

opts.t: She must file an amended 2024 GST34 return because missed ITCs cannot be added to a later period's Line 106.
opts.w: 错误。漏抵的ITC无需专门去修改旧报表，只要未过时效，可以直接加进后续某一期报表的第106行。

opts.t: She can include the unclaimed ITC directly on Line 106 of her current 2026 return, as general registrants have a 4-year time limit to claim ITCs.
opts.w: 正确。一般登记人的进项税额抵免（input tax credit, ITC）时效为4年（仅门槛额超$6,000,000的大户与上市金融机构为2年），漏抵的ITC可直接并入未过4年时效的后续报告期第106行申报。

opts.t: She cannot claim it in 2026 because the ITC time limit for all registrants is strictly 2 years.
opts.w: 错误。2年时效仅适用于门槛额超过$6,000,000的大户及上市金融机构，普通小微登记人的时效为4年。

variants.pt: 快速法资格与GST34申报计算
variants.trap: 快速法第101行填不含税额
variants.stem: Which of the following self-employed professionals in British Columbia (each having $220,000 in tax-included annual revenue and operating continuously for 3 years) is ELIGIBLE to elect the GST/HST quick method?
variants.zh: 下列哪一位在卑诗省执业的自雇专业人士（含税年收入均为$220,000且已连续经营满3年）有资格选举采用GST/HST快速法？

opts.t: A self-employed bookkeeper and tax-return preparer serving small businesses.
opts.w: 错误。记账、财务咨询、税务咨询与报税服务属于快速法明确点名排除的行业（excluded businesses），即使收入低于$400,000也不得使用快速法。

opts.t: A freelance graphic and web designer serving corporate clients.
opts.w: 正确。平面与网页设计不属于被排除行业，且其含税全球应税供应额（$220,000）未超过$400,000上限、已连续经营满365天，完全符合快速法（quick method）资格。

opts.t: An independent legal counsel practicing contract law.
opts.w: 错误。法律、会计与精算专业执业属于快速法点名排除的行业，无权选用快速法。

opts.t: An actuarial consultant providing pension valuations.
opts.w: 错误。精算执业与财务咨询同属快速法点名排除的行业，不得选用快速法。

variants.pt: 快速法与T2125所得税表的接口
variants.trap: 漏将快速法省下的税款计入所得税收入
variants.stem: An Ontario management consultant (13% HST; quick-method service remittance rate 8.8%) has $100,000 in pre-tax revenue ($113,000 including HST) and $20,000 in pre-tax taxable operating expenses in 2026. Based on the chapter's break-even rule of thumb (roughly 23.5%–24.4% of revenue), which method produces a lower GST/HST bill before the 1% credit?
variants.zh: 安大略省一名管理顾问（13% HST；快速法服务类汇款率8.8%）2026年不含税收入为$100,000（含HST为$113,000），不含税应税日常经营开销为$20,000。根据本章的临界点经验法则（应税采购约占营业额的23.5%–24.4%），在计入1%抵免前，哪种方法算出的应缴GST/HST更低？

opts.t: The regular method is lower, at $9,944, compared with $10,400 payable under the quick method for the same year.
Both methods result in the exact same $10,400 remittance because 8.8% of $113,000 equals $10,400.
opts.w: 错误。$113,000 × 8.8% = $9,944，安大略省服务类的相等临界点在应税采购占营业额约23.5%（即$23,500）处，而非20%。

opts.t: The quick method, at $9,944 versus $10,400, because her purchases are 20% of revenue, below the roughly 23.5% break-even.
The regular method is always lower in HST provinces, because the HST rate there is higher than the 5% GST rate.
opts.w: 错误。无论在5%省还是13%/14%/15%的HST省，服务类快速法与常规法的应税采购临界点都落在营业额的23.3%至24.4%之间，采购占比低于该临界点时快速法更省。

variants.pt: 卑诗省PST与网约车强制注册
variants.trap: 卑诗省PST与免税项混入ITC
variants.stem: A registered graphic designer in Victoria, BC buys a computer workstation for her studio for $3,000, paying $150 in federal GST (5%) and $210 in BC PST (7%). She also works part-time delivering restaurant meals by bicycle ($9,000 annual income, her only other activity, with total combined revenues of $26,000 before voluntary registration). How should the $150 GST and $210 PST be treated, and did the meal delivery alone require day-one registration?
variants.zh: 卑诗省维多利亚一名已注册的平面设计师为工作室购置一台$3,000的电脑工作站，支付了$150联邦GST（5%）与$210卑诗省PST（7%）。她还兼职骑车送餐（年收入$9,000，自愿注册前两项业务合计$26,000）。这$150 GST和$210 PST应如何处理？仅做送餐服务是否需要从第一天起强制注册？

opts.t: Both the $150 GST and $210 PST are claimed on Line 106 as ITCs ($360 total), and restaurant meal delivery requires day-one registration just like ridesharing.
opts.w: 错误。卑诗省7% PST（$210）不是增值税，绝不能进第106行作ITC；且送餐、代购、跑腿不属于“客运服务”，仍适用一般$30,000门槛。

opts.t: Only the $150 GST goes on Line 106 (the $210 PST is added to the asset's cost), and meal delivery does not trigger the day-one rideshare rule.
opts.w: 正确。卑诗省发票上12%的税只有5% GST（$150）可填入GST34第106行抵扣进项税额抵免（ITC），7% PST（$210）计入资产成本在所得税上折旧扣除；送餐服务不属于应税客运，不触发首日强制注册规则。

opts.t: Neither tax can be claimed on Line 106 because capital equipment is excluded from ITCs in British Columbia.
opts.w: 错误。无论在常规法还是快速法下，用于应税活动的资本资产（capital property）上的5%联邦GST均可合规抵扣ITC。

opts.t: The $210 PST is claimed on Line 106 while the $150 GST is expensed on Form T2125, and meal delivery is an exempt supply.
opts.w: 错误。将GST与PST的处理完全颠倒了：可抵ITC的是5% GST（$150），计入成本的是7% PST（$210），且送餐属于应税服务而非豁免供应。

variants.pt: 个体户年报与缴款双期限
variants.trap: 个体户6月15日才缴税
variants.stem: A small design corporation in Richmond, BC has a December 31, 2026 fiscal year-end and $420,000 in annual taxable supplies. It files its GST/HST return annually. When are the corporation's 2026 GST34 return and net tax payment due?
variants.zh: 卑诗省列治文一家小型设计有限公司，财年结束日为2026年12月31日，年应税供应额为$420,000，按年申报GST/HST。该公司的2026年GST34报表与净税款何时到期？

opts.t: Both the GST34 return and the net tax payment are due on March 31, 2027 (three months after the December 31 fiscal year-end).
opts.w: 正确。“4月30日缴款、6月15日申报”仅适用于12月31日财年结束且有经营收入的个体经营者（sole proprietor）；有限公司（corporation）缺少“个体经营者”这一条件，退回“财年结束后3个月”的通则，即申报与缴款均在次年3月31日到期。

opts.t: The payment is due on April 30, 2027, and the return is due on June 15, 2027.
opts.w: 错误。这是个体经营者的专属期限，有限公司不适用4月30日与6月15日规则。

opts.t: Both the return and the payment are due on January 31, 2027 (one month after year-end).
opts.w: 错误。“报告期结束后1个月”是月报和季报的期限；年报的通则是财年结束后3个月（3月31日）。

opts.t: The return is due on June 30, 2027 (six months after year-end, matching the T2 corporate income tax filing deadline).
opts.w: 错误。混淆了T2企业所得税申报期（财年结束后6个月）与GST/HST年报申报期（财年结束后3个月）。

variants.pt: 网约车与送餐的GST/HST登记门槛
variants.trap: 网约车误套小供应商豁免
variants.stem: In 2026, Clara worked exclusively as an independent food delivery courier in the first half of the year, earning $18,000 without registering for GST/HST. On September 1, 2026, she began accepting passenger ridesharing trips and earned $1,400 from ridesharing and $4,000 from food delivery during the rest of the year. How does starting passenger ridesharing affect her GST/HST obligations?
variants.zh: 2026 年上半年，克拉拉仅从事独立送餐工作，取得 $18,000 收入且未登记 GST/HST。2026 年 9 月 1 日，她开始接网约车载客单，并在当年剩余时间里取得网约车收入 $1,400 和送餐收入 $4,000。开始接网约车载客单对她的 GST/HST 义务有何影响？

opts.t: She remains a small supplier for the entire 2026 year because her total revenue of $23,400 is below $30,000.
opts.w: 错误。落入「网约车误套小供应商豁免」陷阱：只要开始从事商业性网约车载客，该业务从第一元起就没有小供应商（small supplier）豁免。

opts.t: She must register effective September 1, 2026 and retroactively pay GST/HST on the $18,000 earned from delivery in the first half of the year.
opts.w: 错误。9 月 1 日之前她只做纯送餐且未满 $30,000，属于合法的小供应商期间，登记生效日锚定在开始提供网约车服务的 9 月 1 日，不会追溯对上半年的纯送餐收入征税。

opts.t: She registers effective September 1, 2026, and from then on collects GST/HST on both her ridesharing fares and the $4,000 of later delivery revenue.
opts.w: 正确。网约车业务（taxi business）从实际开始提供服务的第一天（9 月 1 日）起即须登记并收税；一旦成为 GST/HST 注册人，同一账户下后续发生的 $4,000 送餐收入也必须跟着一起收取 GST/HST。

opts.t: She must collect GST/HST only on the $1,400 ridesharing fares while keeping the $4,000 delivery revenue outside the GST/HST system.
opts.w: 错误。同一自雇个人登记 GST/HST 后，不能将网约车与送餐拆开处理，登记生效日之后的送餐收入必须一并收税。

variants.pt: 小供应商单季越过三万的生效时点
variants.trap: 只记四季累计、漏看单季越线
variants.stem: Sonia is an unregistered food delivery courier. Her quarterly gross delivery revenues were $8,000 in Q4 2025, $7,500 in Q1 2026, $8,500 in Q2 2026, and $7,200 in Q3 2026 (ended September 30, 2026), bringing her four-quarter cumulative total to $31,200 without any single quarter exceeding $30,000. By what date does Sonia lose her small supplier status and need to begin collecting GST/HST?
variants.zh: 索尼娅是一名未登记 GST/HST 的纯送餐员。她的季度配送总收入分别为：2025 年第四季度 $8,000、2026 年第一季度 $7,500、2026 年第二季度 $8,500、2026 年第三季度（截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日）$7,200。至此她连续四个季度累计达到 $31,200，且没有任何单个季度超过 $30,000。索尼娅在哪一天失去小供应商身份并须在其后开始收取 GST/HST？

opts.t: At the end of October 31, 2026; she must charge GST/HST on supplies made on or after November 1, 2026.
opts.w: 正确。当连续四个日历季度累计超过 $30,000 但单季均未超过时，适用四季累计触发（four-quarter cumulative trigger）：在超过门槛所在季度（2026 年 Q3，9 月 30 日结束）结束后的下一个月末（10 月 31 日）失去小供应商身份，从 11 月 1 日起的第一笔供应开始收税。

opts.t: She loses her small supplier status on the exact day in Q3 2026 when her cumulative four-quarter revenue crossed $30,000.
opts.w: 错误。把「单季触发（当笔立即生效）」与「四季累计触发」搞反了：单季仅 $7,200 并未突破 $30,000，四季累计超标享有一个自然月的缓冲期（至次月月底）。

opts.t: She loses her small supplier status on September 30, 2026, and must start collecting GST/HST on October 1, 2026.
opts.w: 错误。四季累计超标的失效时点是超标季度结束后的「下一个月末」（10 月 31 日），而不是超标季度当季末（9 月 30 日）。

opts.t: She remains a small supplier for all of 2026 because her 2026 calendar-year revenue from Q1 to Q3 is only $23,200.
opts.w: 错误。$30,000 小供应商门槛是按「连续四个日历季度滚动累计」考核（含 2025 年 Q4），而不是只看单一自然年度（1 月至 12 月）。

variants.pt: DPI规则的排除卖家范围与申报周期
variants.trap: 服务类卖家误套卖货排除线
variants.stem: During 2026, two individuals used digital platforms: Priya sold 18 used household items for a total of $1,900 on a marketplace app, while Sam rented out his cottage for two weekends (2 transactions) for a total of $1,900 on a short-term accommodation app. Under the Part XX Reporting Rules for Digital Platform Operators (DPI), whose 2026 activity must the respective platform operator report to the CRA by January 31, 2027?
variants.zh: 2026 年间，有两人在数字平台上开展活动：普里娅在二手交易应用上售出 18 件闲置家居物品，总对价 $1,900；山姆在短租应用上将度假屋出租了两个周末（共 2 笔交易），总对价也是 $1,900。根据《所得税法》Part XX 数字平台运营方申报规则（DPI），平台运营方必须在 2027 年 1 月 31 日前向 CRA 报告谁的 2026 年活动信息？

opts.t: Neither Priya nor Sam, because both had fewer than 30 transactions and received no more than $2,800 during the calendar year.
opts.w: 错误。落入「服务类卖家误套卖货排除线」陷阱：不动产短租不属于销售货物，不能适用 30 单且 $2,800 的排除线。

opts.t: Both Priya and Sam, because any transaction over $500 on a digital platform is reportable under Part XX.
opts.w: 错误。卖货类卖家只要全年少于 30 单且总额不超 $2,800 即可归为排除卖家（excluded seller），因此普里娅的卖货记录属于排除范围；$500 是不提供税号的罚款。

opts.t: Priya only, because selling tangible goods is always reportable whereas real property rentals under $30,000 are excluded.
opts.w: 错误。恰好说反了：卖货有 30 单且 $2,800 的排除线，而不动产出租在 DPI 下没有任何金额或单数豁免。

opts.t: Sam only, because the <30 transactions and ≤$2,800 exclusion applies exclusively to the sale of goods, not to real property rentals.
opts.w: 正确。DPI 规则中的排除卖家（excluded seller）门槛（全年少于 30 单且不超 $2,800）仅适用于销售货物（普里娅满足条件被排除）；不动产出租（含短租）、网约车与送餐不适用该排除线，山姆即使只有 2 单也必须由平台按季汇总并在次年 1 月 31 日前报给 CRA。

variants.pt: 自雇CPP计算与扣除抵免拆分
variants.trap: CPP 供款全额当成所得扣除
variants.stem: In 2026, Gavin earned $85,000 in net self-employment income from his delivery business, reaching the Year's Additional Maximum Pensionable Earnings (YAMPE) of $85,000 (above the $74,600 YMPE). When Gavin completes Schedule 8 for his 2026 T1 return, how are the enhanced portion of his first-tier CPP (introduced since 2019) and his entire second-tier CPP2 contribution treated for tax purposes?
variants.zh: 2026 年，加文通过送餐业务取得 $85,000 的自雇净收入，达到了 2026 年供款附加最高年收入（YAMPE）$85,000（高于 YMPE $74,600）。当加文为 2026 年 T1 申报表填报 Schedule 8 时，他第一层 CPP 中自 2019 年起新增的增强部分以及整笔第二层 CPP2 供款在税务上应如何处理？

opts.t: Both the enhanced first-tier CPP portion and 100% of the CPP2 contributions are claimed only as non-refundable tax credits on line 31000.
opts.w: 错误。line 31000 只接收雇员等价的基础 CPP 供款（不含增强段），增强部分与 CPP2 均不进 line 31000。

opts.t: Both the enhanced first-tier portion and all CPP2 are deducted on line 22200; only the base portion is split between line 22200 and line 31000.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义 2.3 节与术语表规则（Schedule 8 / line 22200 / line 31000）：基础层 CPP 供款拆成两半（雇主等价段进 line 22200 扣除，雇员等价段进 line 31000 不可退还抵免），而 2019 年 CPP 增强之后新增的部分（含 CPP2 全部）则全额在 line 22200 作为所得扣除。

opts.t: All base CPP, enhanced CPP, and CPP2 contributions are split evenly 50/50 between line 22200 and line 31000.
opts.w: 错误。50/50 拆分仅适用于一般层的基础段供款，2019 年增强段与 2024 年新增的 CPP2 层是全额作为所得扣除（line 22200）。

opts.t: CPP2 contributions are non-deductible and non-creditable because they apply only to earnings between $74,600 and $85,000.
opts.w: 错误。YMPE（$74,600）与 YAMPE（$85,000）之间的自雇 CPP2 供款全额可在 line 22200 抵扣应税所得。

variants.pt: 分期预缴第二年触发与INNS1免计算选项
variants.trap: 首年欠税超标就急着算分期预缴
variants.stem: A Canadian ridesharing driver who also has U.S. tax filing obligations compares the tax instalment rules in both countries. Which statement accurately contrasts the Canadian personal tax instalment system (outside Quebec) with the U.S. estimated tax system as explained in the lecture?
variants.zh: 一名同时负有美国报税义务的加拿大网约车司机对比两国的分期预缴规则。根据讲义说明，下列哪项准确对比了加拿大个人所得税分期预缴制度（魁北克以外）与美国预估税制度？

opts.t: In Canada, the threshold is indexed to inflation each year, whereas in the U.S. the IRS mails Form INNS1 reminders in February and August.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大的 $3,000 分期预缴门槛是长期未变的固定值，不随通胀指数化；且寄送 Form INNS1 提醒信的是加拿大 CRA，不是美国国税局。

opts.t: In Canada, a single year with net tax owing over $1,800 triggers instalments across all provinces, whereas the U.S. requires two consecutive years over $3,000.
opts.w: 错误。$1,800 是魁北克省的门槛，其他省份为 $3,000，且加拿大需要「当年＋前两年至少一年」双重超标。

opts.t: In both Canada and the U.S., taxpayers can wait for an official reminder letter before making any quarterly payment without incurring interest or penalties.
opts.w: 错误。讲义特别指出：把加拿大「等提醒信来」的习惯带到美国那一侧去用是跨境读者最常见的错误，美国不靠税务局寄信提醒，逾期会自动课处罚款。

opts.t: Canada uses a fixed $3,000 two-year test and CRA mails INNS1 reminders; in the U.S., taxpayers self-calculate under safe-harbour rules or face penalties.
opts.w: 正确。加拿大分期预缴门槛为固定不指数化的 $3,000（当年且前两年至少一年超标），由 CRA 在 2 月和 8 月主动寄送 Form INNS1 提醒信；美国则由纳税人自己按安全港规则计算并主动缴纳，不靠税务局提醒，逾期自动罚款。

variants.pt: 网约车与送餐车辆的CCA归类与报税实务
variants.trap: 混淆乘用车排除条件与实务CCA类别
variants.stem: In 2026, Arthur bought a vehicle and used it 40% for passenger ridesharing, 35% for food delivery, and 25% for personal trips during the year of acquisition. In 2027, he stopped food delivery and used the vehicle 85% for passenger ridesharing. Does Arthur's vehicle qualify for the 'passenger vehicle' exclusion (exempting it from Class 10.1 cost limits), and why?
variants.zh: 2026 年，亚瑟购入一辆汽车，在取得当年将其 40% 用于网约车载客、35% 用于送餐配送、25% 用于个人出行。2027 年，他停止送餐，将该车 85% 用于网约车载客。亚瑟的这辆车是否符合「乘用车辆」排除条件（从而不受 Class 10.1 成本上限约束）？为什么？

opts.t: Yes, because his combined commercial platform use in 2026 was 75% (40% ridesharing plus 35% delivery), which exceeds the 50% threshold.
opts.w: 错误。排除于乘用车（passenger vehicle）定义的 >50% 门槛专门看「网约车载客（出租车用途）」比例，不能把送餐配送的 35% 加进来凑数。

opts.t: Yes, starting in 2027, because his passenger ridesharing use exceeded 50% in 2027, which reclassifies the vehicle out of the passenger vehicle rules.
opts.w: 错误。讲义明确指出：是否排除于乘用车定义的判定发生在「取得车辆的那一年」（2026 年），之后年度（2027 年）用途比例上升不会追溯改变归类。

opts.t: No, because in the 2026 acquisition year ridesharing was only 40% of use, not over 50%, and later changes in use do not reclassify the car.
opts.w: 正确。车辆必须是在「取得当年」超过 50% 用于网约车载客才能排除在乘用车（passenger vehicle）定义之外（多数实务归入无上限的 Class 10 30%，法条对专用出租车列 Class 16 40%）；亚瑟取得当年载客仅占 40%，未过半，故仍须按乘用车类别与成本上限区分 Class 10 与 Class 10.1，且次年用途变化不追溯改变归类。

opts.t: No, because any vehicle used for any amount of food delivery is automatically locked into Class 10.1 regardless of its purchase price.
opts.w: 错误。讲义 3.5 节特别提醒：未排除于乘用车定义的车辆（含送餐车），应按乘用车类别和购车成本上限再区分 Class 10 与 Class 10.1，不能不论价格一律列为 Class 10.1。

variants.pt: DPI年度副本核对与小费税务处理
variants.trap: 误把DPI副本总额直接当成应税营业额
variants.stem: In January 2027, Jasmine receives her 2026 annual DPI information copy from her food delivery platform. Why does the DPI copy break down consideration, fees, commissions, and taxes into four separate calendar quarters rather than showing only a single annual total, and what is the primary tax risk if she fails to check how the platform categorizes tips on that statement?
variants.zh: 2027 年 1 月，贾斯敏收到了送餐平台寄来的 2026 年度 DPI 信息副本。为什么 DPI 副本会将对价、费用、佣金和税款拆分为四个日历季度列示，而不是只给一个全年总数？如果她没有确认平台在副本上是如何归类小费的，最主要的税务风险是什么？

opts.t: Quarterly figures show where a gap arises, and unless tips are separated from delivery fees she may misreport income or charge GST on tips.
opts.w: 正确。Part XX 信息申报表（Part XX information return）按日历季度拆列对价、笔数与扣费，只有逐季核对才能查出差额出在哪个季度；同时，不同平台对小费（tips）有的并入总额、有的单列，不先看清栏目说明，要么会在所得税上漏报或重报小费，要么会误对不收 GST/HST 的小费多算消费税。

opts.t: Quarterly breakdowns are used to calculate quarterly CPP2 deductions at source, and tips must be separated because tips are subject to double GST/HST.
opts.w: 错误。平台不代扣 CPP 或 CPP2，且小费完全不收 GST/HST。

opts.t: Quarterly breakdowns determine whether she had fewer than 30 transactions per quarter to qualify as an excluded seller, and tips are tax-free up to $2,800.
opts.w: 错误。送餐属于个人服务，不适用「30 单且 $2,800」的卖货排除卖家（excluded seller）规则，且小费在所得税上并无 $2,800 免税额。

opts.t: Quarterly breakdowns are required by WorkSafeBC to bill the courier for injury insurance, and tips are deducted on line 22200.
opts.w: 错误。DPI 是联邦《所得税法》Part XX 规则而非省级工伤保险报表（且 WorkSafeBC 保费由平台缴纳，不向配送员收），line 22200 是自雇 CPP 扣除行而非小费行。

variants.pt: 递延本质与利润全取出时的成本倒贴
variants.trap: 混淆「税务递延」与「永久免税」
variants.stem: Nora is a self-employed graphic designer in Burnaby, BC earning $55,000 net profit in 2026. She withdraws 100% of her earnings every month to pay rent and living expenses. Why does incorporating her business in 2026 fail to reduce her overall annual cost?
variants.zh: Nora是BC省本拿比的一名自雇平面设计师，2026年净利润为$55,000。她每个月将100%的收入取出来支付房租和生活费。为什么在2026年注册公司无法降低她的年度总成本？

opts.t: Because the small business deduction (SBD) is only available once corporate active business income exceeds $500,000.
opts.w: $500,000是联邦与BC省小企业扣除的业务限额上限（business limit），不是最低起征门槛。

opts.t: Because the dividend tax credit (DTC) is disallowed for corporations earning less than $100,000 in BC.
opts.w: 股息税收抵免（DTC）没有$100,000公司利润的最低门槛限制。

opts.t: Because the CRA imposes a 5% surtax whenever a shareholder withdraws all corporate profits within the same fiscal year.
opts.w: 5%附加税是《所得税法》s.123.5针对个人服务业务（PSB）公司留存利润征收的税项，并非针对正常提取利润的附加税。

opts.t: Deferral only exists on profit left in the company; withdrawing it all brings personal tax anyway, plus T2 and annual filing costs.
opts.w: 正确。税务递延（tax deferral）只在利润留在公司账上不分配时才成立；把钱全部取出来花掉时个人层面的税照交，再加上固定的公司年报费和T2会计费，总体反而倒贴。

variants.pt: 个人服务业务PSB判定与45%综合税率
variants.trap: 把「单一客户」绝对等同于个人服务业务（PSB）
variants.stem: Tariq owns 100% of a BC IT firm that derives all of its revenue in 2026 from a single long-term contract with one large bank. However, Tariq's corporation employs six full-time software engineers throughout the entire year to deliver the project. How is the corporation's income treated for tax purposes in 2026?
variants.zh: Tariq拥有一家BC省IT公司100%的股份，该公司2026年的全部收入均来自与一家大型银行签订的单一长期合同。不过，Tariq的公司全年雇用了6名全职软件工程师来交付该项目。2026年该公司的所得在税务上应如何处理？

opts.t: It is automatically taxed at 45% as a personal services business (PSB) because 100% of its revenue comes from a single client.
opts.w: 跌入「把单一客户绝对等同于PSB」的陷阱，忽略了「全年雇有超过5名全职员工」的法定豁免条件。

opts.t: It falls outside the PSB rules because it has more than five full-time employees all year, so the 11% small business rate can apply.
opts.w: 正确。个人服务业务（PSB）定义中明文规定，只要公司全年雇有超过五名全职员工（more than five full-time employees），或服务对象为关联公司，即豁免于PSB规则；雇有6名全职员工满足豁免，前$500,000活跃经营利润可享受11%的小企业综合税率。

opts.t: It avoids the 5% federal PSB surtax but is still barred from claiming the small business deduction, paying 27% instead.
opts.w: 满足超过5名全职员工豁免后，该公司完全脱离PSB定义，属于正常活跃经营收入，可以正常享受小企业扣除（SBD）和11%综合税率。

opts.t: It qualifies for the 11% rate only if the client bank is an associated corporation of Tariq's firm.
opts.w: 「全年雇有超过5名全职员工」与「服务对象是关联公司」是「或（or）」的关系，满足其一即可豁免PSB，不需要同时满足。

variants.pt: 董事对代扣税款与GST/HST的连带责任
variants.trap: 误以为有限责任公司能隔绝所有税务个人追责
variants.stem: Victor formally resigned as a director of a struggling BC corporation on March 1, 2024. When the corporation collapsed later on, it owed commercial trade suppliers $80,000 and owed the CRA $25,000 in unremitted payroll source deductions. If the CRA attempts to assess Victor personally on June 15, 2026, what is the legal result?
variants.zh: Victor于2024年3月1日正式辞去一家陷入困境的BC省公司的董事职务。该公司随后倒闭，欠商业供应商$80,000货款，并欠CRA $25,000未缴的工资代扣税款。如果CRA在2026年6月15日试图对Victor个人进行追责评税，法律结果是什么？

opts.t: He owes neither: limited liability covers the $80,000 trade debt, and more than two years have passed since he resigned as a director.
opts.w: 正确。公司的有限责任保护股东和董事不对$80,000商业货款承担个人责任；而对于$25,000代扣税款连带责任，根据ITA s.227.1(4)，追责时效为卸任董事之日起2年，2024年3月1日至2026年6月15日已超过2年。

opts.t: Victor must pay both the $80,000 commercial supplier debt and the $25,000 CRA payroll tax debt personally.
opts.w: 普通商业供应商债务受公司有限责任隔绝，且代扣税款追责已超过卸任后2年的法定时效。

opts.t: Victor is protected from the CRA payroll tax debt immediately upon resigning, without any waiting period.
opts.w: 卸任董事并不会立刻免除在任期间发生的代扣税款责任，必须等到卸任满2年后才过追责时效。

opts.t: Victor remains personally liable for the $25,000 payroll tax debt because there is no statutory time limit on director's liability.
opts.w: 《所得税法》s.227.1(4)明确规定了卸任董事之日起2年的追责时效。

variants.pt: T2申报截止日与欠税到期日的时间差
variants.trap: 忽略「报表晚、欠税早」的时间差
variants.stem: Hannah incorporated a BC holding company in 2025, opened a bank account, and then left the company completely inactive with $0 revenue throughout its 2026 tax year. Which statement is correct regarding the company's 2026 T2 Corporation Income Tax Return?
variants.zh: Hannah在2025年注册了一家BC省公司，开了银行账户后在整个2026税年里完全没有任何业务活动，收入为$0。关于该公司2026税年的T2公司所得税申报表，哪项表述是正确的？

opts.t: She does not need to file a T2 return because the corporation had zero revenue and no active operations in 2026.
opts.w: 讲义明确指出，「今年公司没什么生意，先不报」不是合法选项；无活动、不赚钱的公司同样必须按年报T2。

opts.t: She must still file a T2 within six months of year-end, because every resident corporation files yearly unless it falls in a narrow exempt group.
opts.w: 正确。无论当年有无经营活动或盈利，所有加拿大居民公司每个税年都必须在年结后6个月内申报T2，唯三例外是免税的王室公司、Hutterite群体与全年注册慈善机构。

opts.t: She only needs to pay the $43.39 BC Annual Report fee, which automatically replaces the federal T2 tax return for inactive companies.
opts.w: BC省的Annual Report（$43.39）是公司注册处的年度维持申报，不能替代向CRA提交的T2所得税申报表。

opts.t: She can report the inactive corporation's status on her personal T1 Form T2125 instead of filing a separate T2 return.
opts.w: 公司是独立纳税人，绝不能并入个人的T1或T2125表申报。

variants.pt: 联邦注册与BC省内注册的费用及省外注册
variants.trap: 忽略仅在BC一省经营时联邦注册须叠加「省外注册费」
variants.stem: An e-commerce brand plans to operate warehouses in three provinces and wants nationwide corporate name protection across Canada. Aside from initial registration fees, how do the ongoing annual corporate maintenance filing fees compare between federal incorporation (online) and BC provincial incorporation?
variants.zh: 一家电商品牌计划在三个省份设立仓库，并希望获得覆盖全加拿大的全国公司名称保护。除首次注册费外，联邦注册（网上）与BC省内注册的年度维持申报费用相比如何？

opts.t: Both federal and BC corporations pay an identical $30 annual maintenance fee.
opts.w: $30是BC省注册时的名称核准费（name approval fee），不是年度维持费。

opts.t: A federal corporation pays $380 every year, while a BC corporation pays $200 every year.
opts.w: $200和$380是首次注册费，不是每年的年度申报维持费。

opts.t: A federal corporation pays $12 per year online for its Annual Return, while a BC corporation pays $43.39 per year for its Annual Report.
opts.w: 正确。联邦公司每年网上提交Annual Return只需$12，而BC省内公司每年提交Annual Report需$43.39；跨多省经营且需要全国名称保护时，联邦注册更有价值。

opts.t: Neither jurisdiction charges any annual fee at all, as long as the corporation files its T2 return on time with the CRA.
opts.w: 向CRA报T2不能免除公司注册处的年度维持费（Annual Return / Annual Report），不交年报费可能导致公司失去良好状态（good standing）甚至被强制解散。

variants.pt: 终身资本利得豁免与QSBCS股份条件
variants.trap: 误以为独资出售资产也能用终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）
variants.stem: For the 2026 tax year (after indexation resumed), what are the maximum lifetime capital gains exemption (LCGE) limit and the corresponding maximum taxable capital gains deduction for disposing of qualified small business corporation shares (QSBCS)?
variants.zh: 在恢复指数化后的2026税年，处置合格小企业公司股份（QSBCS）适用的终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）上限及对应的最高应税资本利得扣除上限分别是多少？

opts.t: An exemption limit of $1,016,836 and a deduction limit of $508,418.
opts.w: $1,016,836是2024年6月25日之前的旧豁免限额，不是2026税年的现行数字。

opts.t: An exemption limit of $500,000 and a deduction limit of $250,000.
opts.w: $500,000是小企业扣除（SBD）的年度活跃经营业务限额（business limit），不是终身资本利得豁免额。

opts.t: An exemption limit of $1,275,000 and a corresponding deduction limit of $637,500.
opts.w: 正确。终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）在2024-06-25提高到$1,250,000，2026税年恢复指数化后升至$1,275,000，对应扣除上限为$637,500。

opts.t: An exemption limit of $1,250,000 with no indexation adjustment in 2026.

variants.pt: 被动收入递减与分拆收入税三道防线
variants.trap: 误以为小企业$500,000低税率限额无条件固定不变
variants.stem: Which three anti-avoidance mechanisms does the Income Tax Act use to prevent taxpayers from artificially splitting income or hoarding investment assets inside a CCPC to abuse the 11% small business rate?
variants.zh: 《所得税法》使用哪三道防滥用机制来防止纳税人通过人为分拆收入或在CCPC内部囤积投资资产来滥用11%的小企业低税率？

opts.t: Extra-provincial registration fees, mandatory GIFI schedules, and the 53-week year-end rule.
opts.w: 省外注册费、GIFI附表和53周年结日规则属于日常行政与报税程序，不是防止滥用低税率的反避税防线。

opts.t: Dividend gross-up, dividend tax credit (DTC), and the federal abatement of 10 percentage points.
opts.w: 毛额化、股息税收抵免和10%联邦省份减让是计算正常税负与税收整合的基础机制，不是防滥用防线。

opts.t: The passive income grind ($50,000 to $150,000), the tax on split income (TOSI), and the personal services business (PSB) rules.
opts.w: 正确。讲义第1.4节明确列出围绕活跃经营低税率的三道防线：被动收入递减（passive income grind，$50,000起、$150,000归零）、分拆收入税（TOSI）、以及个人服务业务（PSB）。

opts.t: The lifetime capital gains exemption (LCGE), the section 85 rollover, and the three-month balance-due extension.
opts.w: LCGE、第85条转让（s.85 rollover）和3个月欠税宽限期都是对符合条件纳税人的优惠或递延机制，而非反避税惩罚防线。

variants.pt: CCPC身份判定与丧失身份后果
variants.trap: 忽视事实控制或控制权变更触发视同年结
variants.stem: Tech Co. is a Canadian private corporation whose voting shares are held 60% by two Canadian residents and 40% by a public corporation listed on a designated stock exchange. However, under a unanimous agreement and debt covenant, the public corporation has the legal and practical power to appoint a majority of the board of directors. Does Tech Co. qualify as a CCPC for 2026?
variants.zh: Tech Co. 是一家加拿大私人公司，其表决权股份由两名加拿大居民持有 60%，一家在指定证券交易所上市的公众公司持有 40%。但根据一致协议和债务契约，该公众公司拥有任命董事会多数席位的法律与实际权力。Tech Co. 在 2026 年是否符合 CCPC 资格？

opts.t: Yes, because Canadian residents hold more than 50% of the voting shares, which satisfies the de jure control test.
opts.w: 错误。CCPC 定义中的「控制」不仅看表决权多数的法律控制（de jure control），还包括事实上的控制（de facto control）；不能只看 60% 的表面持股比例。

opts.t: Yes, because none of Tech Co.'s own shares are listed on a designated stock exchange.
opts.w: 错误。虽然公司自身股份未上市，但 CCPC 的三条否定条件还包括「不得被公众公司控制」；踩中三条否定中的任何一条即丧失 CCPC 资格。

opts.t: Yes, but its $500,000 federal business limit must be reduced by 40% to reflect the public corporation's ownership share.
opts.w: 错误。CCPC 是一个非黑即白的开关，不存在按公众公司持股比例打折享受小企业扣除（SBD）的规则。

opts.t: No, because control includes de facto control, and a public corporation that can appoint most of the board controls it in fact.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.125(7) 及 CRA 口径，CCPC 判定中的控制既包括法律控制（de jure control）也包括事实控制（de facto control）；公众公司虽然只持股 40%，但实际能左右董事会，构成事实控制，因此该公司不是 CCPC，无法享受 9% 联邦低税率、2% BC 省低税率及三个月欠税宽限期。

variants.pt: 短税年经营限额摊分与SBD计算
variants.trap: 短税年不摊经营限额或把$500,000当免税额
variants.stem: Bakery Co., an unassociated CCPC in BC, had a 73-day short tax year in 2026 due to an approved change of fiscal year-end. During this 73-day period, it earned $120,000 of Canadian active business income (equal to its taxable income), with no business limit reductions. What is its federal small business deduction (SBD) for this 73-day tax year?
variants.zh: Bakery Co. 是卑诗省一家无联营关系的 CCPC，因获批变更年结日在 2026 年产生了一个 73 天的短税年。在这 73 天内，它赚取了 $120,000 的加拿大境内经营活动收入（等于其应税收入），且无限额递减。该 73 天短税年的联邦小企业扣除（SBD）是多少？

opts.t: $22,800, calculated as 19% of the full $120,000 of active business income earned in the short year.
$95,000, calculated as 19% of the full $500,000 statutory business limit for the year.
opts.w: 错误。既没有按 73 ÷ 365 缩减短税年经营限额，也没有遵循「四数取最小」原则。

opts.t: $19,000, because the limit is prorated to $100,000 ($500,000 × 73 ÷ 365), the least of the four amounts.
$9,000, calculated as 9% of the $100,000 prorated business limit for the 73 days.
opts.w: 错误。$9,000（9% × $100,000）是限额内收入扣除 SBD 后的联邦应缴税额，而联邦 SBD 扣除额本身应按 19% 计算，即 $19,000。

variants.pt: 两条限额递减取大者与2022 年前旧规则
variants.trap: 把两条限额递减相加或混淆$15M与$50M归零点
variants.stem: Holding Co., an unassociated CCPC, had $12,000,000 of taxable capital employed in Canada and $90,000 of adjusted aggregate investment income (AAII) in its preceding tax year. Under the current 2026 tax-year rules, what is its reduced federal business limit for 2026?
variants.zh: Holding Co. 是一家无联营关系的 CCPC，上一税年在加拿大使用的应税资本为 $12,000,000，调整后合计投资收入（AAII）为 $90,000。按 2026 税年现行规则，其 2026 年递减后的联邦经营限额是多少？

opts.t: $275,000, by subtracting both the $25,000 taxable capital reduction and the $200,000 passive income reduction from $500,000.
opts.w: 错误。把应税资本递减 $25,000 与被动收入递减 $200,000 直接相加了；两条递减必须取大者，不能叠加扣除。

opts.t: $300,000, because the $200,000 passive income reduction is greater than the $25,000 taxable capital reduction, and only the greater applies.
$475,000, because the corporation can elect to apply the smaller $25,000 taxable capital reduction.
opts.w: 错误。税法规定两条递减取大者（greater of），纳税人不能自行选择较小的递减额。

opts.t: $0, because any AAII above $50,000 immediately eliminates the entire $500,000 business limit.
opts.w: 错误。被动收入（AAII）从 $50,000 起每超 $1 削减 $5 限额，要到 $150,000 时才会把 $500,000 限额全部归零，$90,000 只削减 $200,000。

variants.pt: 亲属持股联营判定与Schedule 23
variants.trap: 误以为配偶各开一家公司就自动联营
variants.stem: Alpha Corp. (100% owned by Sister A) and Beta Corp. (100% owned by Sister B) have no cross-ownership between the sisters, so they would not normally be associated. However, both Alpha Corp. and Beta Corp. are associated with a third corporation, Gamma Corp. Gamma Corp. files a Schedule 28 election not to be associated with Alpha and Beta for purposes of connecting them. What is the statutory price of filing this Schedule 28 election?
variants.zh: Alpha Corp.（由姐姐 A 100% 持有）和 Beta Corp.（由妹妹 B 100% 持有）之间没有任何交叉持股，本来不联营。但 Alpha 和 Beta 都与第三家公司 Gamma Corp. 联营。Gamma Corp. 提交了 Schedule 28 选择表，选择不作为穿透桥梁使 Alpha 与 Beta 联营。提交这张 Schedule 28 选择表的法定代价是什么？

opts.t: Investment income received from Gamma Corp. that would otherwise be treated as active business income can no longer qualify for the small business deduction.
opts.w: 正确。第六条联营规则是穿透第三家公司（A 与 B 都和 C 联营，则 A 与 B 视为联营）；若第三家公司 C 提交 Schedule 28 切断穿透联营，代价是从 C 那里流过来的、原本被视为经营收入的投资收入不能享受小企业扣除（SBD）。

opts.t: Alpha Corp. and Beta Corp. must each pay a flat $1,000 election penalty under ITA s.162(7.2) for every year the election stays in force.
opts.w: 错误。$1,000 罚款是 ITA s.162(7.2) 针对「应电子申报 T2 而未电子申报」的处罚，与 Schedule 28 无关。

opts.t: Alpha Corp. and Beta Corp. both lose their CCPC status for the year and can no longer claim the BC 2% small business rate on any income.
opts.w: 错误。提交 Schedule 28 的目的正是让 Alpha 和 Beta 保持不联营从而各自享受 CCPC 的 SBD 限额，不会导致丧失 CCPC 身份。

opts.t: There is no tax cost at all, because Schedule 28 is purely an informational form, filed in the same way as the Schedule 50 shareholder list.
opts.w: 错误。Schedule 50 是持股 10% 以上股东信息表，而 Schedule 28 是具有明确税务代价的法定选择表（切断穿透后，来自该公司的视同经营投资收入不得享 SBD）。

variants.pt: 四个截止时点与季度分期预缴资格
variants.trap: 混淆申报日与欠税日或算错首期预缴日
variants.stem: Logistics Co. has a March 31, 2026 fiscal year-end. Its total Part I corporate tax payable was $2,400 in 2025 and $9,600 in 2026. It is not a CCPC because it is controlled by a non-resident parent company. What are its 2026 balance-due day, its 2026 T2 filing deadline, and was it required to make tax instalments during its 2026 tax year?
variants.zh: Logistics Co. 的会计年结日为 2026 年 3 月 31 日。其 Part I 应缴公司税在 2025 年为 $2,400，在 2026 年为 $9,600。由于受非居民母公司控制，它不是 CCPC。其 2026 税年的欠税截止日、T2 申报截止日分别是哪天？在 2026 税年期间它是否需要分期预缴？

opts.t: Balance due May 31, 2026 (no CCPC extension), T2 due September 30, 2026, and no instalments for 2026 because 2025 tax was $2,400.
opts.w: 正确。非 CCPC 不享三个月宽限，欠税截止日（balance-due day）为年结后 2 个月（2026 年 5 月 31 日）；年结落在月末（3 月 31 日），申报截止日为第 6 个月的月末（2026 年 9 月 30 日）；分期预缴规则是「上一年或本年任一年税额不超过 $3,000 即免分期」，由于 2025 年税额仅 $2,400（不超过 $3,000），故 2026 年免于分期预缴。

opts.t: Balance-due day is June 30, 2026 (3 months after year-end), T2 filing deadline is September 30, 2026, and monthly instalments were required in 2026 because 2026 tax exceeded $3,000.
opts.w: 错误。该公司不是 CCPC，欠税截止日只有 2 个月（5 月 31 日）而非 3 个月；且只要上一年或本年任一年不超过 $3,000 即可免分期，2025 年为 $2,400，因此 2026 年无需分期预缴。

opts.t: Balance-due day and T2 filing deadline are both September 30, 2026, and quarterly instalments were required in 2026.
opts.w: 错误。欠税截止日是 5 月 31 日而非 9 月 30 日，且非 CCPC 绝无按季度分期预缴的资格。

opts.t: Balance-due day is May 31, 2026, T2 filing deadline is December 31, 2026, and instalments were required because the two-year average tax exceeded $3,000.
opts.w: 错误。T2 申报截止日是年结后 6 个月（9 月 30 日）而非年底；且 $3,000 门槛不看两年平均值，而是看上一年或本年任一年是否不超过 $3,000。

variants.pt: 迟报罚基数与重犯升级机制
variants.trap: 把迟报罚基数当成税款总额而非未缴税款
variants.stem: Repair Co. had $20,000 of unpaid corporate tax on its T2 filing deadline and filed its return 6 full months late. The CRA had issued a formal demand to file, and Repair Co. had already been assessed a late-filing penalty on a prior T2 return within the preceding 3 tax years. What late-filing penalty applies?
variants.zh: Repair Co. 在 T2 申报截止日有 $20,000 未缴公司税，且迟交报表满 6 个整月。CRA 此前已向其发出正式申报要求（demand to file），且该公司在前 3 个税年内曾因迟报被处以过迟报罚。此次应适用多少迟报罚款？

opts.t: $2,200, calculated at the standard rate of 5% plus 1% per month for 6 months (11% of $20,000).
opts.w: 错误。5% 加每月 1% 是首犯费率；该公司已收到 CRA 申报要求且前三年内有过迟报受罚记录，触发了重犯翻倍罚则。

opts.t: $4,400, calculated at the repeat-offender rate of 10% plus 2% per full month for 6 months (22% of the $20,000 unpaid tax).
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.162(2)，当 CRA 已发出申报要求且公司在前三年内曾因迟报被罚过时，迟报罚升级为未缴税款的 10% 加每满一个整月 2%（最多 20 个月，封顶 50%）。迟报 6 个整月即 10% ＋ 2% × 6 ＝ 22%，罚款 ＝ $20,000 × (10% ＋ 2% × 6) ＝ $4,400。

opts.t: $10,000, because any repeat late filing automatically triggers a flat 50% penalty regardless of how many months late the return is.
opts.w: 错误。50% 是重犯迟报满 20 个月时的封顶上限（10% ＋ 2% × 20 ＝ 50%），迟报 6 个整月按 22% 计算，不是直接按 50% 一刀切。

opts.t: $3,400, because late-filing penalties for corporations are always capped at 17% of unpaid tax.
opts.w: 错误。17% 只是首犯的封顶比例（5% ＋ 1% × 12），重犯罚则的封顶比例是 50%。

variants.pt: 整合机制与BC省2026新投资抵免
variants.trap: 混淆非合资格与合资格股息放大率或把抵免当费用扣除
variants.stem: Why does the lecture describe the Small Business Deduction (SBD) as a tax deferral rather than a permanent tax reduction under Canada's corporate-personal tax integration system?
variants.zh: 在加拿大公司税与个人税的整合（integration）制度下，为什么讲义将小企业扣除（SBD）的本质描述为「税款递延（tax deferral）」而非「永久减免」？

opts.t: Because the CRA requires every CCPC to repay its accumulated SBD in cash to the federal government at the end of its tenth fiscal year.
opts.w: 错误。SBD 是非退还的税额扣减，只要利润留在公司内部不分配，并没有「满十年向政府现金退还 SBD」的规定。

opts.t: Because the SBD is a refundable tax credit that must be added back to taxable income on Schedule 1 in the following tax year.
opts.w: 错误。SBD 是非退还（non-refundable）税额扣减，只能把应缴税减到零，减不出退税，也不会在次年 Schedule 1 加回公司应税收入。

opts.t: Because the low-taxed profit is later paid out as non-eligible dividends, grossed up 15% with a 9/13 credit, so total tax ends up roughly as if earned personally.
opts.w: 正确。在整合（integration）机制下，用了 SBD 享 11% 低税率的利润分红时属于非合资格股息（放大 15%、联邦抵免为放大部分的 9/13），而按 27% 一般税率交过税的利润分红时属于合资格股息（放大 38%、联邦抵免为放大部分的 6/11）。公司在前面少交的税，股东在分红那一天要多补回来，两级合计约等于个人直接赚取该笔收入的税负，所以 SBD 真正给的是把个人层面补税推迟到分红日的递延优势。

opts.t: Because integration guarantees that corporate retention followed by dividend distribution produces the exact same tax to the penny as paying a salary in every province and every year.
opts.w: 错误。由于联邦抵免率全国统一而各省税率不同，整合永远只是「约等于（近似）」，不同省份、不同年份走「留存分红」与「发工资」会相差几个百分点，任何声称开公司一定省税或一定与发工资分毫不差的说法都是错误的。

variants.pt: AII与AAII的四项口径调整
variants.trap: AII与AAII口径混用
variants.stem: In 2026, Oakridge Logistics Inc., a CCPC, earns $40,000 of net rental income from a warehouse leased to an unrelated tenant, realizes an $80,000 capital gain ($40,000 taxable capital gain) from selling delivery trucks used exclusively in its active freight business, and receives $15,000 of taxable dividends from public Canadian corporations. What are Oakridge's AII and AAII for 2026?
variants.zh: 2026 税年，一家 CCPC（Oakridge Logistics Inc.）从出租给非关联租户的仓库赚取净租金收入 $40,000，出售专门用于其积极货运业务的送货卡车实现资本利得 $80,000（应税资本利得 $40,000），并收到加拿大上市公司的应税股息 $15,000。Oakridge 在 2026 税年的 AII 和 AAII 分别是多少？

opts.t: AII is $55,000 and AAII is $80,000.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了『AII与AAII口径混用』陷阱，把两个口径的计算规则反过来套用，导致结果颠倒。

opts.t: AII is $80,000 and AAII is $95,000.
opts.w: 错误。计算 AAII 时加回了 $15,000 非联结公司股息，但漏了剔除出售货运卡车（经营性资产 active asset）的 $40,000 应税资本利得。

opts.t: AII is $80,000 and AAII is $55,000.
opts.w: 正确。合计投资收入（AII）＝ 净租金 $40,000 ＋ 应税资本利得 $40,000 ＝ $80,000（不含按 s.112 扣除的股息）；调整后合计投资收入（AAII）剔除处置经营性资产（active asset）的 $40,000 应税资本利得，并加回非联结公司（non-connected）股息 $15,000，即 $40,000 ＋ $15,000 ＝ $55,000。

opts.t: AII is $40,000 and AAII is $40,000.
opts.w: 错误。AII 必须包含所有应税资本利得（无论是否属于经营性资产），而 AAII 必须加回非联结公司的组合股息 $15,000。

variants.pt: 被动收入递减跨年计算与省税联动
variants.trap: 被动收入递减错算当年或全额乘5
variants.stem: Northshore Engineering Inc. is a BC CCPC with a December 31 year-end and no associated corporations. In 2025, it sold an idle rental lot and reported adjusted aggregate investment income (AAII) of $110,000. In 2026, it has $0 of passive income and $500,000 of active business income. What is Northshore's remaining small business deduction business limit for 2026, and how much additional combined federal and BC tax does it owe in 2026 as a result of the 2025 AAII?
variants.zh: Northshore Engineering Inc. 是一家年结日为 12 月 31 日、无联营公司的卑诗省 CCPC。2025 年，该公司出售了一块闲置出租地块，报告调整后合计投资收入（AAII）为 $110,000。2026 年，其被动收入为 $0，积极经营收入为 $500,000。Northshore 在 2026 税年剩余的小企业扣除经营限额是多少？受 2025 年 AAII 影响，其 2026 年需多交多少联邦与卑诗省合计公司税？

opts.t: The remaining 2026 business limit is $200,000, and additional combined tax is $48,000.
The remaining 2026 business limit is $500,000, and additional combined tax is $0, because passive income returned to zero in 2026.
opts.w: 错误。递减看的是上一历年内结束税年（2025 年）的 AAII，即使 2026 年被动收入回到零，2025 年的一次性利得仍会在 2026 年削掉 $300,000 限额。

opts.t: The remaining 2026 business limit is $0, and additional combined tax is $80,000, because $110,000 multiplied by 5 exceeds $500,000.
opts.w: 错误。错把 $110,000 全额乘以 5；只有超过 $50,000 的部分才乘以 5，AAII 要到 $150,000 时经营限额才会归零。

opts.t: The remaining 2026 business limit is $200,000, and additional combined tax is $18,000, reflecting only the 6% federal rate difference.
opts.w: 错误。漏算了卑诗省同步削减限额带来的 10% 省税差额（12% 一般率减 2% 小企业率）。

variants.pt: Part IV税与联结公司双10%判据
variants.trap: 联结与联营判据张冠李戴
variants.stem: Harbour Ventures Inc. (a CCPC) holds shares of Cascade Tech Ltd. (a CCPC) that carry 12% of the voting rights, but because of a large class of preferred shares held by other investors, Harbour's shares represent only 8% of the total fair market value of all issued shares of Cascade Tech. The owners of the two companies are siblings. In 2026, Harbour receives a $100,000 eligible dividend from Cascade Tech, which received no dividend refund on the payment. How much Part IV tax must Harbour Ventures pay?
variants.zh: Harbour Ventures Inc.（一家 CCPC）持有 Cascade Tech Ltd.（一家 CCPC）12% 表决权的股份，但由于其他投资者持有大量优先股，Harbour 所持股份仅占 Cascade Tech 已发行全部股份总市值的 8%。两家公司的股东是亲兄妹。2026 年，Harbour 从 Cascade Tech 收到 $100,000 合资格股息，Cascade Tech 就该次派息未获得任何股息退税。Harbour Ventures 必须缴纳多少 Part IV 税？

opts.t: $0, because the owners are siblings and the voting-share stake is above the 10% threshold.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了『联结与联营判据张冠李戴』陷阱：亲属关系用于判断联营（associated），而联结（connected）的第二条路径要求同时满足『>10% 表决权』且『>10% 总市值』两个条件（ITA s.186(4)）。

opts.t: $38,333, because the 8% value stake fails the connected test, so full 38⅓% Part IV tax applies.
opts.w: 正确。不具控制权（>50% 表决权）时，构成联结公司（connected corporation）必须同时满足持有 >10% 表决权股本且占全部股份 >10% 市值（ITA s.186(4)）。Harbour 只占总市值 8%，不是联结公司，付款方有没有股息退税都不影响，按 38⅓% 全额课 Part IV 税：$100,000 × 38⅓% ＝ $38,333。

opts.t: $30,667, at the 30⅔% refundable rate, because the value stake is below the 10% threshold.
opts.w: 错误。30⅔% 是 Part I 税对利息、租金等 AII 的可退还比例，而公司间股息适用的是 38⅓% 的 Part IV 税率。

opts.t: $0, because eligible dividends a CCPC receives from another CCPC are exempt from Part IV tax.
opts.w: 错误。来自非联结公司的应税股息无论是合资格股息（eligible dividend）还是非合资格股息，均须按 38⅓% 缴纳 Part IV 税（区别仅在于进 ERDTOH 还是 NERDTOH）。

variants.pt: 双池RDTOH掏池顺序与退税计算
variants.trap: 双池RDTOH退税方向搞反
variants.stem: At the end of 2026, Bayside Properties Inc., a CCPC that earns only rental and interest income, has an ERDTOH balance of $0 and a NERDTOH balance of $30,667. The corporation also has a general rate income pool (GRIP) balance of $80,000 from prior years' high-rate business income. In 2026, Bayside pays an $80,000 dividend and designates the entire amount as an eligible dividend. How much dividend refund will Bayside receive for 2026?
variants.zh: 2026 年末，仅赚取租金和利息收入的 CCPC（Bayside Properties Inc.）账上 ERDTOH 余额为 $0，NERDTOH 余额为 $30,667；同时该公司因早年按一般税率纳税的经营利润而拥有 $80,000 的一般税率收入池（GRIP）余额。2026 年，Bayside 派发了 $80,000 股息，并将其全额指定为合资格股息。Bayside 在 2026 税年能拿到多少股息退税？

opts.t: $0, because an eligible dividend can only trigger a refund out of ERDTOH, which has a zero balance.
opts.w: 正确。根据双池 RDTOH 规则（ITA s.129(1)），派发合资格股息（eligible dividend）只能从合资格池（ERDTOH）申请退税，不能动用非合资格池（NERDTOH）。由于 ERDTOH 余额为 $0，即便公司有充足的 GRIP 和 $30,667 的 NERDTOH，本次派息的股息退税也是 $0。

opts.t: $30,667, because the corporation has sufficient GRIP to support the $80,000 eligible dividend designation.
opts.w: 错误。GRIP 只能保证公司派发合资格股息不触发 20% 的 Part III.1 超额指定罚税，但不能让合资格股息去掏 NERDTOH 的钱。

opts.t: $24,533, calculated as 30⅔% of the $80,000 dividend paid.
opts.w: 错误。股息退税率是 38⅓% 而非 30⅔%，且合资格股息无法动用 NERDTOH，退税额应为 $0。

opts.t: $15,333, because half of NERDTOH can be refunded when GRIP is reduced to zero.
opts.w: 错误。税法中没有『GRIP 清零即可退一半 NERDTOH』的规定；要拿回 NERDTOH，必须派发非合资格股息（non-eligible dividend）。

variants.pt: CDA超额派发60%罚税与补救条件
variants.trap: 资本股息超额与迟报后果混淆
variants.stem: On March 15, 2026, Silver Birch Ltd., a private corporation, verified with the CRA via Schedule 89 that its capital dividend account (CDA) balance was $80,000. On March 20, 2026, it filed Form T2054 and paid an $80,000 capital dividend to its sole shareholder. In October 2026 (within the same tax year), Silver Birch sold publicly traded shares and realized a $60,000 capital loss ($30,000 non-allowable half). What is the Part III tax consequence for the March 20, 2026 capital dividend?
variants.zh: 2026 年 3 月 15 日，私人公司 Silver Birch Ltd. 通过 Schedule 89 向 CRA 核实其资本股息账户（CDA）余额为 $80,000。2026 年 3 月 20 日，该公司提交 T2054 表格并向唯一股东派发了 $80,000 资本股息。2026 年 10 月（同一税年内），Silver Birch 出售上市股票并实现了 $60,000 资本亏损（不可抵扣的一半为 $30,000）。2026 年 3 月 20 日那笔资本股息的 Part III 税后果是什么？

opts.t: The corporation owes $18,000 of Part III tax (60% of $30,000) because CDA is calculated at the end of the tax year.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了『年末才算 CDA 余额』的陷阱：年末计算的是 GRIP，而 CDA 余额是累计到『股息成为应付或实际支付那一刻』计算的。

opts.t: The corporation owes $0 of Part III tax because the CDA balance is tested immediately before the dividend becomes payable, not at year-end.
opts.w: 正确。资本股息账户（capital dividend account, CDA）是从公司最后一次成为私人公司起累计到『派息那一刻』的通知账户，而非年末结算账户。既然 2026 年 3 月 20 日派息前一刻 CDA 确有 $80,000 余额，该次资本股息选择完全有效；同年 10 月后来才发生的资本亏损只会冲减以后的 CDA 可派余额，不会追溯导致 3 月的派息超额。

opts.t: The corporation must file a s.184(3) election within 90 days of year-end to reclassify $30,000 as an ordinary dividend.
opts.w: 错误。因为 3 月派息时并未超额，根本不产生 Part III 税，无需走 s.184(3) 的补救选择。

opts.t: The $30,000 non-allowable capital loss reduces the corporation's life insurance CDA component and triggers a 20% penalty.
opts.w: 错误。资本亏损不可扣的一半只冲减由资本利得形成的那部分 CDA（减至零为止），不冲减寿险赔款形成的额度，且不会触发 20% 罚款。

variants.pt: GRIP年末结算与超额指定罚税
variants.trap: 把LRIP当CCPC账户或漏记GRIP年末回看
variants.stem: In June 2026, Pacific Timber Ltd., a CCPC with a December 31 year-end, pays a $100,000 dividend and records a resolution in its board minutes notifying the shareholder that the entire dividend is an eligible dividend. At that time, its GRIP balance from 2025 was $0, as it expected high-rate income in the second half of 2026. Due to a market downturn, its 2026 year-end GRIP turns out to be only $40,000 (with no abusive tax avoidance). What is the consequence?
variants.zh: 2026 年 6 月，年结日为 12 月 31 日的 CCPC（Pacific Timber Ltd.）派发了 $100,000 股息，并在董事会纪要中记录决议，书面通知股东该股息全额为合资格股息。当时其承接自 2025 年的 GRIP 余额为 $0，因为公司预计 2026 年下半年会有按一般税率纳税的收入。由于市场下滑，其 2026 年末计算的 GRIP 最终只有 $40,000（无滥用避税安排）。后果是什么？

opts.t: The entire $100,000 designation attracts the 20% Part III.1 tax, because GRIP was $0 on the June payment date.
opts.w: 错误。GRIP 在年末才结算，年中可以先派合资格股息，只要年末有足够的 GRIP 即可覆盖；因此 $40,000 部分有效，只有超出的 $60,000 属于超额指定。

opts.t: $60,000 is an excessive designation taxed at 20% ($12,000), removable if the shareholder consents to treat it as non-eligible.
opts.w: 正确。年末回看时已派合资格股息（$100,000）超出年末 GRIP（$40,000）的 $60,000 构成超额合资格股息指定（excessive eligible dividend designation，Schedule 55），适用 20% 的 Part III.1 税（$12,000）；因为不涉及人为拉高 GRIP（30% 档），该 20% 罚税可经股东同意将超额部分改按普通（非合资格）股息处理来化解（ITA s.185.1）。

opts.t: A 30% Part III.1 tax ($18,000) applies, since paying an eligible dividend before GRIP is earned is treated as artificial.
opts.w: 错误。年中先派、等年末算 GRIP 是税法允许的正常时点机制，不属于人为拉高 GRIP 的安排，不适用不可豁免的 30% 惩罚档。

opts.t: The corporation owes $36,000 (60% of the $60,000 excess) under Part III unless it files Form T2054 within 90 days.
opts.w: 错误。60% 的 Part III 税和 T2054 表格针对的是资本股息账户（CDA），与 GRIP 和合资格股息无关。

variants.pt: 两条递减取大者与现行应税资本区间
variants.trap: 两条递减相加或套用旧区间
variants.stem: In 2025, Fraser Valley Corp. changed its fiscal year-end with CRA approval, resulting in two tax years ending in the 2025 calendar year: the first had AAII of $35,000 and taxable capital of $4,000,000; the second had AAII of $45,000 and taxable capital of $5,000,000. How is Fraser Valley's 2026 small business deduction business limit affected by the passive income grind?
variants.zh: 2025 年，Fraser Valley Corp. 经 CRA 批准变更了财政年结日，导致在 2025 历年内有两个税年结束：第一个税年的 AAII 为 $35,000、应税资本为 $4,000,000；第二个税年的 AAII 为 $45,000、应税资本为 $5,000,000。Fraser Valley 在 2026 税年的小企业扣除经营限额受被动收入递减的影响是多少？

opts.t: The 2026 business limit is reduced by $0 because only the immediately preceding tax year's AAII ($45,000) is counted, which is under $50,000.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了计量期混淆陷阱：只看『上一个税年（preceding tax year）』的是应税资本递减（s.125(5.1)(a)），而被动收入递减（s.125(5.1)(b)）看的是『在上一历年内结束的每一个税年』的 AAII 合计。

opts.t: The 2026 business limit is reduced by $0 because neither tax year in 2025 individually exceeded the $50,000 AAII threshold.
opts.w: 错误。$50,000 门槛是针对上一历年内结束的所有税年的 AAII 加总数（$35,000 ＋ $45,000 ＝ $80,000），不是每个短税年各自享有一个 $50,000。

opts.t: The 2026 business limit is reduced by $150,000 because the AAII of all tax years ending in the preceding calendar year must be totalled ($80,000).
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.125(5.1)(b)，被动收入递减公式中的 E 计量的是公司在『上一历年内结束的每一个税年（all taxation years ending in the preceding calendar year）』的 AAII 总和。因此 2025 历年内结束的两个税年的 AAII 必须相加（$35,000 ＋ $45,000 ＝ $80,000），削减 2026 年经营限额 ($80,000 − $50,000) × 5 ＝ $150,000。

opts.t: The 2026 business limit is reduced by $400,000 because both the AAII ($80,000) and the taxable capital ($9,000,000) of the two tax years are combined.
opts.w: 错误。即便把两个税年的 AAII 加总为 $80,000，乘以 5 的也只是超出 $50,000 的 $30,000 部分（削 $150,000），且应税资本递减只取上一税年（不把两个税年的应税资本相加）。

variants.pt: 赚取收入与三项法定资格
variants.trap: 股息计入赚取收入陷阱
variants.stem: Sonia owns 100% of a BC graphic design CCPC. In 2026, her corporation has $150,000 of pre-tax profit eligible for the small business deduction. She wants to create exactly $12,600 of new RRSP contribution room for 2027 and qualify to deduct her toddler's daycare fees as the lower-income spouse. What must she do?
variants.zh: Sonia 100% 持有一家卑诗省平面设计 CCPC。2026 年公司有 $150,000 符合小企业扣除条件的税前利润。她希望为 2027 年创造恰好 $12,600 的新增 RRSP 供款额度，并作为低收入一方具备扣除幼儿托儿费的资格。她必须怎么做？

opts.t: Pay herself $70,000 in non-eligible dividends and retain the remaining profit inside the corporation.
opts.w: 落入股息计入赚取收入陷阱。非合资格股息（non-eligible dividend）不属于赚取收入（earned income），发 $70,000 分红产生的 RRSP 额度和托儿费扣除基数均为 $0。

opts.t: Pay herself a $60,870 non-eligible dividend so that the 15% gross-up brings her taxable dividend to $70,000.
opts.w: 落入股息计入赚取收入陷阱。无论股息是否经过 15% 毛额化（dividend gross-up），股息都不计入 ITA s.146(1) 或 s.63(3) 的赚取收入。

opts.t: Leave all $150,000 inside the corporation and transfer 18% of the corporate after-tax profit directly to her RRSP.
opts.w: 混淆了公司留存利润与个人 RRSP 额度生成机制。个人 RRSP 额度必须凭个人上一年 18% 的赚取收入（earned income）产生，不能用公司留存利润直接生成。

opts.t: Pay herself $70,000 in employment salary, which generates $12,600 of RRSP room (18%) and counts as earned income for childcare.
opts.w: 正确。发放 $70,000 工资属于雇佣所得（赚取收入［earned income］），既可在下一年产生 18% × $70,000 = $12,600 的 RRSP 供款额度，也能提供托儿费扣除所需的赚取收入基数及 CPP 记录。

variants.pt: 股息毛额化与税收抵免计算
variants.trap: 滑单混报与超额合资格股息陷阱
variants.stem: A BC corporation has accumulated income in its General Rate Income Pool (GRIP) that was taxed at the general corporate rate (15% federal plus 12% BC). In 2026, it properly designates and pays an eligible dividend to its shareholder. Which gross-up and dividend tax credit (DTC) rates apply?
variants.zh: 一家卑诗省公司在一般税率收入池（GRIP）中积累了按一般公司税率（联邦 15% 加 BC 省 12%）完税的利润。2026 年公司合规指定并向股东派发一笔合资格股息。适用哪组毛额化与股息税收抵免（DTC）比例？

opts.t: A 38% gross-up, a federal DTC of 6/11 of the gross-up amount, and a BC DTC of 12% of the grossed-up taxable dividend.
opts.w: 正确。从 GRIP 中派发的合资格股息（eligible dividend）按 38% 毛额化（dividend gross-up），联邦股息税收抵免为放大部分的 6/11（ITA s.121），卑诗省 2026 年省级抵免为放大后应税股息的 12%。

opts.t: A 15% gross-up, a federal DTC of 9/13 of the gross-up amount, and a BC DTC of 1.96% of the grossed-up taxable dividend.
opts.w: 错用了非合资格股息（non-eligible dividend）的比例。15% 毛额化、联邦 9/13 与 BC 省 1.96% 适用于享小企业扣除的低税利润分红。

opts.t: A 38% gross-up, a federal DTC of 9/13 of the gross-up amount, and a BC DTC of 12% of the actual cash dividend received.
opts.w: 混用了联邦抵免分数且算错了省级基数。合资格股息的联邦抵免是毛额增量的 6/11（不是 9/13），且 BC 省 12% 抵免乘的是放大后的应税股息而非实际收到的现金。

opts.t: A 27% gross-up matching the combined federal and BC general corporate rate, with a full dollar-for-dollar tax credit.
opts.w: 臆造了毛额化比例。合资格股息的法定毛额化率自 2012 税年起长青固定为 38%（ITA s.82(1)(b)），并非直接按 27% 合计公司税率放大。

variants.pt: 控股股东工资的CPP与EI
variants.trap: 控股股东照常缴EI陷阱
variants.stem: Nadia holds 45% of the voting shares of a BC manufacturing corporation, while two unrelated investors hold the remaining 55%. She works as the general manager and receives a $70,000 salary in 2026. How is her salary treated for Employment Insurance (EI) and CPP purposes?
variants.zh: Nadia 持有一家卑诗省制造公司 45% 的有表决权股份，另外两名无关联投资人持有其余 55%。她担任总经理并在 2026 年领取 $70,000 工资。她的工资在雇佣保险（EI）和 CPP 上如何处理？

opts.t: Subject to both CPP and EI because she holds less than 50% of the voting shares and is not in control.
opts.w: 落入控股股东照常缴 EI 陷阱。《雇佣保险法》s.5(2)(b) 规定的不可保雇佣门槛是控制超过 40% 的有表决权股份，而不是 50%；Nadia 持股 45% 已超过 40% 门槛。

opts.t: Exempt from both CPP and EI because a shareholder with over 40% of the voting shares falls outside payroll rules.
opts.w: 扩大了免除范围。超过 40% 表决权股份只免除雇佣保险（EI），并不免除加拿大退休金计划（CPP）；只要发放工资，雇员与雇主仍须各按 5.95% 缴纳 CPP。

opts.t: Exempt from EI because her stake exceeds 40% of the votes, but she and the corporation each pay 5.95% CPP.
opts.w: 正确。因 Nadia 控制超过 40% 有表决权股份（45% > 40%），按《雇佣保险法》s.5(2)(b) 免缴 EI；但工资依然产生 CPP 可保收入，她本人与公司须各按 5.95% 配缴 CPP。

opts.t: The corporation pays only the 5.95% employer CPP share, and Nadia is exempt from the employee CPP share.
opts.w: 违反了 CPP 对等供款规则。公司发放工资时，雇员与雇主必须各付一份 5.95% 的 CPP（合计 11.9%），雇员不能免缴。

variants.pt: TOSI家庭分红三条排除线
variants.trap: TOSI年龄与工时错配陷阱
variants.stem: Arthur turned 65 in 2026. For the past 30 years, he has been the sole active operator of a BC plumbing CCPC. His spouse, Wendy, age 61, has never worked in the business and owns only non-voting shares worth 2% of the company. If the corporation pays Wendy a $35,000 dividend in 2026, how is it taxed?
variants.zh: Arthur 在 2026 年满 65 岁。过去 30 年里他一直是卑诗省一家水暖工程 CCPC 的唯一实际经营者。他 61 岁的配偶 Wendy 从未在公司工作，且仅持有占公司市值 2% 的无表决权股份。若公司 2026 年向 Wendy 派发 $35,000 分红，该如何课税？

opts.t: At the top marginal tax rate under TOSI because Wendy has not yet reached age 65 and never worked 20 hours per week.
opts.w: 落入 TOSI 年龄与工时错配陷阱。第三条排除线（ITA s.120.4(1.1)(c)）看的是创造收入的业主本人是否年满 65 岁，只要 Arthur 当年满 65 岁，配偶 Wendy 自己几岁不论。

opts.t: At Wendy's graduated marginal tax rates because Arthur is 65 in 2026 and the income would be exempt from TOSI if received by him.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.120.4(1.1)(c) 的业主满 65 岁排除规则，创造收入的业主 Arthur 当年已满 65 岁，且这笔钱若由他本人收取不受 TOSI 限制，那么分给配偶 Wendy 也不受 TOSI 限制，按 Wendy 自己的边际税率课税。

opts.t: At Wendy's graduated marginal tax rates under the excluded shares exception because plumbing is not a professional corporation.
opts.w: 落入 TOSI 年龄与工时错配陷阱。合资格股份（excluded shares）要求收款人同时持有不少于 10% 的表决权与 10% 的市值，Wendy 仅持 2% 无表决权股，无法走合资格股份排除。

opts.t: Disallowed as a deduction to the corporation under the s.67 reasonableness test because Wendy performed no services.
opts.w: 混淆了工资与分红的规则。分红本来就不能在公司层面扣除，不适用针对工资费用的 s.67 合理性测试（reasonableness test）。

variants.trap: 股东贷款免本金即免利息陷阱
variants.stem: Hannah is the sole shareholder of a BC corporation with a June 30 taxation year-end. On August 10, 2025 (during the corporation's fiscal year ending June 30, 2026), she borrows $150,000 at 1% interest for personal use while the CRA prescribed rate is 3%. Assuming this is not part of a series of loans and repayments, what occurs if she repays the full principal on May 15, 2027?
variants.zh: Hannah 是一家年结日为 6 月 30 日的卑诗省公司的唯一股东。2025 年 8 月 10 日（属于截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的公司财年），她按 1% 利率向公司借款 $150,000 用于个人用途，当时 CRA 规定利率为 3%。假设非循环借还，若她在 2027 年 5 月 15 日全额还清本金，会发生什么？

opts.t: The principal escapes s.15(2) as it was repaid before June 30, 2027, but the 2% rate gap is a s.80.4 benefit.
opts.w: 正确。借款发生在截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的公司税年内，在该税年结束后一年内（2027 年 6 月 30 日前）的 2027 年 5 月 15 日还清，免除了 s.15(2) 本金并入；但实付 1% 低于 3% 规定利率（prescribed rate）的 2% 差额仍须按 s.80.4 计为推定利息福利。

opts.t: The full $150,000 principal is included in her 2025 income because it was not repaid within 12 months of August 10, 2025.
opts.w: 误将公司税年结束后一年内算成借款日起 12 个月。借款所在公司税年于 2026 年 6 月 30 日结束，还款宽限期截至 2027 年 6 月 30 日。

opts.t: No taxable benefit arises under either s.15(2) or s.80.4 because she paid a positive 1% rate on the loan.
opts.w: 落入股东贷款免本金即免利息陷阱。只要实付利率（1%）低于 CRA 公布的规定利率（3%），差额部分依然触发 s.80.4 的推定利息福利（deemed interest benefit）。

opts.t: Both the $150,000 principal and a 3% deemed interest benefit are taxed as eligible dividends on a T5 slip.
opts.w: 落入滑单混报陷阱。按时归还已免除本金并入，且利息福利走 T4A 计入普通所得，绝非 T5 上的合资格股息。

variants.pt: 公司车待命费与股东福利滑单
variants.trap: 滑单混报与超额合资格股息陷阱
variants.stem: A corporation leases a vehicle for $900 per month (including taxes) and makes it available to its shareholder-employee for all 12 months of 2026. He drives 24,000 km in total during the year, including 18,000 km for business and 6,000 km for personal use, and keeps no mileage logbook, estimating the split from memory. How is his standby charge determined?
variants.zh: 一家公司以每月 $900（含税）租赁一辆汽车，在 2026 年全年 12 个月提供给股东兼雇员使用。他全年共行驶 24,000 公里，其中公务 18,000 公里、私用 6,000 公里，但未记行车日志，仅凭感觉估算比例。他的汽车待命费如何确定？

opts.t: 2/3 × $900 × 12 months, reduced by multiplying by 6,000 ÷ (1,667 × 12) because estimated business use exceeds 50%.
opts.w: 忽略了行车日志的证据要求。待命费（standby charge）只有在公务用途超过 50% 且备有私用与公务公里记录（行车日志）时才能打折，凭感觉估算无日志只能按全额计算。

opts.t: 2% × $900 × 12 months with no reduction, because he failed to maintain a contemporaneous mileage logbook.
opts.w: 混淆了买断车与租赁车的计算公式。每月 2% 适用于买断车的原始成本，租赁车应按 2/3 × 月租计算。

opts.t: $0 standby charge, because business use represents 75% of the total kilometres driven during the year.
opts.w: 误解了待命费减免机制。即便公务过半且有日志，也只是按私用公里 ÷（1,667 × 可用月数）比例打折，只要有私用就不会直接免除为 $0，更何况本题没有行车日志。

opts.t: The full lease standby charge of 2/3 × $900 × 12 months ($7,200), since no logbook supports a reduction.
opts.w: 正确。租赁车待命费（standby charge）按 2/3 × 月租 × 可用月数计算（ITA s.6(1)(e)/(2)）；待命费只有在公务用途超过 50% 且有里程日志记录时才能按私用公里 ÷（1,667 × 可用月数）打折，不记行车日志凭感觉估只能按全额 $7,200 计算。

variants.pt: 家庭雇员s.67与合规截止日
variants.trap: TOSI年龄与工时错配陷阱
variants.stem: An owner-managed CCPC in BC hires the owner's spouse as the full-time office and purchasing manager, paying her $45,000 in 2026. Comparable arm's-length managers in the local market earn between $42,000 and $48,000. Which statement correctly describes the deductibility and filing requirements for her remuneration?
variants.zh: 一家卑诗省业主经理 CCPC 雇佣业主配偶担任全职办公室兼采购经理，2026 年支付工资 $45,000。当地市场上非关联同类岗位经理的年薪在 $42,000 至 $48,000 之间。下列哪项准确描述了该笔薪酬的扣除资格与申报要求？

opts.t: The $45,000 is non-deductible because salaries paid to a spouse are disallowed unless the owner-manager is at least 65 years old.
opts.w: 混淆了工资合理性测试与 TOSI 满 65 岁分红排除。真实付出劳动、按公允市价领工资的配偶一直合法可扣，无需等业主满 65 岁。

opts.t: All $45,000 is deductible because it passes the s.67 reasonableness test; the T4 is due by the end of February.
opts.w: 正确。配偶真实提供服务且 $45,000 工资处于同类岗位市场公允区间（$42,000–$48,000）内，满足 business purpose 测试与 s.67 合理性测试（reasonableness test），公司可全额税前扣除；T4 滑单须于次年 2 月最后一天前完成发放与申报。

opts.t: The corporation can report the $45,000 on both a T4 and a T5 so the spouse gets RRSP room and the dividend credit.
opts.w: 违反了滑单互斥原则。T4 与 T5 是两张完全独立的表，同一笔钱绝对不能同时上两张单。

opts.t: The corporation must file Form T2054 on the exact day each paycheque to the spouse becomes payable.
opts.w: 混淆了工资申报与资本股息账户（CDA）申报。T2054 当天申报要求仅适用于用 CDA 派发免税资本股息，发工资走的是 RP 薪资账户按月汇缴与次年 2 月底报 T4。

variants.pt: 股东贷款一年例外死线与雇员例外
variants.trap: 用借款日加一年算还款死线
variants.stem: Mr. Deng is the sole shareholder of Pacific Supply Ltd., which has a January 31 taxation year-end. On February 1, 2026, he borrows $100,000 from the corporation for personal use (not part of a series of loans and repayments). What is the latest date he can repay the principal to qualify for the one-year repayment exception under ITA s.15(2.6)?
variants.zh: 邓先生是太平洋供应公司的唯一股东，该公司税年结束日为 1 月 31 日。2026 年 2 月 1 日，他因个人用途从公司借款 $100,000（不属于一系列借与还）。为符合 ITA s.15(2.6) 的一年还款例外，他最迟可在哪一天归还本金？

opts.t: February 1, 2027, one calendar year from the date the funds were advanced.
opts.w: 落入了『借款日加一年』的陷阱；必须先确定放款落入公司的哪一个税年，再从该税年结束日往后推一年。

opts.t: January 31, 2027, the end of the corporation's taxation year in which the loan was made.
opts.w: 少算了一年；2027-01-31 只是放款所在公司税年的结束日，s.15(2.6) 允许在该税年结束之后再往后一年内还清。

opts.t: December 31, 2027, one year after the end of the 2026 calendar year.
opts.w: 误把个人日历年当成起算点；s.15(2.6) 看的是放款方（公司）的税年结束日（1 月 31 日），而非 12 月 31 日。

opts.t: January 31, 2028, which is one year after the corporation's January 31, 2027 taxation year-end.
opts.w: 公司的税年结束日为 1 月 31 日，2026 年 2 月 1 日放出的股东贷款（shareholder loan）落在 2027-01-31 结束的那个公司税年内；按 s.15(2.6) 往后推一年，还款死线为 2028-01-31。

variants.pt: s.80.4视同利息利益与实付利息抵减
variants.trap: 股东贷款免本金即免利息
variants.stem: An employee-shareholder receives an interest-free home relocation loan from his corporation on January 1, 2026, when the CRA prescribed rate is 3%. If the loan remains outstanding for more than five years and prescribed rates fluctuate in future quarters, how does ITA s.80.4(4) and (6) govern the rate used to calculate his deemed interest benefit?
variants.zh: 一名雇员股东于 2026 年 1 月 1 日从其公司取得一笔无息搬迁购房贷款，放款当时的 CRA 规定利率为 3%。若该贷款存续超过五年且未来各季度的规定利率发生波动，ITA s.80.4(4) 与 (6) 如何规定其视同利息利益的计算利率？

opts.t: The rate is permanently fixed at 3% for the whole life of the loan, even if the quarterly prescribed rate falls below 3%.
opts.w: 误以为购房贷款利率是『既封顶又托底』且永久不变；实际上它是只封顶不托底（利率下行时按当期较低利率算），且每满五年要重新锁定一次。

opts.t: The rate floats freely with each quarter's prescribed rate with no cap, since only non-shareholder employees get a rate cap.
opts.w: 忽略了 s.80.4(4) 对符合条件的购房与搬迁贷款设有放款时规定利率封顶的保护规则。

opts.t: Capped at the 3% rate in force when the loan was made (a lower current rate applies if rates fall), re-locked after five years.
opts.w: 根据 ITA s.80.4(4) 与 (6)，购房与搬迁类借款的视同利息利益（deemed interest benefit）计算利率以放款当时的规定利率（prescribed rate）封顶、下行时按当期较低利率算；期限超过五年的，第五年末余额视同一笔新贷款，按那一刻的规定利率重新锁顶。

opts.t: No deemed interest benefit is calculated during the first five years, after which the full principal is added to income under s.15(2).
opts.w: 前五年期间只要是无息或低息借款，仍须按季计算 s.80.4 视同利息利益，并非免算五年。

variants.pt: s.85票据超税基与下限规则
variants.trap: s.85 拿超额票据仍以为零税负
variants.stem: Mr. Kuan makes the s.85 transfer in 2026. As a self-employed individual, his 2026 T1 filing deadline is June 15, 2027. His new corporation chooses May 31, 2027 as its first taxation year-end, making its T2 filing deadline November 30, 2027. Which property CANNOT be included in the s.85 rollover, and what is the filing deadline for Form T2057?
variants.zh: 关先生在 2026 年进行 s.85 转让。作为有自雇收入的个人，他 2026 年 T1 的报税截止日为 2027 年 6 月 15 日；新公司选择 2027 年 5 月 31 日为首个税年结束日，其 T2 报税截止日为 2027 年 11 月 30 日。下列哪类财产不能用 s.85 转让，且 T2057 表的递交截止日是哪一天？

opts.t: Real property held as inventory cannot be rolled over; Form T2057 is due on June 15, 2027.
opts.w: 根据 s.85(1.1)，存货里的不动产不属于合格财产（eligible property），不能用 s.85 转进公司；根据 s.85(6)，T2057 必须在转让双方各自报税截止日中最早的那一天（2027-06-15 与 2027-11-30 取早，即 2027-06-15）之前单独递交。

opts.t: Internally generated goodwill cannot be rolled over; Form T2057 is due on November 30, 2027 with the corporate T2.
opts.w: 自建商誉属于合格财产（可按税基 $0 选举转让）；且 T2057 不随 T2 一起递交，截止日取双方中最早的 2027-06-15 而非公司的 2027-11-30。

opts.t: Real property held as inventory cannot be rolled over; Form T2057 is due on November 30, 2027.
opts.w: 虽然找对了不合格财产，但错选了较晚的公司报税截止日；s.85(6) 规定取转让方与受让公司申报期限中最早的一个（2027-06-15）。

opts.t: Depreciable equipment cannot be rolled over; Form T2057 is due on June 15, 2027.
opts.w: 折旧设备属于合格财产（eligible property），可以通过 s.85 递延转让。

variants.pt: ABIL计算与历年豁免两倍冲减
variants.trap: ABIL 误用 2/3 纳入率或漏算豁免冲减
variants.stem: Suppose Mr. Yuen had NEVER claimed the lifetime capital gains exemption in any prior year, so his $50,000 loss in 2026 produces a $25,000 ABIL. Which rules govern the small business corporation (SBC) timing test for this loss and the carryforward of any unused ABIL?
variants.zh: 假设袁先生在以往任何年度都未曾用过终身资本利得豁免，因此 2026 年的 $50,000 损失产生 $25,000 的 ABIL。关于该笔损失的小企业公司（SBC）时点测试及未用完 ABIL 的结转，适用哪项规则？

opts.t: The company must meet the SBC test on the exact day of disposition, and unused ABIL carries forward for 20 years against any income.
opts.w: 两处皆错：判 ABIL 只需在处置前 12 个月内任一时点符合 SBC 定义即可；且 ABIL 只能作为非资本亏损结转 10 年（普通非资本亏损才是 20 年）。

opts.t: SBC status at any time in the 12 months before disposal suffices; unused ABIL carries forward 10 years, then becomes a net capital loss.
opts.w: 判可扣营业投资损失（ABIL）时，只要处置前 12 个月内的任何一个时点符合小企业公司（small business corporation, SBC）定义即可（倒闭前卖光设备剩现金不影响资格）；按 s.111，未用完的 ABIL 结转 10 年后转为净资本亏损（net capital loss），此后只能抵应税资本利得。

opts.t: The company must hold 90% active business assets for 24 consecutive months, and any unused ABIL expires completely after 10 years.
opts.w: ABIL 不要求连续 24 个月持有测试（那是处置前 12 个月内任一时点测试），且第 10 年后未用完的 ABIL 是转为可无限期结转的净资本亏损，而非彻底作废。

opts.t: Selling the worthless shares directly to his spouse triggers the ABIL immediately, with no need for any s.50(1) election.
opts.w: 根据 s.39(1)(c)，触发 ABIL 必须是 s.50(1) 视同处置选举或与『非关联方』的真实处置；把烂股份卖给配偶属于关联方交易，不产生 ABIL。

variants.pt: 清算视同股息与PUC及ACB分步计税
variants.trap: 清算时拿个人 ACB 算视同股息
variants.stem: During its 2026 wind-up, a corporation has an actual CDA balance of $40,000, but the director mistakenly files an s.83(2) capital dividend election for $50,000. What is the tax consequence under ITA s.184, and what relief is available?
variants.zh: 在 2026 年清算过程中，一家公司的实际 CDA 余额为 $40,000，但董事误按 $50,000 递交了 s.83(2) 资本股息选举。按 ITA s.184 会产生什么税务后果，又有什么救济途径？

opts.t: The entire $50,000 election is voided automatically, and the shareholder must include the whole $50,000 as an ordinary taxable dividend.
opts.w: 超额选举不会使 CDA 真实余额内的 $40,000 免税部分自动作废；惩罚针对的是超出的 $10,000 部分。

opts.t: Part III tax of 3/5 of the $10,000 excess applies, unless within 90 days of assessment the excess is elected to be a taxable dividend.
opts.w: 根据 ITA s.184，资本股息（capital dividend）选举金额超过资本股息账户（CDA）余额的部分（$10,000），公司要缴 3/5 的第三部分税（Part III tax）；救济是在超额评税通知书发出后 90 天内再作一次选举，把超额部分改按应税股息处理。

opts.t: The corporation pays a late-filing penalty of $100 per month, up to a maximum of $8,000, under the s.85(8) rules.
opts.w: 混淆了不同条文的罚则；每月 $100、封顶 $8,000 是 s.85(8) 资产转让选举或 s.220(3.2) 迟报选举的罚金，不是 s.184 超额资本股息的第三部分税。

opts.t: The $10,000 excess is automatically deducted from the shareholder's lifetime capital gains exemption in the following year.
opts.w: CDA 超额选举与终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）没有自动抵扣关系，超额部分触发的是公司层面的 3/5 第三部分税。

variants.pt: 清算解散法定顺序与清税证明书责任
variants.trap: 先分财产后办清税证明或注销后才选 CDA
variants.stem: Which sequence correctly orders the mandatory steps for winding up and dissolving a corporation and closing its CRA accounts?
variants.zh: 下列哪项正确排列了公司清算解散及关闭 CRA 账户的法定步骤顺序？

opts.t: Distribute remaining cash to shareholders → final T2 (line 078 Yes) → apply for TX19 clearance certificate → CDA election after dissolution.
opts.w: 把最致命的两步全做反了：不能在拿到 TX19 清税证明书之前分钱，且公司一旦注销就不存在了，CDA 选举必须在注销前完成。

opts.t: Close BN accounts with RC145 → apply for TX19 clearance certificate → file final T2 return (line 078 Yes) → distribute property to shareholders.
opts.w: 顺序颠倒：申请 TX19 清税证明书必须附上『最终 T2 的评税通知书』，因此必须先报最终 T2 并拿到评税通知书才能申请 TX19，而 RC145 关户排在最后一步。

opts.t: Apply for TX19 clearance certificate first → receive certificate → file final T2 return (line 078 Yes) → distribute property and close accounts.
opts.w: 在还没申报最终 T2 并取得最终 T2 评税通知书（含 Schedule 100 资产分配信息）之前，无法完成 TX19 清税证明书的申请。

opts.t: Resolution and debts settled → final T2 (line 078 Yes) → TX19 and clearance certificate → distribute, with CDA election → RC145.
opts.w: 正确的七步法定顺序是：①股东决议 → ②变现资产清偿债务 → ③报最终 T2（第 078 行勾『是』）→ ④凭最终 T2 评税通知书等三份材料交 TX19 申请清税证明书（clearance certificate）→ ⑤收到清税证明书 → ⑥向股东分配剩余财产并在注销前完成 s.83(2) CDA 选举 → ⑦用 RC145 关闭营业号程序账户。

variants.pt: s.50(1)视同处置选举年份与实物分配
variants.trap: 先分财产后办清税证明或注销后才选 CDA
variants.stem: Instead of selling its delivery van and computers for cash before winding up under ITA s.88(2), a corporation transfers those capital assets directly to its sole shareholder on the wind-up. How does s.88(2) treat this distribution at the corporate level?
variants.zh: 一家公司在按 ITA s.88(2) 清算前没有把送货车和电脑卖成现金，而是直接在清算时将这些资本资产过户给唯一股东。s.88(2) 在公司层面如何处理这次分配？

opts.t: The corporation is deemed to dispose of each distributed property at its fair market value, recognizing any resulting recapture or capital gain on its final T2 return.
opts.w: 根据 ITA s.88(2)，清算（winding-up）时分给股东的每一项财产均按公平市值视同处置，公司当年要认列相应的收入回收、折旧回收与资本利得，把车和电脑直接过户给股东并非零税事件。

opts.t: The assets roll over automatically at their undepreciated capital cost (UCC) so that neither the corporation nor the shareholder pays tax on the wind-up.
opts.w: 普通小公司向个人股东清算适用的是 s.88(2) 而非免税结转；财产按公平市值视同处置，不存在自动按未折旧资本成本（UCC）零税过户的待遇。

opts.t: The corporation recognizes no gain, and the fair market value of the van and computers is taxed solely as an employment benefit on a T4 slip.
opts.w: 清算分配是股东身份下的分配，公司在 s.88(2) 下按市值视同处置资产，股东则按 s.84(2) 与资本损益规则计税，不是雇佣福利。

opts.t: The transfer is ignored for tax purposes until the shareholder eventually sells the van and computers to an arm's-length buyer.
opts.w: 违反了『公司与股东是两个独立纳税主体』的底层逻辑；财产在清算离开公司那一刻即按公平市值视同处置。

variants.pt: 雇员福利与股东福利的身份分流与报表
variants.trap: 混淆雇员福利（s.6，T4，可扣）与股东福利（s.15(1)，T4A，不可扣）
variants.stem: Elena owns 100% of the shares of a consulting corporation and also works as its manager. In 2026, the corporation paid $9,500 for a luxury family vacation for Elena and her parents. No other employees receive vacation payments. What are the corporate and personal tax consequences of this $9,500 payment?
variants.zh: Elena 拥有一家咨询公司 100% 的股份并兼任经理。2026 年，公司支付了 $9,500 为 Elena 和她的父母购买豪华家庭度假。其他雇员均无此类度假福利。这笔 $9,500 支出的公司税与个人税后果是什么？

opts.t: The corporation deducts the $9,500 as an employee fringe benefit, and Elena includes the $9,500 on her T4 employment slip.
opts.w: 错误。其他雇员都没有这项福利，说明 Elena 是因持股身份而非受雇身份拿到这笔家庭度假费，不能按受雇福利（ITA s.6(1)(a)）在公司税前扣除并报 T4。

opts.t: The corporation is denied any deduction for the $9,500, and only Elena's parents are taxed on their own shares of the trip.
opts.w: 错误。根据股东福利规则（shareholder benefit, ITA s.15(1)），公司向股东或其关系人授予的福利，由股东本人（Elena）全额计入当年收入，而不是转嫁给未持股的父母申报。

opts.t: No corporate deduction (it fails the s.18(1)(a) purpose test), and Elena includes $9,500 as a s.15(1) shareholder benefit on a T4A.
opts.w: 正确。替股东及其父母付私人度假费与赚取经营收入无关，过不了 ITA s.18(1)(a) 目的检验，公司不得扣除；同时按 ITA s.15(1) 股东福利规则，全额 $9,500 计入股东 Elena 的个人收入，报在 T4A code 028。

opts.t: The corporation can deduct the $9,500 if it withholds CPP, EI and income tax on that amount before the end of February 2027.
opts.w: 错误。身份判据看的是事实而非账务或扣缴动作，属于股东身份拿到的私人消费不能通过补做源头扣缴变成可扣除的雇员薪酬。

variants.pt: 2026法定扣款上限与雇主配比成本
variants.trap: 只看 EI 费率下调就断定保费减少或忽略雇主 1.4 倍
variants.stem: When comparing the 2026 federal statutory payroll deduction rules with those of 2024 and 2025 for an employee earning $90,000 per year outside Quebec, which statement is correct?
variants.zh: 在为一位魁北克以外、年薪 $90,000 的雇员比较 2026 年与 2024、2025 年的联邦法定薪资扣款规则时，下列哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: The EI rate fell to 1.63% in 2026, yet the maximum employee EI premium rose to $1,123.07 because MIE rose to $68,900.
opts.w: 正确。这是讲义重点强调的判断：EI 雇员费率虽然从 2024 年的 1.66% 一路降到 2026 年的 1.63%，但最高可保收入（Maximum Insurable Earnings, MIE）从 $63,200 升到了 $68,900，两个数字反向变动，乘出来的 2026 年雇员最高保费（$1,123.07）与雇主最高保费（$1,572.30）仍然逐年上升。

opts.t: Because the federal EI rate dropped to 1.63% in 2026, the maximum annual EI premium paid by both the employee and the employer is lower in 2026 than in 2024.
opts.w: 错误。这是「只看费率判断保费涨跌」的典型陷阱，忽略了可保收入上限（MIE）从 $63,200 大幅上调至 $68,900 的影响。

opts.t: The CPP basic exemption was indexed upward in 2026 along with the $74,600 YMPE, which lowers the employee's effective CPP rate.
opts.w: 错误。CPP 基本免税额（basic exemption）$3,500 从 1997 年冻结至今不指数化，因此随着 YMPE 升至 $74,600，CPP 的实际有效费率其实在悄悄上升。

opts.t: The employer's CPP2 contribution is 1.4 times the employee's $416 contribution, which matches the Employment Insurance multiplier.
opts.w: 错误。1.4 倍配比只适用于就业保险（EI）；CPP 与 CPP2 的雇主配比均为 1:1（各 $4,230.45 与 $416）。

variants.pt: 公司车减免待命费的双重并列条件
variants.trap: 减免待命费只看业务比例过半
variants.stem: In 2026, a corporation buys a car for $45,000 (before tax) and makes it available for all 12 months to an employee who is required to use it for work. The employee drives 22,000 km in total during 2026: 10,000 km for business (45%) and 12,000 km for personal use. How are the standby charge and operating expense benefit determined for 2026?
variants.zh: 2026 年，一家公司以 $45,000（税前）买入一辆车，全年 12 个月提供给一位因工作需要用车的雇员。该雇员 2026 年共行驶 22,000 公里：业务 10,000 公里（45%），个人 12,000 公里。2026 年的待命费和运营费用福利应如何确定？

opts.t: The standby charge is cut to 12,000/20,004 of 2% × $45,000 × 12, and the operating benefit is 12,000 km × 34¢.
opts.w: 错误。个人里程 12,000 公里虽低于 20,004 公里，但业务用途只占 45%，未过半，不满足减免待命费（reduced standby charge）的第一个条件，待命费不能打折。

opts.t: Business use is not over half, so no reduction and no optional method: full $10,800 standby charge, and 34¢ × 12,000 km ($4,080).
opts.w: 正确。减免待命费与运营费用福利的选择性算法（optional calculation）都要求业务用途过半；本例业务只占 45%，两项都不可用。自有车待命费按全额：2% × $45,000 × 12 ＝ $10,800；运营费用福利只能用固定费率法：12,000 公里 × 34¢ ＝ $4,080。

opts.t: He may still elect the optional method of $5,400 (half the $10,800 standby charge), as it is lower than the fixed-rate amount.
opts.w: 错误。选择性算法（按待命费的一半计算）不仅要求存在待命费，还要求业务用途过半；业务仅占 45% 时不能用，$5,400 的算法不成立。

opts.t: Both benefits are subject to CPP, EI and income tax source deductions, and both are reported on the employee's T4 slip.
opts.w: 错误。公司车辆产生的应税福利属于非现金福利，不构成可保收入（insurable earnings），因此只需扣缴 CPP 与所得税，不扣缴 EI。

variants.pt: 乘用车法定上限与里程津贴方向辨析
variants.trap: 混淆里程津贴与运营费用福利
variants.stem: Which of the following correctly pairs a 2026 federal automobile parameter with its tax mechanism?
variants.zh: 下列哪一项正确配对了 2026 年联邦车辆参数及其税务机制？

opts.t: 73 cents / 67 cents per km: the rate used to calculate the taxable operating expense benefit when an employee drives a company car for personal use.
opts.w: 错误。73¢／67¢ 是雇员开私家车办公事的合理免税里程津贴（reasonable per-kilometre allowance）；开公司车办私事的运营费用福利固定费率是 34¢/km。

opts.t: $61,000: the maximum monthly deductible lease cost for a non-zero-emission passenger vehicle.
opts.w: 错误。$61,000 是 Class 54 零排放乘用车的 CCA 资本成本上限，而月租金扣除上限是 $1,100（税前）。

opts.t: 34 cents per km: the tax-free allowance rate an employer pays an automobile salesperson for driving a personal vehicle.
opts.w: 错误。34¢/km（汽车销售或租赁雇员为 31¢/km）是开公司车产生个人里程时的应税运营费用福利费率（operating expense benefit），方向是计入雇员收入而非免税津贴。

opts.t: $1,100 per month (before tax) and $350 per month: the respective ceilings on deductible lease costs and deductible car loan interest for a passenger vehicle in 2026.
opts.w: 正确。2026 税年乘用车的月租金扣除上限（leasing deduction limit）为 $1,100／月（税前），新车贷利息扣除上限（interest deduction limit）为 $350／月，两者在 2026 年均已生效且与条例文本一致。

variants.pt: 礼品500排除股东与奖金180天死线
variants.trap: 股东亲属套用 $500 礼品免税
variants.stem: In 2026, a corporation gives three items to an arm's length employee who has worked there for exactly five years (and never received a service award before): a $400 non-cash birthday gift, a $450 non-cash 5-year long-service plaque and watch, and a $200 cash bonus card. It also gives a $300 non-cash holiday gift to the sole shareholder's spouse who works part-time as a bookkeeper. Which items are taxable benefits in 2026?
variants.zh: 2026 年，一家公司向一位工作满五年（且此前从未拿过服务奖）的公平交易雇员发放了三样东西：一份价值 $400 的非现金生日礼物、一份价值 $450 的非现金五周年长期服务奖牌与手表，以及一张 $200 的现金奖励卡。公司还向兼职做记账的唯一股东配偶送了一份价值 $300 的非现金节日礼物。2026 年哪些项目属于应税福利？

opts.t: Only the $200 cash bonus card and the $350 excess of the combined $850 non-cash items given to the arm's length employee are taxable; the spouse's $300 gift is tax-free.
opts.w: 错误。一方面，每满五年一次的 $500 非现金长期服务奖与每年 $500 的非现金礼品额度互不占用，公平交易雇员的 $400 与 $450 均免税；另一方面，股东配偶属于关系人（non-arm's length），不适用 $500 免税政策，$300 必须全额计税。

opts.t: All four items are fully taxable because an employer cannot combine the annual gift policy and the long-service award policy in one calendar year.
opts.w: 错误。一般礼品奖（$500）与五年一次的长期服务奖（$500）两个额度互不占用，同一年可以各用一次。

opts.t: Only the $200 cash bonus card is taxable, because each of the three non-cash gifts is under the $500 threshold, including the spouse's gift.
opts.w: 错误。漏掉了 CRA 礼品政策的核心排除条款（non-arm's length exclusion）：股东及其亲属（包括配偶）收到的任何礼品，从第一块钱起就是应税福利。

opts.t: The arm's length employee's $400 gift and $450 service award are tax-free; the $200 cash card and the spouse's $300 gift are taxable.
opts.w: 正确。对公平交易雇员而言，每年 $500 非现金礼品额度与每满五年 $500 非现金长期服务奖额度互不占用，因此 $400 与 $450 均免税，但现金与准现金（$200）永远是应税福利；对股东配偶而言，非公平交易雇员（non-arm's length employee）被明文排除在 $500 政策之外，$300 全额计税。

variants.pt: 源头扣缴汇款四档与迟缴未扣罚则
variants.trap: 忽略联营公司合并 AMWA 或销售税迟报导致季度汇款资格丢失
variants.stem: An employer deducted $10,500 in CPP, EI, and income tax from its employees' paycheques in May 2026 (its first offence and not due to gross negligence), but remitted the $10,500 to the CRA six days after the due date. What is the federal late remittance penalty rule for this delay?
variants.zh: 一家雇主在 2026 年 5 月从雇员薪水中扣下了 $10,500 的 CPP、EI 和所得税（属首次违规且非严重疏忽），但在到期日之后第 6 天才将这 $10,500 上缴给 CRA。针对这次延误的联邦迟缴罚则是什么？

opts.t: 7% of the amount above $500, since the late remittance tiers are 3%, 5%, 7% and 10% by days late.
opts.w: 正确。扣了迟交适用四级阶梯迟缴罚（late remittance penalty）：迟交 1–3 天罚 3%、4–5 天罚 5%、6–7 天罚 7%、超过 7 天或未交罚 10%；在非明知或严重疏忽的一般情形下，只对超过 $500 的那一部分计罚。迟交 6 天对应 7%。

opts.t: 10% on the full $10,500, applied immediately from the first day after the remittance due date.
opts.w: 错误。10% 是未扣缴罚（failure to deduct penalty）或迟缴超过 7 天／根本未交的最高档罚率，迟交 6 天适用 7%。

opts.t: 3% on the full $10,500, because every remittance made within seven days is penalized at a flat 3%.
opts.w: 错误。3% 仅适用于迟交 1–3 天（或加速门槛二雇主按时缴但未经金融机构缴纳的情形），6–7 天为 7%。

opts.t: 20% on the full $10,500, because source deductions are held in trust for the Crown and were not remitted.
opts.w: 错误。20% 罚率仅在同一日历年内第二次违规、且属于明知或严重疏忽（knowingly or under circumstances amounting to gross negligence）时才触发。

variants.pt: BC雇主健康税缺口费率与联营共享
variants.trap: 联营公司拆薪资躲避加速汇款或 BC 雇主健康税
variants.stem: Why does British Columbia's Employer Health Tax (EHT) apply a 5.85% notch rate to a regular employer's BC remuneration between $1,000,000.01 and $1,500,000, while applying 1.95% to total remuneration once payroll exceeds $1,500,000?
variants.zh: 为什么卑诗省的雇主健康税（EHT）对一般雇主在 $1,000,000.01 至 $1,500,000 之间的 BC 薪酬适用 5.85% 的缺口费率，而在薪酬超过 $1,500,000 后改对全额薪酬适用 1.95%？

opts.t: The 5.85% notch rate phases out the exemption so that at $1,500,000 both formulas give the same $29,250, with no cliff.
Employers with payroll over $1,500,000 still keep the $1,000,000 exemption and pay 1.95% only on the part above $1,500,000.
opts.w: 错误。一旦薪酬超过 $1,500,000，$1,000,000 的免税额整块消失，1.95% 是乘以全额 BC 薪酬。

opts.t: 5.85% is the rate for regular employers, while 1.95% is reserved exclusively for registered charities and non-profit organizations.
opts.w: 错误。慈善与非营利雇主的免税额是 $1,500,000、缺口费率是 2.925%；1.95% 是一般雇主超过 $1,500,000 后的全额税率。

opts.t: The first $500,000 above $1,000,000 includes federal CPP and EI remittances, which are deducted once payroll exceeds $1,500,000.
opts.w: 错误。BC 雇主健康税按日历年 BC 薪酬计征，与联邦所得税和源头扣缴（CPP/EI）完全无关。

variants.pt: 非营利组织四要件与禁开收据
variants.trap: 零税免报 T2 陷阱
variants.stem: Compare an incorporated registered charity under ITA s.149(1)(f) with an incorporated non-profit organization (NPO) under ITA s.149(1)(l), assuming neither has any tax payable for the year. How do their rules differ regarding official donation receipts and annual T2 returns?
variants.zh: 对比一家符合 ITA s.149(1)(f) 的公司制注册慈善机构与一家符合 ITA s.149(1)(l) 的公司制非营利组织（假设两者当年应纳税额均为零）。它们在开具正式捐赠收据和年度 T2 申报义务上有何不同？
